title: Cloud DevOps -Operations Support-Puppet
description:
Job Description

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE – SaaS Platform Operations)

Position Summary: Experienced Azure-based SRE required to support a large-scale enterprise SaaS platform, with strong Microsoft SQL Server expertise, future PostgreSQL readiness, production operations, patching, automation, troubleshooting, and incident response capability.

Role Type

Site Reliability Engineering / SaaS Platform Operations

Primary Technology Focus

Microsoft Azure, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Windows/Linux, Monitoring, Automation

Future Scope

Upcoming releases include database movement from MSSQL to PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL operational support is expected to become increasingly important.

Experience Level

4+ years relevant experience; strong MSSQL production support background; PostgreSQL exposure preferred

Working Model

24x7 production support environment; US time zone support/night shifts as required

Audience

Client, delivery leadership, hiring panel, and internal stakeholders



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support a large-scale enterprise SaaS platform operating in cloud and high-availability environments.

This role is responsible for maintaining infrastructure reliability, availability, performance, and operational excellence across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL readiness, Windows, Linux, monitoring, automation, and incident response functions.

This is not a first-line helpdesk role. The role requires a hands-on engineer who can independently investigate complex technical issues, collaborate with engineering and platform teams, and provide clear technical communication to internal and client stakeholders.

Future Scope: In upcoming product releases, selected databases are expected to move from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL. The role should therefore include PostgreSQL awareness and operational readiness in addition to current MSSQL responsibilities.

Role Focus Areas

Focus Area

Expected Capability

Business Outcome

Cloud Operations

Manage and support Azure infrastructure, monitoring, storage, compute, and patching activities.

Stable, secure, and scalable platform operations.

Database Reliability

Administer MSSQL workloads today and support PostgreSQL readiness for future releases, including tuning, maintenance, backups, and HA/DR.

Improved database performance, resiliency, and recoverability.

Patching & Maintenance

Plan and support SQL/database patching and operating system patching across Windows and Linux environments.

Improved security compliance and reduced operational risk.

Incident Response

Perform initial analysis, support P1/P2 triage, contribute to RCA, and improve runbooks.

Reduced MTTR and stronger production readiness.

Automation & Observability

Use PowerShell/Python, alert tuning, logging, dashboards, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

Better operational efficiency and proactive issue detection.

Engineering Collaboration

Reproduce issues, validate defects, and escalate with evidence to product engineering.

Faster defect resolution and improved customer experience.

Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Platform Reliability

  • Maintain highly available, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.

  • Monitor platform health, review technical logs, and proactively address performance and availability issues.

  • Improve infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and logging to support proactive reliability management.

  • Plan, coordinate, and support operating system patching and maintenance activities across Windows and Linux servers.

  • Ensure security updates, compliance patches, and platform upgrades are executed in line with change management processes while minimizing service disruption.

  • Drive operational excellence through standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.

Database Administration & Performance Management

  • Manage and support Microsoft SQL Server databases across production and non-production environments on Azure.

  • Support PostgreSQL operational readiness and future PostgreSQL database support as selected databases move from MSSQL to PostgreSQL in upcoming releases.

  • Troubleshoot and tune queries, SQL jobs, indexing, CPU, memory, I/O, and storage utilization.

  • Implement and maintain backup, restore, high availability, disaster recovery, and routine database maintenance processes.

  • Perform SQL Server and PostgreSQL database patching, upgrades, maintenance, and version lifecycle activities under enterprise change management processes.

  • Use T-SQL and scripts for investigations, reporting, and controlled production data fixes under change control.

Incident Management & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Investigate complex infrastructure, application, database, Windows, Linux, and Azure-related issues.

  • Participate in incident response, perform initial technical analysis, and contribute to root cause analysis documentation.

  • Reproduce customer-reported issues in staging or lab environments where required.

  • Escalate verified product defects to engineering teams with clear technical evidence, logs, and impact analysis.

Automation, DevOps & Observability

  • Create and maintain operational automation using PowerShell, Python, or equivalent scripting languages.

  • Support Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management practices using tools such as Terraform and Puppet.

  • Collaborate on CI/CD and operational tooling improvements using platforms such as GitHub and Jenkins.

  • Enhance monitoring and alert management practices for SaaS product operations.

Stakeholder & Customer Communication

  • Collaborate closely with onsite DB SREs, application teams, platform teams, product support, and engineering.

  • Provide clear and timely communication on issue status, technical findings, risks, and next steps.

  • Join customer or onsite calls when required to explain technical findings and remediation actions.

  • Update runbooks, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and operational documentation.

Required Qualifications Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in SRE, production operations, database administration, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise platform support.

  • 2+ years of SaaS pipeline or SaaS product operations experience.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and cloud monitoring tools.

  • 4+ years in Microsoft SQL Server-centric roles such as DBA, Production Support Engineer, or Database SRE in 24x7 environments.

  • PostgreSQL exposure or willingness to support PostgreSQL environments as part of future platform modernization scope.

  • Experience supporting SQL/database patching and operating system patching activities in controlled production environments.

  • Willingness and ability to work night shifts or US time zone aligned support coverage when required.

Technical Skills Matrix

Skill Category

Required Skills

Priority

Database

MSSQL 2016+, T-SQL, query tuning, SQL jobs, stored procedures, indexing, backup/restore, HA/DR

Critical

PostgreSQL

PostgreSQL administration, performance tuning, backup/recovery, replication, HA awareness, and migration/coexistence readiness

Future Scope / High

Patching

SQL/database patching, OS patching, version lifecycle management, maintenance planning, and controlled change execution

High

Cloud

Microsoft Azure infrastructure, Azure VMs, Azure storage, Azure SQL or SQL on Azure VMs, Azure monitoring

Critical

Operating Systems

Windows Server administration and working knowledge of Linux servers

High

Monitoring & SRE

Application performance monitoring, alert management, logging, incident response, RCA, runbooks

High

Automation

PowerShell, Python, scripting for investigations, reporting, and operational automation

High

DevOps / IaC

Terraform, Puppet, GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD awareness

Medium

Containerization

Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture familiarity

Preferred

Preferred / Additional Qualifications

  • Experience setting up, configuring, and improving monitoring and tooling for SRE/DevOps operations of a SaaS product.

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL databases in enterprise production environments.

  • Experience with database migration, modernization, or coexistence initiatives involving Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL performance tuning, backup/recovery, replication, and high availability architectures.

  • Experience with PagerDuty or similar incident notification and escalation platforms.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch is a strong advantage.

  • Ability to perform application debugging and collaborate effectively with Product Support, Platform, Database, and Engineering teams.

  • Ability to conduct research, evaluate technology options, make recommendations, and maintain a high level of expertise in systems software and operational tooling.

  • Strong understanding of compliance, policies, procedures, patching windows, and change control expectations in enterprise production environments.

Core Competencies

Independent technical troubleshooting

Customer-focused communication

Production incident ownership

Analytical thinking and RCA mindset

Cross-functional collaboration

Operational discipline and documentation

Hiring / Screening Guidance

Candidate screening should prioritize strong MSSQL production operations and Azure infrastructure experience, while also considering PostgreSQL exposure or readiness due to upcoming platform releases where selected databases are expected to move from MSSQL to PostgreSQL. The role is best suited for an engineer who can combine database reliability, cloud operations, patching, automation, and incident response in a large-scale SaaS environment.

Strong Fit Indicators

Potential Red Flags

MSSQL DBA / production support background

Pure DevOps profile with limited database depth

Azure infrastructure operations experience

NOC/helpdesk-only background

PostgreSQL exposure or database modernization experience

Database developer with no production operations

SQL and OS patching experience in controlled environments

Cloud-only profile without MSSQL troubleshooting

Hands-on incident/RCA ownership

No exposure to controlled patching/change management

PowerShell/Python automation

Limited ownership in incident response

Comfortable with US time zone support

No willingness to support future PostgreSQL scope

Role Value Proposition

This role provides the opportunity to contribute directly to reliability, performance, security, and operational maturity for a large-scale enterprise SaaS platform. The selected candidate will support the current Microsoft SQL Server estate, help prepare for future PostgreSQL adoption, and work with modern cloud, database, automation, patching, and monitoring technologies while collaborating closely with experienced SRE, database, platform, support, and engineering teams.

title: Junior Graphic & Multimedia Designer
description:
Description

Join us in an exciting phase of growth and expansion at The Brewerkz Group!

This role supports creative execution across our family of brands — from award-winning craft beers and modern Mexican fare, to modern Asian dining and our newest concept designed for Singapore’s startup ecosystem.

You’ll be working across:

  • Brewerkz – Singapore’s longest-running craft brewery, with six thriving restaurants and a proud Made with Passion brand

  • Café Iguana – Serving modern Mexican food and a pioneer in Singapore’s Mexican dining scene since 2000

  • Jiak Kim House – A tribute to modern Asian cuisine housed in a beautifully restored 1920s warehouse along the Singapore River, helmed by Chef-Partner Seow Tzi Qin (TQ)

Reporting to the Art Director and working closely with the marketing team, this role covers both print and digital design, with a strong emphasis on social media content, reels, and website visuals. You will work closely with the marketing team to execute campaigns, support outlet launches, and bring brand stories to life across multiple platforms.

This role is ideal for someone self-driven, hands-on, and passionate about F&B and lifestyle brands.

Responsibilities

  • Design and adapt marketing collaterals across print and digital platforms (menus, posters, EDMs, social content)

  • Create visual content for social media, including reels, short-form videos, and website assets

  • Assist in food and lifestyle content shoots (photography/videography)

  • Propose and develop creative concepts for campaigns and promotions

  • Ensure accuracy and timely execution of artwork across platforms

  • Manage vendor sourcing and coordination for print production and delivery

  • Stay updated on social and digital trends to enhance brand relevance

  • Provide general creative and administrative support for marketing projects

Requirement:

  • Diploma/Degree in Graphic Design, Multimedia Design, or related field

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience preferred

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

  • Working knowledge of motion/video tools (e.g. Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut)

  • Strong understanding of social media formats and short-form content creation

  • Good sense of visual design and attention to detail

  • Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

  • Basic knowledge of CMS platforms (e.g. WordPress) is a bonus

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Developer to join our cloud-native software engineering team responsible for building and operating a modern Azure-based platform and on premise solutions in the Rail sector. The role combines development, technical direction, and development ownership, with a strong focus on Kubernetes, C#/.NET, and adoption of AI-driven capabilities across our products and services.

You will play a key role in defining the future technical roadmap, ensuring our platform remains scalable, secure, and ready to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation.


Technical Design & Architecture

  • Contribute to design, development, and implementation of cloud-based and edge-based software solutions using C#/.NET.
  • Recommendation of technical design decisions for complex systems spanning Azure-hosted services, distributed applications, and on-board software agents running on unmanned hardware.
  • Define and drive software architecture, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable, and aligned with long-term business objectives.
  • Establish engineering standards, design patterns, and development best practices across teams.

Software Development & System Ownership

  • Take ownership of critical applications and services throughout their lifecycle, from design and delivery through to operational support and continuous improvement.
  • Lead the resolution of complex technical challenges, production incidents, and cross-system integration issues.
  • Drive performance optimisation, reliability improvements, and technical debt reduction initiatives.
  • Ensure applications meet high standards for performance, security, quality, and operational excellence.

Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Work with infrastructure team on the design and evolution of Azure infrastructure, deployment strategies, observability, and operational practices.
  • Drive DevOps maturity through automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD enhancements, and deployment governance.
  • Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery strategies for cloud and edge-based systems.
  • Champion security, compliance, and resilience best practices across the software delivery lifecycle.

Distributed Systems & Messaging

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable messaging and integration architectures using message orientated architecture, event-driven patterns, and distributed systems principles.
  • Define communication standards and strategies for interactions between cloud services and remote hardware deployments.

Evaluate and the introduction of new technologies and architectural approaches where appropriate.

title: Projectsecretaris
description:
VluchtelingenWerk Nederland zet zich in voor de belangen van vluchtelingen en asielzoekers, vanaf hun eerste stap in Nederland tot aan volledige integratie. Met een netwerk van duizenden vrijwilligers en honderden betaalde medewerkers beschermen we de rechten van vluchtelingen en bieden we persoonlijke steun, belangenbehartiging en juridische begeleiding. Wil je hieraan bijdragen vanuit jouw expertise? Dat kan!

Want per 1 september zijn we op zoek naar een projectsecretaris voor Team Projecten voor onder andere het project Wijkverbinders én aanvullend een aantal uren bij andere projecten.

Wat draag je bij?

Als projectsecretaris draag je bij aan onze missie als organisatie een brug te slaan tussen vluchtelingen en de samenleving. Dit doen we in verschillende projecten

Als projectsecretaris ondersteun je de landelijk projectleider(s) en het gehele projectteam. Je draagt zorg voor de projectverantwoording en de periodieke, financiële en inhoudelijke rapportages. Daarnaast doe je aan verslaglegging, ben je een sparringpartner voor de landelijk projectleider en voer je secretariële en organisatorische werkzaamheden uit. Je bereidt inhoudelijke stukken zoals nieuwsbrieven en stuurgroep-rapportages voor en jij verstrekt -in overleg met de landelijk projectleider- informatie aan betrokken partijen. Daarnaast zijn er altijd interessante inhoudelijke onderdelen van het project die wij in overleg met jou verdelen. Je valt hiërarchisch onder de landelijke projectleider.

We bij Team Projecten opzoek naar een project secretaris die flexibel inzetbaar is op verschillende projecten waaronder in ieder geval ook het Project Wijkverbinders. Met Wijkverbinders zetten we in op het faciliteren van ontmoetingen tussen bewoners van opvanglocaties en direct omwonenden van die opvanglocaties. Onze Wijkverbinders brengen mensen samen en zorgen voor activiteiten die aansluiten bij wat vluchtelingen en omwonenden zelf belangrijk vinden. Bijvoorbeeld sport, muziek, koken, tuinieren of taal.

Wat ga je doen?

Als projectsecretaris ben je, samen met de projectleider, medeverantwoordelijk voor het reilen en zeilen van het project. Daarnaast ben je betrokken bij kwaliteitsverbeteringstrajecten en het beheer van de socialmedia kanalen. Wat neem je mee?

  • Je hebt hart voor vluchtelingen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Je helpt mee aan een menswaardige opvang en een sterke basis voor de toekomst van vluchtelingen in Nederland. Verder krijg je:

  • Salaris tussen € 3.718 en € 5.769 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur (schaal 9 van de cao Sociaal Werk).

Mocht je inhoudelijke vragen hebben dan kan er contact opgenomen worden (na 28 juli) met Conchita Rink, Projectleider via crink@vluchtelingenwerk.nl

VluchtelingenWerk als inclusieve organisatie

Wij vinden het belangrijk om onze doelgroep te betrekken en een kans te geven voor een betaalde baan binnen onze organisatie. title: Student Assistants for Social Entrepreneurship Education Projects
description:
The Department of Management, Society and Communication are looking for several student assistants with an interest in social entrepreneurship, communication, project coordination, and educational innovation to contribute to a range of projects related to social entrepreneurship education.

As a Student Assistant, you will be affiliated with Professor Kai Hockerts and Anne-Karen Hüske and become part of an international team supporting educational and research initiatives across the Aurora European University Alliance.

Our work focuses on improving social entrepreneurship education through international collaboration, innovative teaching initiatives, digital platforms, and the development of new educational projects. This includes supporting initiatives within Aurora, seizmic, and other international collaborations.

More information about our projects can be found at:

https://aurora-universities.eu/

https://alliance.aurora-network.global

https://www.seizmic.eu/

Avaliable work areas

  • Support communication activities for Aurora and seizmic initiatives.
  • Create and update communication materials for students, educators, and external stakeholders.
  • Help communicate educational initiatives and learning opportunities across the Aurora alliance.
  • Support communication with international partners and CBS colleagues.


2. International Project Support
  • Support Aurora bridge funding activities.
  • Assist with project coordination, meeting preparation, and project documentation.
  • Communicate with international partners and CBS colleagues.
  • Provide administrative support for ongoing international education projects.


3. EIT Project Support
  • Support the implementation of an EIT-funded project.
  • Assist with project coordination, communication, and documentation.
  • Contribute to project deliverables, reporting, and collaboration with project partners.
  • Support meetings and other project-related activities where needed.


4. Coursera & Digital Platforms
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of three Coursera courses.
  • Assist with digital learning resources and educational content.
  • Support educators and students using the seizmic learning ecosystem.


5. Website & Online Presence
  • Assist with the maintenance and further development of the seizmic.eu website using Wix.
  • Update website content and ensure information remains current.
  • Support digital outreach activities.


We are looking for students who
  • Have solid written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Enjoy working with multiple stakeholders in an international environment.
  • Have an interest in social entrepreneurship and educational innovation.
  • Show initiative, a service-oriented mindset, and a willingness to learn.
  • Can balance solo tasks with effective teamwork.


The following are considered an advantage
  • Experience with project coordination or international collaboration.
  • Experience with website management (e.g. Wix).
  • Experience with digital communication or content creation.
  • Familiarity with online learning platforms (e.g. Coursera).

In order to be considered, your application must include:

We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to work in an international and interdisciplinary environment at Copenhagen Business School. You will become part of an engaged and motivated research and education team while contributing to innovative projects across the Aurora European University Alliance.

The position offers flexible working hours, opportunities for professional development, and the possibility of remote work.

Salary and terms of employment

Employment takes place in accordance with the HK organisational agreement and the Collective Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and Publicly Employed Organisations (OAO-S Collective Agreement).

The salary currently ranges between DKK 144.80 and DKK 151.90 per hour and is dependent on previous employment in the office profession and level of education. The pension contribution amounts to 16% of the pensionable salary components.

It is a prerequisite for employment that you are an active student at a higher educational institution.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. A recruitment committee will assess applications and call a selection of qualified candidates for an interview.

One of CBS' strategic goals is to promote diversity and inclusion in our organisation. Therefore, we strive for a hiring process that reduces potential bias. Consequently, we encourage applicants not to include photos or unnecessary information about personal circumstances in the application.

Additional information

If you want to know more about the job content, please contact Frederik Steffensen on fs.msc@cbs.dk or on jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Interviews are expected to be held on an ongoing basis.

You apply for the position online, where you fill in the application form and attach your application with information about previous employment, exam papers and CV.

Application due 8/28/2026

title: DII Haven, Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny pædagogmedhjælper
description:
DII Haven, Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny pædagogmedhjælper.

Har du mod på at lege og være en del af de 0-6-årige børns hverdag, er Haven måske stedet for dig?

DII Haven i Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny medhjælper

Du vil komme til at have en særlig flyverstilling og derfor være sammen med både vuggestue- og børnehavebørn: Mariehønestuen, hvor de 0-2-årige boltrer sig, på Brumbassestuen holder de 2-4-årige til og hos Sommerfuglene flyver de 4-6-årige rundt. Vi er en personalegruppe, som hjælper hinanden meget i det daglige, og da vi arbejder på kryds og tværs af stuerne, vil der være dage, hvor du skal hjælpe til i en anden børnegruppe, end du regnede med. Vi bor i omgivelser med skov, sø og eng og har en kæmpe legeplads, så du skal være indstillet på, at vi er ude i alt slags vejr. Desuden har vi en gymnastiksal, hvor vi har faste gymnastikdage i løbet af ugen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En levende institution
  • En personalegruppe med engagement og faglighed
  • Et kollegialt samarbejde og et arbejdsklima med humør og glæde
  • En engageret forældregruppe, der yder stor opbakning

Vi forventer:

  • At du har overblik
  • At du kan tage initiativ og ansvar (fx lave andre aktiviteter rundt i huset, både med kollegaer og alene)
  • At du har lyst til at være sammen med børnene i børnehøjde, vi sidder meget på gulvet, og det forventer vi også, du gør.
  • At du er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og har en positiv og anerkendende tilgang til børn, forældre og kollegaer.

Vi vil foretrække:

  • Ansøgere, som har erfaring med vuggestue eller børnehavebørn.

Du kan være god til at bygge huler, danse, synge og male, men det vigtigste er, at du er positiv og har lysten vil at være sammen med vores skønne børn.

Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du læse mere på vores hjemmeside: https://aarhus.inst.dk/Foresides/IntraForeside.aspx?Location=IP.1DB

Din ansøgning bedes du sende digitalt ved at benytte link.



Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Commercial Director
description:
About Us

Atomic Group started in Australia in 2000 and has grown across China and ASEAN over two decades. With deep industry knowledge and a long-term partnership approach, we serve multinationals and local clients across all major sectors. Following the successful launch of our Singapore office in 2023and Malaysia in 2025, we're expanding fast — and looking for hungry, driven individuals to grow with us.

The Role

We're looking for a Commercial Director to run their own high-value desk within Atomic Singapore. This is an individual contributor role for a senior, billing-focused recruiter — you'll own your own client portfolio and revenue targets, operate with full autonomy on strategy and business development, and act as a mentor and senior point of reference for junior consultants.

What You'll Do

· Run and grow your own specialist desk, owning full end-to-end recruitment delivery and your own revenue targets

· Drive new business development — identifying, pitching, and winning new enterprise and multinational clients

· Build and manage senior-level client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor within your specialization

· Lead complex, high-value search assignments and headhunting for senior or hard-to-fill roles

· Mentor and coach junior and mid-level consultants informally, sharing market expertise and best practice

· Stay ahead of market trends, salary benchmarks, and competitor activity within your sector

· Represent Atomic externally at industry events and client engagements as a senior subject-matter expert

What We're Looking For

· Strong track record as a senior individual contributor in recruitment, staffing, or a related sales-driven industry

· Demonstrated ability to build and manage your own client portfolio and consistently hit revenue targets

· Strong network and credibility within the Singapore market

· Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior client contacts

· Natural mentoring ability — comfortable guiding junior consultants without formal management responsibility

· Commercially astute, self-driven, and results-oriented

What's In It For You

· Full autonomy to run your own desk and shape your own client strategy

· A senior, individual-contributor career path with no management overhead

· Opportunity to grow into a broader regional role as we expand across APAC, Europe, and the US

· Competitive base salary with a strong, uncapped commission structure

· A high-growth, entrepreneurial environment backed by two decades of group track record

Next Steps

If you're ambitious, coachable, and ready to build something — we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV to shashtidaran.prasanan@atomicgroup.sg

Da vi er et lille tæt team, er det vigtigt, at du er parat til at skifte kontorstolen ud med en lagertjans eller en varetur, når behovet opstår.

Vores varesortiment er meget bredt og omfatter reservedele til personvogne, personvognstrailere, lastbiler, trailere og busser, så du skal være nysgerrig af natur, og parat til at lære nyt.

Du er nytænkende og løsningsorienteret, du tager en aktiv og deltagende rolle i teamet, og du ønsker et arbejde med fokus på salg og service til forretningens professionelle kunder.

Du trives med at yde dit bedste for forretningen, og at skabe ekstraordinære resultater i et team med fokus på udvikling af både Refako og dig som person.

Vi forventer at du:
• har erfaring fra reservedelsmarkedet eller tilsvarende.
• har flair for godt købmandskab.
• arbejder selvstændigt og behersker IT på brugerniveau.
• er udadvendt, smilende og mødesikker.

Dine opgaver bliver:
• betjening af såvel privat- som erhvervskunder.
• deltagelse i lagerarbejde og varekørsel.

Du kan forvente:
• en udfordrende stilling, hvor din indsats gør en synlig forskel.
• et fuldtidsjob i et firma, der lægger vægt på ordnede forhold.
• stor indflydelse på egen arbejdsdag.
• at blive en vigtig medarbejder i et tæt team af engagerede kolleger.

Vi er en virksomhed i konstant udvikling, hvor et godt arbejdsmiljø med medarbejderengagement og –udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi sætter en ære i at yde god service, ekspedition og rådgivning til alle vores kunder, og at klare en travl hverdag med et godt humør – det forventer vi også af dig.

Stillingen ønskes besat fra 1. september, men vi afholder samtaler løbende. Send din ansøgning og CV ”Ekspedient Hvidovre” til Thore Wegner på job@refako.dk

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We’re a team of 800+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: Appfire Flow, JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.

Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource-library/customer-stories

About the role:

Appfire is looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer to help evolve a modern, cloud-based SaaS platform. You’ll design new backend functionality, optimize existing services, and support systems used by thousands of tenants. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Engineering and works cross-functionally with product, UX, and frontend partners to deliver reliable, well-tested SaaS solutions.

You can choose to work remotely from anywhere in Poland.

What you’ll do:

  • Designing and implementing new functionalities while maintaining and optimizing existing ones.
  • Ensuring high code quality through rigorous testing (unit, integration) and peer code reviews.
  • Collaborating with Product Owners, UX/UI designers, and frontend teams.
  • Solving performance-related challenges to ensure system stability and speed.
  • Contributing to technical discussions and helping the team solve production issues.
  • Actively utilizing AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to boost daily productivity and participating in the technical implementation of AI-driven product features.

Technical Highlights:

  • Add your value to a complex yet well-designed application, having over 100 modules and fully-fledged Domain-Driven Design (ubiquitous language, aggregates, domain events etc.)
  • Practice your craftsmanship in good design (clean code, SOLID, Inversion of Control) and in various architectures (hexagonal, event-driven, pipes&filters, modular monoliths, microservices and more)
  • Thoroughly test what you build: with unit, integration and e2e tests (Spock, JUnit, Mockito, AssertJ, REST Assured, WireMock, Testcontainers, Cypress)
  • Learn our advanced cloud (SaaS) architecture: serving thousands of tenants (multitenant architecture), continuously monitored and profiled (ELK, async-profiler), and with state of the art release process (feature flags, canary releases). We use AWS and GCP. Help us advance our cloud architecture further
  • Practice other cool approaches and tools like reactive programming, Event Sourcing, Apache Kafka or Redis
  • Enhance your engineering workflow by adopting state-of-the-art AI tools for code generation, refactoring, and debugging, while working on cutting-edge AI integrations
  • Feel safe with our extensive CI process that automatically runs unit, integration, e2e, architecture, migration and performance tests on your commit

What you'll need:

  • Solid Java Foundation: Strong practical knowledge of Java, Spring, Hibernate, and SQL.
  • Clean Code & Patterns: A good understanding of SOLID principles and common design patterns to keep the codebase maintainable.
  • AI & Modern Tooling: Hands-on experience working with AI coding assistants (like Cursor) and an eagerness to implement modern AI solutions (e.g., LLM integrations, RAG) into the product.
  • Testing & Tools: Proficiency in JUnit/Spock, Git, Maven, and Docker.
  • Production-Ready Mindset: Experience in evolving and scaling established systems (beyond just greenfield projects) and a focus on long-term code maintainability.
  • Performance Awareness: Ability to use profiling tools and a focus on writing efficient code that performs well under load.
  • Cloud Basics: Understanding of SaaS architecture and cloud environments (AWS or GCP).

Beyond the resume skills that match our culture and this role:

  • You are dedicated to elevating client and co-worker experiences, knowing that exceptional work centers on serving others.
  • You adapt swiftly to new business demands, understanding that change fuels collective and individual growth.
  • You excel in communication, effectively connecting in remote/hybrid environments using tools like Slack, Zoom, and G Suite and through occasional in-person events.
  • You have exceptional coaching, mentoring, and people development skills.

What we offer:

  • Contract of Employment (indefinite)
  • Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
  • 26 paid vacation days annually, regardless of tenure, 12 Wellness Days (1 day per month, non-transferable), 24 hours of paid volunteer time to engage in meaningful activities outside of work.
  • Fully covered Luxmed private healthcare plan. You can extend coverage to your partner or opt for additional upgrades tailored to your needs. Life insurance provided by UNUM and fully paid by Appfire.
  • MyBenefit Platform - 150 PLN per month to spend on a Multisport card or on a variety of experiences such as shopping, restaurants, and entertainment.
  • Home Office Allowance - 200 PLN net per month added to your salary to support your electricity and internet costs while working remotely.
  • Lunch Card - 300 PLN monthly for groceries or dining out, available via a virtual pre-paid Pluxee card.

#LI-Remote

Market recognition

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

title: STYLIST & CONTENT CREATOR
description:
STYLIST & CONTENT CREATOR
VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF ET GLOBALT FASHION BRAND I EN RIVENDE UDVIKLING?

Er du stilsikker, passioneret omkring mode og dygtig til at skabe visuelt stærkt og engagerende content? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.
Til b.young søger vi en Stylist & Content Creator, der kombinerer kreativitet og kommerciel forståelse med struktur og et sikkert visuelt blik.
Du får ansvaret for vores e-commerce-skydninger og bliver samtidig en vigtig del af vores content- og kampagneproduktion.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant baggrund inden for mode, kommunikation, marketing eller multimediedesign – gennem uddannelse og praktisk erfaring.

Med sans for stil og blik for de små detaljer kan du omsætte trends til enkel, inspirerende styling, der rammer b.youngs målgruppe.
Samtidig er du nysgerrig på AI-billedgenerering og har lyst til at udforske teknologiens visuelle muligheder.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og trives i en afvekslende hverdag med styling og skydninger, kreativ contentproduktion samt planlægning, koordinering og analyse foran computeren. FAGLIGE KVALIFIKATIONER:
• Erfaring med styling, content creation og sociale medier
• Erfaring med planlægning og analyse af SoMe-kampagner
• Erfaring med influencersamarbejder og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
• Stærk kommerciel og visuel forståelse
• Interesse for mode, trends og visuel storytelling
• Evne til at planlægge, koordinere og bevare overblikket
• En positiv, energisk og samarbejdsorienteret tilgang
• Erfaring med Adobe-pakken er en fordel

VI TILBYDER:
• En spændende stilling i et dynamisk modehus med højt tempo og kreative udfordringer
• Et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø som en del af et stærkt marketing- og e-commerce-team
• Mulighed for at præge b.youngs visuelle identitet og storytelling på tværs af platforme
• Gode personalefordele og en arbejdsplads med fokus på fællesskab, kreativitet og udvikling

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bettina Schytt Therkelsen : tel 51 91 46 96

ARBEJDSSTED: Vejle
REJSEAKTIVITET: 20-25 dage årligt
TILTRÆDELSE: Snarest
ANSØGNINGSFRIST: 20.08.2026 men da vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, bedes du sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt til jobvejle@dkcompany.com – mærket ”Stylist & Content Creator - byoung”


DK Company Group er en dynamisk, vækstorienteret international virksomhed med passionerede medarbejdere, der ønsker at gøre en forskel. Mulighederne er mange i en gruppe med 26 mærker, 16.500 salgspunkter, 450 butikker samt e-handelsplatforme for alle mærker. Den årlige omsætning er 4,6 milliarder DKK. Koncernen har aktiviteter i Danmark, Norge, Sverige, Finland, Belgien, Holland, Tyskland, Storbritannien, Schweiz, Frankrig, Spanien, Canada, USA, Kina og repræsentation i Tyrkiet og Bangladesh. title: Brolægger til bundopbygning og belægning i Hvidovre
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og brolægning med styr på forarbejdet?

Vi mangler en brolægger til bundopbygning og stenlægning i Hvidovre.

Du lander i et anlægshold, hvor brolægning er en fast del af hverdagen. Kunderne er både private, virksomheder og entreprenører, så opgaverne skifter mellem indkørsler, stier og pladser. Arbejdet foregår i makkerpar og sjak, hvor bund, fald og finish skal passe sammen. Pladserne ligger omkring Hvidovre og København, og der er styr på planlægningen, så aftalerne kan holde.

Her betyder forarbejdet lige så meget som de sidste sten. Du får firmabil i jobbet, men hverdagen er stadig holdarbejde, hvor I løfter opgaven sammen. Det passer til dig, der tager ansvar for dit stykke af pladsen og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Det får du

Løn: 200-240 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Hvidovre og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Bundopbygning, stenlægning og sjakarbejde

Din hverdag

Du arbejder ud fra en aftalt rækkefølge på pladsen, hvor forarbejde, bund og fald skal sidde før stenene lægges. Når underlaget er klar, handler det om forbandt, linjer og en afslutning der kan holde til brug. Hvis noget skal koordineres, tager du det med sjakket, så arbejdet ikke stopper næste led.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Bygger bund op og gør forarbejdet klar
  • Lægger sten og arbejder med forbandt
  • Lægger fliser, sten og belægninger på indkørsler, stier og pladser
  • Sætter kantsten og trapper
  • Arbejder med chaussésten, granit og mønsterbelægning

Når noget ikke passer med fald, underlag eller tidsplan, siger du til i tide, så aftalerne kan holde. Så afleverer I belægningen ordentligt, og næste del af pladsen går ikke i stå.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som brolægger
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde i makkerpar og sjak
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både bundopbygning, stenlægning og forbandt. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan arbejde stabilt og få pladsen til at spille sammen med resten af holdet.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: ORO LINIJŲ ELEKTRIKĖ (-AS) REMONTO KOMANDOJE (KAUNAS)
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) Remonto komandoje Kaune. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už saugų ir užtikrintą elektros energijos tiekimą vartotojams. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame Tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart! #elektrikė #elektrikas

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Vykdant remonto ir techninės priežiūros darbus 0,4-10 kV elektros įrenginių objektuose;
  • Vykdant operatyvinį perjungimą elektros įrenginiuose 0,4-10 kV;

  • Gebėjimas skaityti ir suprasti elektrines principines schemas ir brėžinius;
  • Gebėjimas dirbti „MS Office“ pagrindinėmis programomis;
  • B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimas;
  • Atsakingumas, kruopštumas, orientacija į rezultatą, gebėjimas dirbti komandoje.

Privalumas būtų:

  • Darbų vykdytojo teisės VK elektrosaugos kategorija;
  • ​​​​​BE, C, CE kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimai.
  • Papildomų naudų paketą, kurį sudaro sveikatos draudimas ir sveikatinimosi išmoka;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Finansinį skatinimą už kandidatų rekomendavimą;
  • Modernią, aukščiausius saugumo reikalavimus atitinkančią darbo aplinką;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Profesionalią naujos kartos energetikų bendruomenę;
  • Vertybėmis grįstą lyderystę ir verslo sprendimus.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will be at the forefront of AI innovation, working with a diverse team to create intelligent, autonomous systems. Your role is pivotal in enhancing our products and services, ensuring they are at the cutting edge of technology. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, applying your expertise to develop and implement AI strategies that drive our business forward.

  • Document solution designs, technical decisions, best practices, and implementation guidelines to support scalable delivery and maintenance.

Must-Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree with experience in AI/ML engineering and solution development.
  • Strong experience in AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, and end-to-end AI solution delivery.
  • Deep understanding of RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, embeddings, and model evaluation techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, generative AI technologies, and agentic AI frameworks for building intelligent applications and orchestration workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including APIs, automation platforms, version control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and responsible AI principles related to governance, security, and privacy.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks.

  • orchestration frameworks for intelligent automation.

  • Designed and deployed cloud-based solutions on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud platforms.

  • Applied MLOps best practices for enterprise AI deployments and leveraged automation certifications to deliver scalable, reliable solutions.

title: Rides Guest Services Supervisor
description:
Job Description

Location: Niseko, Japan

Dates: November 2026 – April 2027 (exact dates TBC) - Seasonal, Full-time

Salary: From ¥1900 per hour

Reports to: Rides Guest Services Manager


About us:

Rhythm is about creating epic experiences for our customers, which starts with our people. We live by our values and put people first. We take pride in creating working and living environments that foster innovation, adventure, and balance. Working at Rhythm is more than a job, it's an experience you will have forever.

The Role:
Our Rides Guest Services team is key to giving our guests an epic experience – listening to each customer’s needs and goals and using deep product knowledge to recommend the best on-snow lesson or guiding experience.

As Guest Services Supervisor, you’ll own the day-of operation. This is a hands-on leadership role focused on running the live guest services shift each day – leading the team on the floor, keeping the line-up moving, and being the point of contact when things need a quick, confident decision. You set the standard, support and coach the team through the day, and hold the shift together from first line-up to last guest.

Key Responsibilities and Duties:
Day-of operations & shift leadership

  • Own and run the daily Guest Services operation – lead the shift, set the pace, and make sure every task is completed to a high standard.
  • Act as the on-the-day point of contact for the GS team, making confident decisions in the moment as situations arise.
  • Collaborate closely with the operations team to deliver a smooth daily line-up, ensuring every lesson begins on time and as expected.
  • Address and resolve escalated guest enquiries, concerns and complaints promptly and professionally, in line with our complaint management guidelines.
  • Approve refunds and other resolutions within agreed authority, escalating to a manager only where needed.

Team leadership & support

  • Supervise, support and coach the GS Assistants through the day, stepping in where needed and lifting the standard of every guest interaction.
  • Provide in-the-moment guidance and feedback, and help onboard and upskill team members across the season.

Customer service excellence

  • Personally handle the most complex or sensitive guest interactions with the highest level of professionalism and courtesy.
  • Support the GS Assistants with lesson enquiries received via email, phone, our booking system and in person at our booths in Rhythm Hirafu and Setsu.
  • Maintain deep, up-to-date knowledge of our products and services and ensure all booking processes are completed accurately.

Coordination & communication

  • Work closely with other Rides teams and the wider Rhythm departments to deliver a cohesive guest experience.
  • Be the communication bridge between the GS team and management – surface issues early and drive them to resolution.

What you need to succeed:

  • Previous team leadership or supervisory experience, ideally in guest services, snowsports or hospitality.
  • The ability to lead a team and hold a busy operation together under pressure, with sound judgement for in-the-moment decisions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a natural, upselling-friendly approach to customer service.
  • A solid understanding of skiing and snowboarding progression, so you can confidently coordinate the best experiences for our guests.
  • Excellent collaboration and attention to detail, alongside proficiency with Google Workspace.
  • A calm, solution-oriented mindset when resolving guest feedback and complaints.
  • Good knowledge of the local Niseko area is a bonus.

The Perks and Benefits:

As a Rhythm employee, you’ll experience the same legendary hospitality we extend to our guests. We’re passionate about looking after our crew, and here are just a few of the perks you’ll enjoy when you join our team:

  • Live, Work, and Play in Paradise: Immerse yourself in one of the world’s top mountain resorts.
  • Work with a Legendary Crew: Join a team that’s passionate, fun-loving, and deeply connected to the industry.
  • Subsidized Staff Accommodation: Affordable housing options and housing assistance to help you settle in.
  • Epic Social Scene: From team ride days and department dinners to staff parties, events, and day trips, our social calendar is packed with opportunities to connect and unwind.
  • Wellness and Lifestyle Benefits: Access the Rhythm Wellness program, enjoy free snowsports or bike demos, and take advantage of generous store discounts for you, your friends, and your family.

At Rhythm, we work hard, but we play even harder. If you know anyone who’s worked with us before, they’ll tell you this isn’t just a job- it’s an experience of a lifetime. Our fun, supportive culture is the heart of everything we do because people like you make Rhythm what it is.

title: Senior Associate Audit
description:
Zoek jij een uitdagende rol als Senior Associate Audit bij een accountantskantoor in Eindhoven? Als Senior Associate Audit bij Joanknecht werk je aan complexe controleopdrachten, begeleid je teamleden en bouw je aan je carrière binnen onze controlepraktijk. Met intensieve coaching en trainingen via de Joanknecht Academy blijf je jezelf continu ontwikkelen. Benieuwd hoe jouw groeipad bij Joanknecht eruitziet? Maak kennis met ons team in Eindhoven!

Een dag als Senior Associate Audit bij Joanknecht

Je start je dag met een teammeeting op kantoor in Eindhoven of vanuit huis. Samen met je collega’s bespreek je de planning en voortgang van de lopende opdrachten. Jij houdt overzicht, bewaakt de voortgang van jouw dossieronderdelen en stemt af wie welke werkzaamheden oppakt binnen het klantteam. Je begeleidt nieuwe collega’s on-the-job, beantwoordt vragen en geeft gerichte coaching en feedback op hun werkzaamheden.

Vervolgens werk je verder aan de controle. Afhankelijk van de planning ben je bij de klant op locatie of werk je vanuit kantoor of thuis. Je vraagt gericht informatie op, zoals onderbouwingen van balansposten, contracten en procesbeschrijvingen, en voert gesprekken met medewerkers om processen en interne beheersing goed te doorgronden. Je pakt zelfstandig complexere controlewerkzaamheden op en signaleert tijdig bijzonderheden of inconsistenties, zodat het team snel kan bijsturen.

Later op de dag werk je aan het controledossier en review je de werkzaamheden van (junior) collega’s. Je toetst of documentatie compleet is, of conclusies logisch en goed onderbouwd zijn en je geeft duidelijke, coachende feedback. Zo help je collega’s zich verder te ontwikkelen en borg je de kwaliteit van het dossier.

Tot slot maak je ruimte voor je eigen ontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld met een training via de Joanknecht Academy over verdieping in controleaanpak of verslaggeving, of skills rondom begeleiding en klantcommunicatie. Aan het einde van de dag heb je niet alleen waarde geleverd aan de klant, maar ook het team verder geholpen in kwaliteit en groei.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Binnen twee jaar kun je doorgroeien naar Junior Manager Audit, waarin je jezelf verder kunt specialiseren en (nog) meer leuke en uitdagende verantwoordelijkheden krijgt.

  • Toegang tot de Joanknecht Academy voor workshops, specialistische trainingen en opleidingen bij hogescholen en universiteiten.

  • Je werkt voor een breed klantenbestand in de Brainport regio, van familiebedrijven tot internationale organisaties.

  • De mogelijkheid om tijdens werktijd als vrijwilliger bij te dragen aan maatschappelijke projecten via de Joanknecht Foundation.

  • De ruimte om met eigen ideeën te komen en deel te nemen aan projecten buiten je vakgebied.

  • De kans om multidisciplinair te werken en als business partner van je klant te fungeren.

  • Flexibele werktijden en de optie om hybride te werken, zodat je zelf je werkplek en -tijd bepaalt.

  • Een parttime of fulltime dienstverband (24-40 uur per week).

  • Een marktconform salaris, 29 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband), goede pensioenregeling, keuze tussen mobiliteitsbudget of leaseauto en een leasefiets, maandelijkse massages, en elke dag verse lunch en fruit op kantoor.

Dit neem je mee

  • Een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding in de richting van Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Finance & Control of andere relevante opleidingen en minimaal twee jaar werkervaring in de audit of een soortgelijke functie.

  • Je bent bij voorkeur bezig met (voorbereiding op) een studie om registeraccountant (RA) te worden of je wil hiermee gaan starten.

  • Je bent een teamspeler en haalt energie uit (multidisciplinair) samenwerken.

  • Motivatie om persoonlijk en inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Resultaatgerichtheid en het vermogen om doelen effectief te realiseren.

Leer onze mensen kennen!

Ons Assurance team bestaat uit zo’n 40 collega’s met diverse ervaringsniveaus, van werkstudent tot ervaren accountant, inclusief onze collega’s in Zuid-Afrika. Bij Joanknecht houden we van teamwork én gezelligheid. Van koffiemomenten tot onze vrijdagmiddagborrel in de lounge, dus je leert je collega’s snel kennen! Lees ook onze medewerkersverhalen om te zien hoe het is om deel uit te maken van ons team.

Maak het verschil bij Joanknecht

Klaar om je carrière een kickstart te geven? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt groeien bij Joanknecht. Liever eerst kennismaken? Kom langs voor een kop koffie en ervaar onze werksfeer! Graag ontmoeten we je om te bespreken hoe we samen verder kunnen bouwen aan de toekomst van Joanknecht en haar klanten! Nog vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze recruiters om de mogelijkheden te bespreken, via werkenbij@joanknecht.nl of 040 844 7000!

Een online assessment en een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) maken deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Het assessment meet je werkstijl en relevante competenties voor deze functie en je verdere loopbaan.

title: Interim Hoofd HR Specialismen - grote publieke organisatie - Zuid Holland
description:

  • Adviseren van directie en management over complexe HR-thema’s.

Duur van de opdracht: 6 maanden, met optie tot verlenging.

Stuur ons dan zo spoedig mogelijk je CV met contactgegevens en beschikbaarheid. Een motivatiebrief is welkom, maar niet verplicht. We laten je daarna snel weten hoe we jouw interesse in deze interim opdracht verder oppakken. Je kunt hiertoe de sollicitatiebutton gebruiken op deze pagina.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kun je contact opnemen met Judith Schoorlemmer, Managing Consultant Interim Management, (06) 26923481 of j.schoorlemmer@berenschot.nl

title: Adviseur geohydrologie
description:
De toekomst vraagt om creatieve breinen en slimme oplossingen

‘Bij de business unit Water werken we met 100 professionals aan dé wateropgaven in Nederland. Hiervoor benutten we aanwezige kennis en ervaring of ontwikkelen we onze eigen tools. Wij creëren duurzame wateroplossingen die bijdragen aan schoon water, gezonde ecosystemen en een leefomgeving waarin mensen kunnen wonen, werken en floreren — want elk stukje telt voor de wereld van morgen. Wil jij werken in een dynamische en kennis gedreven projectenorganisatie? Stuur dan een reactie. Ik maak graag kennis met je!’

— Wilmer Noome – teammanager Water


Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van 24.000 collega’s met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Binnen de business unit Water werken wij aan de brede opgaven voor klimaat, natuur, verdroging, energietransitie en waterbeschikbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van een business unit waar we met een hecht team van geohydrologen, hydrologen en ecologen werken aan projecten voor onder meer overheden, drinkwaterbedrijven en ontwikkelaars. Denk aan vraagstukken rond natuurherstel, waterbeschikbaarheid, impactanalyses en klimaatadaptatie in zowel stedelijke als landelijke gebieden. Door jouw inzet kan Nederland op een robuuste manier blijven groeien en zorgen we tegelijkertijd voor schoon water, gezonde ecosystemen en leefomgeving. In deze functie werk je mee aan projecten zoals de vervangingsopgave van de Amsterdamse kades (Kade2.020), aan het vergroten van zand- en grindwinputten en een bemalingsadvies in Monster.

Als adviseur geohydrologie werk je aan uiteenlopende grondwatervraagstukken binnen zowel stedelijke als regionale projecten. Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en interesses adviseer je opdrachtgevers over vraagstukken zoals grondwateroverlast, droogte, bemalingen en de ontwikkeling van duurzame watersystemen, of ontwikkel en optimaliseer je grondwatermodellen die inzicht geven in complexe geohydrologische processen. Je analyseert data, voert modelberekeningen en kalibraties uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar praktische en onderbouwde adviezen. Daarbij bepaal je bijvoorbeeld haalbare oplossingen voor grondwateroverlast in stedelijk gebied, onderzoek je welke bemaling nodig is voor civiele projecten of analyseer je de effecten van ingrepen op het grondwatersysteem. Je verdiept je in het functioneren van bodem en watersysteem en zorgt ervoor dat grondwatermodellen aansluiten op de projectdoelstellingen, de praktijk én de wensen van de opdrachtgever. Je werkt nauw samen met hydrologen, ecologen, civieltechnische collega's en andere disciplines binnen integrale projecten en bent een belangrijke gesprekspartner voor opdrachtgevers en stakeholders. Je presenteert onderzoeksresultaten op een heldere en overtuigende manier en vertaalt complexe technische analyses naar begrijpelijke inzichten waarmee opdrachtgevers weloverwogen keuzes kunnen maken. De uitdaging ligt in het combineren van diepgaande vakinhoudelijke kennis met praktische en toekomstbestendige oplossingen die bijdragen aan een klimaatbestendige, veilige en duurzame inrichting van Nederland.

Voor beide specialisaties binnen geohydrologie zoeken we iemand die communicatief vaardig is en in staat is om oplossingen helder en begrijpelijk uit te leggen, waardoor klanten zich betrokken en goed geïnformeerd voelen, en worden meegenomen in de mogelijkheden en keuzes. Bij Sweco krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Via de Sweco Academie, interne vakgroepen en samenwerking met experts uit het hele land blijf je continu leren en groeien. Sweco onderscheidt zich door multidisciplinair samenwerken, innovatie en digitalisering. We pakken grote projecten binnenshuis op waarbij de focus ligt op lokaal werken. We werken met een hands-on aanpak in een snel wisselende omgeving en projecten. Naast uitdagende projecten bieden we je een omgeving met veel kennisdeling, vakinhoudelijke sessies en ruimte voor gezelligheid. Spreekt jou dit aan? Reageer dan en kom in gesprek met ons.

[sweco-recruitee-vacancy-summary]

Dit is wat we jou bieden

Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Om te beginnen ontvang je een goed salaris en maar liefst 32 vakantiedagen. Daarnaast bieden we een thuiswerkvergoeding, vakantietoeslag, een circulaire thuiswerkplek en een uitzonderlijk goede pensioenregeling.


Daarnaast krijg je bij Sweco veel regie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Over hoeveel je werkt, waar je werkt, hoe je werkt en wanneer je werkt. Binnen ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket heb je de keuze om te kiezen op welke manier jij reist. We stimuleren duurzame en actieve keuzes en belonen deze extra. Ook krijg je direct toegang tot onze eigen AI-omgeving SwecoGPT, tot de Sweco Academy voor zeer ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden, en tot ons vitaliteitsprogramma gericht op leefstijl en sport.

Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan een tweedaags event voor alle nieuwe collega’s, de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, en activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en de lokale personeelsverenigingen.

Solliciteer op deze functie

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie!

Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Wilmer Noome, teammanager Water via +31 6 30 54 42 42 of

wilmer.noome@sweco.nl.

Vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je stellen aan Kirsty Bushoff, via 06-57029598 of kirsty.bushoff@sweco.nl.

**Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs**

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding richting civiele techniek, fysische geografie, (geo)hydrologie of watermanagement met affiniteit met grondwater

  • Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring

  • Vakinhoudelijk gedreven en communicatief vaardig; je bent immers hét visitekaartje van Sweco bij de klant en denkt echt met de klant mee

  • Een hands-on aanpak en flexibiliteit in projecten, proactief en nieuwsgierig

  • Volledig vaardig in de Nederlandse taal (mondeling en schriftelijk), minimaal C1 niveau

title: Healthcare Quality & Regulatory Advisor
description:
Position Summary

This position play a critical role in driving compliance and quality programs for Healthcare Transportation & Facilities and supporting the Healthcare Quality Management System to ensure processes and systems are compliant with regional and local regulations and customer requirements.

Job Scope

1. Quality Policies & Procedures: Determine, implement & promote policies and procedures for company’s Network and facilities (hubs & stations) to ensure compliance to standards such as GDP, GCP and others.

2. Quality Assessment & Standards: Write & review SOPs and Work Instructions for transportation & fulfilment solutions pertaining to the healthcare industry.

3. Compliance & Quality Program Management: Implement compliance and quality programs to support local Quality teams to ensure they are kept up-to-date and prepared.

4. CAPA Process Management: Lead in process creation and review of documentation on the implementation and responses to corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and monitor action progress until closure.

5. Healthcare Quality Management System: Develop, implement & support the system and processes, develop corresponding training programs, and acts as Super User for eQMS system.

6. Internal Audit Programs: Design & implement robust internal audit processes to ensure readiness of various functions & processes when meeting regulatory agencies & customer audits.

7. Certification Audits: Lead various certification audits with relevant regulatory agencies and certification providers across the region.

8. Operations & Customer Audit Programs: Lead & prepare for regular audit programs / random checks / regulatory activities to achieve successful audit outcomes and proper post audit follow up actions.

9. Healthcare Customer Liaison: Liaise with customers to understand quality requirements / issues / underlying concerns to advise on the way forward, provide advice based on interpretations as applicable to 3PL and resolve issues via conducting root cause analysis.

10. Healthcare Quality Feedback: Liaise, consolidate feedback from different functions to update and prepare final copy for Quality Questionnaires, Agreements and RFQ Proposals for customers.

11. Validation Programs: Lead the validation of transportation lanes and critical equipment like cold chain facilities, and packaging systems.

12. Depot Support: Provide secondary / backup support to healthcare specialists for market depots.

Requirements :

1. Hold local pharmacist license

2. Have at least 5 -7 years of relevant experience in warehouse, quality + QMS for pharmaceutical / healthcare industry in quality related role

3. Experience working in warehouse is desire

4. Have competencies in quality assurance / regulatory affairs, customer relationship management and root cause analysis

5. Have working experience ensuring compliance in accordance to Goods Manufacturing Practise cGMP,)/, Good Clinical Practises cGCP, Goods Distribution Practice (GDP) & ISO13485 for Medical Devices,

6. Experience in local certifications in a warehouse and transportation business.

7. IATA CEIV certification knowledge would be at advantage but not necessary.

8. Experience in conducting external and internal audits for regions

9. Must hold at least Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy from a reputable local institute in Singapore.

10. Occasionally travel is required to sites and region warehouses.

Competency

1. Accuracy & attention to detail which is crucial to proper compliance to regulatory and standards

2. Problem-solving skills to support customer issue resolution

3. Planning & organization skills to ensure proper audit programs are managed effectively

4. Communication skills to facilitate engagements with customer and regulatory agencies

5. Project management capabilities and familiarity with Process Mapping, Six Sigma, Lean Methodology, Agile or Design Thinking

6. Apply data-driven decision making with the use of data analytics and visualization tools like Power BI and competency in Microsoft Office applications like Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

Mon to Fri 9am-6pm

title: Tømrer til nybyg på erhvervsbyggeri i København
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast makker og nybyg på erhvervsbyggeri?

Vi mangler en tømrer til erhvervsbyggeri i København.

Du lander i en mindre tømrerflok, hvor arbejdet ligger på erhvervsbyggeri i København og omegn. Her handler det om nybyg, og du arbejder som udgangspunkt med makker, så du ikke står alene med opgaverne. Det er et setup for dig, der gerne vil have faste rammer uden at hverdagen bliver tung.

Firmabilen er med, og rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil møde ind til noget der er til at regne med. Tonen skal også være ordentlig, for mottoet er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Du får et job hvor du kan tage fat, bygge nyt og have en makker tæt på.

Det får du

Løn: Kan forhandles

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: København og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, erhvervsbyggeri og makkerpar

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om nybyg, hvor I arbejder jer igennem de aftalte tømreropgaver på pladsen. Du og din makker fordeler arbejdet imellem jer og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Udfører tømrerarbejde på nybyg og erhvervsbyggeri
  • Monterer vinduer og døre efter mål
  • Arbejder med tagarbejde på relevante byggesager
  • Lægger isolering og dampspærre

Hvis rækkefølgen ændrer sig i løbet af dagen, tager du det med makkeren og får arbejdet videre. Det skal være til at arbejde ordentligt sammen, også når der er tryk på.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som tømrer
  • Kan arbejde i makkerpar uden at gøre tingene tunge
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Kan tage fat på nybyg og erhvervsbyggeri
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet på erhvervsbyggeri før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan gå ind i et makkerpar og levere ordentligt tømrerarbejde.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

📈Check out the development opportunities in the Collections team.

📍 Manchester | 🏢 3 days in office, 2 from home (Fully office-based for the first 3 months)

⏰ Shifts - 37.5 hours per week Monday - Friday between 8am - 8pm.

Collections & Customer Operations 🚀
As our business continues to scale, our Collections team plays a key role in supporting good customer outcomes. This role sits at the heart of Customer Operations, combining data analytics with operational improvement to keep our collections practices efficient, compliant, and evolving.

What You'll Be Doing 🗃️

  • Build and maintain reporting on key collections metrics, including repayment and recovery rates and team performance, turning results into clear insights for senior stakeholders.
  • Review and improve how we manage collections and help customers who are struggling, balancing consistent recovery performance with fair customer outcomes.
  • Review how the team currently operates, identify where processes slow down, and help shape improvements that make the department more effective.
  • Build detailed knowledge of our data and systems, resolving data issues to keep reporting accurate, and act as the main point of contact for external suppliers.
  • Represent the department's priorities, ensuring fair treatment of customers and full compliance with FCA rules and company policy.

We're Looking For 🔎

  • A track record in a data, analytics, or strategy role within financial services, with solid knowledge of the sector's demands.
  • A good grasp of end-to-end collections processes, debt recovery mechanics, and strategy optimisation, with the skills to help bring about real improvement.
  • Proficient SQL skills, able to extract, manipulate, and interpret datasets to uncover meaningful insights with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent ability to interpret data and write clear reports, turning complex trends into compelling findings for any audience.
  • Sharp attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Diversity & Inclusion 🌈
We welcome, consider, and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks
We believe in balancing hard work with a bit of fun, so our office is designed for both productivity and play. From a pool table and PlayStation to a few office dogs roaming around, we’ve created a space where you can relax and recharge. Check out the perks we offer:

💷 Salary range £35,000 - £40,000 depending on experience

🎁 Anniversary Rewards (£250, £500, £750, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

📖 Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
👪 Enhanced Parental Leave
🚲 Cycle to Work Scheme

🍫 Free drinks and snacks in our offices

title: Vehicle Hardware & Software Technician
description:

● Perform routine vehicle inspections, diagnostics, and maintenance

● Troubleshoot issues across mechanical, electrical, and basic software-facing systems

● Support hardware and software retrofit activity as needed

● Automotive or electromechanical technician foundation

● Clear documentation habits and attention to detail

● Strong communication skills

● Safe work practices and sound operational judgment

● Travel availability

Preferred Qualifications

The following are valuable, but should not prevent hiring if the minimum baseline is met:

● ASE or OEM technician certifications

● ADAS or sensor calibration experience

● Exposure to LiDAR, radar, cameras, or embedded computer systems

● EV, AV, depot, fleet, or R&D vehicle experience

● Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Jira, Google Suite, or similar systems

● Experience supporting vehicle retrofits, updates, or field issue resolution

  • Travel availability
