title: Ombudsman, Banking and Finance (Small Business & Transactions)
description:
AFCA’s Banking & Finance (Small Business and Transactions) team is looking for an Ombudsman to join its team. The Small Business & Transactions team and the Banking & Finance team form part of AFCA’s broader banking team. The Small Business & Transactions team focusses on complaints involving small business (e.g. loans, merchant payments and general banking relationship) and also complaints involving banking and payment transactions more generally (e.g. scams, account restrictions and closures, recalls, recharges, KYC questions), across consumer and small business accounts and payments services.

We are looking for an Ombudsman to join our busy and collegiate decision-making team to help resolve standard and complex banking and finance disputes, with a focus on either small business or transactions related issues. The Small Business & Transactions team is managed by Lead Ombudsman, Suanne Russell, and this role reports to a Senior Ombudsman in the team.

The role will would suit senior legally qualified professionals with a strong track record of significant achievement and particularly with a background in the banking and finance sector. You are likely to be at a stage of your career where you have an interest in using your well-developed skills and experience in a role which contributes to good community outcomes in the banking and finance sector.

Your role will be to make decisions, individually or as part of a panel, on standard and complex complaints in accordance with the AFCA rules and fairness principles. The decisions are likely to make a real difference and influence the banking and finance industry as they are binding on them when accepted by the complainant.

You will also have the opportunity to provide professional and technical leadership across AFCA and to coach and mentor Adjudicators, case workers and others. There may also be opportunities to develop AFCA approaches, and to present at external conferences as a subject matter expert. The role also involves supporting AFCA’s relationships with small business and consumer groups, government bodies, regulators, AFCA members, member organisations and other Ombudsman networks.

This is a Board appointed role.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Legal qualifications and a significant track record of achievement at senior executive level within the banking and finance industry or a tribunal, EDR scheme, regulatory agency or related business entity or in private practice
  • Strong analytical skills, the ability to quickly get to the heart of complex issues and to efficiently and independently handle a busy caseload, with a clear outcomes focus
  • A demonstrated high level of written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with a wide cross-section of the insurance sector and the broader community.
  • Resilience, focus, determination and excellent engagement skills and the ability to effectively manage challenges, external criticism and public scrutiny.
  • Silver AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

title: EY-Parthenon - Senior Associate, Software Strategy Group
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our Software Strategy Group (SSG)

operates within EY’s Strategy & Execution (S&E) practice – EY’s market leading team delivering technology, operations, and financial advisory services to corporate and private equity clients pursuing acquisitions, divestitures, or business restructurings. The S&E team brings together specialists across commercial, operations, software, technology, cyber, finance, and deal execution, drawing on deep experience from industry, advisory, and audit.

SSG provides top-tier product and technology diligence, strategic guidance, and transaction advisory. Each year, we help hundreds of companies and investors evaluate product architectures, enterprise technology environments, and technical teams to inform critical investment decisions. In every engagement, you will interact directly with the target company’s CTO / CIO and broader management team, learning how real decisions are made and how mature tech organizations operate.

Key strategic focus areas include:

  • Product & Technology: Providing investment and acquisition guidance across commercial, product, and technical dimensions to assess software businesses or companies leveraging proprietary technology.
  • Enterprise Technology: Evaluating technology risks and opportunities across operating models – including IT organizations, enterprise systems, infrastructure (server, storage, network, cloud), data, spend, strategy, and governance.
  • Cybersecurity: Assessing how cyber considerations intersect with business operations, regulatory requirements, and critical assets using our proprietary tools, benchmarks, and operational understanding.

SSG has completed hundreds of successful engagements, offering a unique capability to help clients make confident strategic decisions and execute transactions with clarity and conviction.

The opportunity

We are expanding our Singapore team and seeking a Senior Associate who can evaluate how technology is architected, deployed, and leveraged within a target business – while applying a critical, deal‑focused lens to address core client questions in transactions. You will advise clients across sectors, support executive decision makers, and lead engagement workstreams across pre‑deal software and technology due diligence, carve‑outs and integrations, and portfolio value assessments.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver end-to-end technology due diligence across a target’s technology landscape - including proprietary software, enterprise technology, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and delivery capability – identifying key risks, value drivers, investment needs, and operational implications.
  • Evaluate proprietary software and product technology, assessing feature set, roadmap, architecture, R&D processes, development practices, scalability, security posture, technical debt, and team capabilities to determine the product’s ability to support future growth and investment.
  • Advise on technology and cybersecurity in separations and integrations, from pre‑sign to post‑close – mapping dependencies in carve‑outs, identifying integration synergies, shaping Day‑1 readiness, defining interim and target-state operating models, assessing execution risks, and guiding TSA structures and readiness.
  • Conduct rapid value‑creation diagnostics, identifying operational bottlenecks, performance gaps, and cost‑optimization opportunities, and developing actionable plans to accelerate benefit capture.

To qualify for the role, you should have,

  • Basic or strong understanding of modern software concepts (e.g., software development lifecycle, product management, cloud infrastructure, software architecture, APIs, data platforms, etc.), enterprise IT environments (ERPs, CRMs, HRISs, etc.), and cybersecurity principles.
  • Demonstrated experience analysing complex business or technical problems and synthesizing insights for senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to apply a commercial and deal‑focused mindset to assess technology risks, investment needs, operating models, and scalability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technology topics clearly to non‑technical executives (CIO/CTO/CEO, investors, deal teams).
  • A self‑starter mindset with a commitment to learning, continuous improvement, and delivering exceptional client service

Ideally, you’ll also have,

  • A bachelor’s or higher degree in Business Administration, Economics, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related fieldsTransactions / M&A experience.
  • Client facing experience from a professional services background

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Audit Associate (Food and Beverages)
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Audit Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the Internal Audit Department by assisting in audit documentation, data gathering, report preparation, monitoring, and store audit operations. The role supports the conduct of audits across Fredley Group of Companies’ various stores and departments by ensuring accurate records, proper documentation, compliance with company policies, and timely follow-up on audit findings and recommendations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Store Audit Operations

  • Assist in conducting regular and surprise audits of company stores and other business units.
  • Review store operations and compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Assist in checking cash handling, sales transactions, POS records, deposits, and other financial documents.
  • Assist in conducting inventory counts and checking inventory records against actual stock levels.
  • Review store documents, reports, and supporting records for completeness and accuracy.
  • Identify discrepancies, irregularities, control weaknesses, and non-compliance during audit activities.
  • Document audit findings and prepare reports for review by the Audit Team.
  • Conduct follow-up audits or verification of corrective actions implemented by stores.
  • Coordinate with store personnel and Operations teams regarding audit requirements and findings.
  • Travel to different store locations as required for audit activities.

Audit Administrative Support

  • Assist in the preparation and organization of audit schedules, working papers, checklists, and other audit-related documents.
  • Maintain accurate and organized audit files and records.
  • Encode, consolidate, and monitor audit findings, observations, and recommendations.
  • Assist in preparing audit reports, presentations, and other documentation required by the Audit Team.
  • Ensure that audit documents are complete, properly filed, and readily accessible.

Data Gathering and Monitoring

  • Collect and consolidate data and supporting documents from various departments and branches.
  • Assist in monitoring compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Track the status of audit findings and recommendations and follow up with concerned departments or stores.
  • Maintain monitoring reports, trackers, and audit databases.
  • Assist in identifying discrepancies or incomplete documentation for further review by the Audit Team.

Coordination and Communication

  • Coordinate with store operations, Head Office departments, and other concerned personnel regarding audit requirements and documentation.
  • Assist in scheduling audit activities, meetings, and follow-up discussions.
  • Communicate audit-related requests and reminders in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support the Audit Team in coordinating the submission of required documents and reports.

General Administrative Support

  • Provide administrative assistance to the Internal Audit Department.
  • Prepare meeting minutes, presentations, reports, and other documents as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality of audit records, company information, and other sensitive documents.
  • Perform other related tasks and responsibilities that may be assigned by the immediate supervisor.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Internal Audit, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience in audit, accounting, administrative, inventory, or store operations is an advantage.
  • FRESH GRADUATES WITH RELEVANT INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCE ARE WELCOME.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • Detail-oriented with good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Able to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Willing to conduct store visits and travel to different locations as required.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced, multi-branch food and beverage environment.

Why choose us?

We are one of the promising companies in the Philippines with different awards & recognitions. We are offering our employees these perks and benefits as follows:

  • Government Mandated Benefits
  • Pay Raise
  • 13th Month Pay
  • Holiday pay
  • Overtime pay
  • Night differential
  • Promotion

Job Summary:

The Backend Operator is responsible for performing post-processing and finishing operations for PVD sputtering targets and evaporation materials. This role supports manufacturing activities including ultrasonic cleaning, sand blasting, laser peening, surface preparation, inspection, packaging, and material handling to ensure products meet quality, cleanliness, and customer specifications.

The Operator is safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and capable of following standardized work instructions in a precision manufacturing environment.

  • Perform backend manufacturing processes for sputtering targets, evaporation materials, and related components.

  • Execute ultrasonic cleaning operations following approved cleaning procedures and contamination control requirements.

  • Operate sand blasting equipment to achieve specified surface finish, roughness, and preparation requirements.

  • Perform laser peening processes according to work instructions and process specifications.

  • Conduct visual inspection of products before and after processing to identify defects, contamination, or damage.

  • Perform deburring, polishing, and final cleaning operations where applicable.

  • Ensure products meet dimensional, appearance, and cleanliness requirements before pass to final QC inspection.

  • Operate manufacturing equipment safely and efficiently.

  • Perform routine equipment setup, startup, shutdown, and cleaning activities.

  • Follow manufacturing work instructions, SOPs, and quality procedures.

  • Complete production records, process logs, and inspection documentation accurately.

  • Verify job travelers, batch records, and production paperwork before processing materials.

  • Support in-process inspections and quality audits.

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) policies and procedures.

  • Use required personal protective equipment (PPE) when handling chemicals, blasting media, and manufacturing equipment.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work area using 5S principles.

  • Participate in safety training and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements:

  • Diploma, NITEC, Higher NITEC, Technical Certificate, or equivalent vocational qualification.

  • Secondary school education with relevant manufacturing experience may also be considered.

  • 1–3 years of manufacturing or production experience preferred.

  • Experience in metal processing, semiconductor materials, precision manufacturing, vacuum coating materials, or surface treatment operations is an advantage.

  • Experience operating ultrasonic cleaning, blasting equipment, or laser processing systems is preferred.

  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required to effectively communicate and collaborate with China-based stakeholders.

title: Ping Identity/LDAP Administrator
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Directory Operations & Administration

  • Configure, tune, and maintain LDAP infrastructure (e.g., PingDirectory) to optimize replication, synchronization, and data integrity across regions.
  • Manage directory schemas, object classes, attributes, tree structures, and Access Control Instructions (ACIs).
  • Lead or support lift-and-shift initiatives to migrate legacy LDAP/Ping architectures to cloud providers like AWS or Azure. [1, 2, 3]

2. Access Management & Federation

  • Administer PingFederate and PingAccess environments, including custom adapters and policy management.
  • Configure and troubleshoot SSO integrations using federation protocols such as SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC (OpenID Connect), and WS-Federation.
  • Manage API security rules, authentication schemes, and authorization frameworks for internal and SaaS applications. [1, 2, 3]

3. Automation & Support

  • Write and maintain automation scripts (using Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to streamline administrative tasks.
  • Monitor audit trails, logs, and security events to diagnose and resolve complex federation and replication issues.
  • Handle SSL/TLS certificate management and ensure compliance with enterprise security policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Core Tools: Hands-on experience with Ping Identity stack (PingFederate, PingDirectory, PingAccess).
  • Directory Knowledge: Deep expertise in LDAP database management, replication, and indexing strategies.
  • Protocols: Strong command of SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and general networking protocols.
  • Environment: Proficiency in both Linux/Unix and Windows Server administration.
  • Scripting: Basic to intermediate level in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud Experience: Experience managing IAM infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization: Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Certifications: Ping Identity Certified Professional (PICP) or Ping Identity Certified Expert (PICE).

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

From planning and initiation to execution and close-out, you’ll help keep projects on track, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

Procurement & Logistics Support

Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Support the use of digital collaboration tools (Office 365, SharePoint, NetSuite) across the team.

Who You Are

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Google Cloud Consulting - Singapore
description:
Product area

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Job description

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

Qualifications

Job responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interface (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for engineering teams. Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience taking production-grade Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions from conception to launch for customers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions.
  • Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Processtærke akademikere med politisk forståelse og stærke samarbejdsevner søges til Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriets departement
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde i et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø og løse centrale samfundsopgaver på et område, der er genstand for stor politisk interesse og mediebevågenhed? Så har du nu muligheden for at blive en del af holdet i kontorerne Internationalt Migrationssamarbejde eller International Arbejdskraft og EU-ophold.



Velkommen til Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriets departement
I Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet beskæftiger vi os med spørgsmål som:

  • Hvem må indrejse og opholde sig i landet?
  • Hvordan sikrer vi, at udlændinge bidrager til og tager del i samfundet?
  • Hvordan sikrer vi, at personer uden lovligt ophold forlader landet?
Dette er vigtige spørgsmål, som alle lande skal forholde sig til – og det er netop vores kerneopgaver.

Du kan læse mere om vores kerneopgaver og vores ministerium her: https://uim.dk/

Vi er i alt ca. 250 medarbejdere, som ser frem til at byde dig velkommen til en hverdag præget af høj faglighed, stort engagement, masser af sparring og et godt socialt miljø.



Om International Migrationssamarbejde

Kontoret beskæftiger sig med det internationale samarbejde på migrationsområdet - særligt det europæiske Schengen- og asylsamarbejde, herunder bl.a. grænser, visum, tilbagesendelse og asyl. Derudover er Migrationstaskforcen forankret i kontoret, som i samarbejde med Udenrigsministeriet, har ansvaret for opgaver relateret til indfrielsen af ambitionen om nye løsninger inden for asylsystemet. Du vil få en væsentlig rolle i det fortsatte arbejde hermed.

Som en del af Migrationstaskforcen i Internationalt Migrationssamarbejde vil dine arbejdsopgaver bl.a. kunne omfatte:

  • Planlægning, koordinering samt deltagelse i rejser på såvel minister- som embedsmandsniveau
  • Forberedelse og afvikling af møder og større arrangementer på såvel minister- som embedsmandsniveau
  • Udarbejdelse af juridiske og praktiske udredninger
  • Er fleksibel og serviceminded
  • Varetagelse en bred kontaktflade og sikre et godt samarbejde med andre relevante lande og internationale samarbejdspartnere.
Alt med det formål, at bidrage til at fremme mulighederne for regeringens ønske om at etablere udrejse- og modtagecentre i tredjelande.

Til denne stilling må der forventes en del rejseaktivitet ligesom gode sprogkundskaber vil være en fordel.



Om International Arbejdskraft og EU-ophold

I kontoret for International Arbejdskraft og EU-ophold understøtter og udvikler vi politik på udlændingeområdet. Kontoret har ansvaret for bl.a. udlændingelovens regler om international arbejdskraft og internationale studerende fra lande udenfor EU. Det omfatter de opholdsordninger, som giver bl.a. kvalificerede internationale arbejdstagere adgang til det danske arbejdsmarked, samt regler for studerendes adgang til Danmark, herunder sundhedspersoner, praktikanter og au pair-personer. Hertil kommer reglerne om myndighedernes adgang til løbende kontrol af betingelserne for ophold og arbejde.

Kontoret har herudover ansvaret for EU-reglerne om personers fri bevægelighed, familiesammenføring på grundlag af unionsborgerskabet, associeringsaftalen mellem EU og Tyrkiet, samt udtrædelsesaftalen, hvor vi bl.a. varetager danske interesser i retssager anlagt ved EU-Domstolen og sikrer den løbende implementering i dansk ret.

Som en del af International Arbejdskraft og EU-ophold vil dine arbejdsopgaver omfatte klassisk ministerbetjening, som bl.a. indebærer, at sagerne skal udgøre et godt beslutningsgrundlag og være skåret rigtigt til politisk. Derudover kan opgaverne bestå i at koordinere og udarbejde politiske udspil, lovforslag, bekendtgørelser, svar til Folketinget mv. samt betjening af minister og departementschef i relation til regeringssager, møder og lignende. Opgaverne i kontoret er præget af en analytisk tilgang, hvor mulige løsninger bidrager til at sikre den fortsatte udvikling af opholdsordningerne med udgangspunkt i de politiske tendenser på området og arbejdsmarkedets behov.



Om dig
Du har en relevant samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, f.eks. cand.scient.pol., cand.jur. eller lignende, og har stærke analytiske kompetencer samt erfaring med at arbejde i en politisk styret organisation.

Du bliver en del af et politisk miljø, hvor høj faglighed og samarbejde på tværs er i højsædet, og hvor vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gode formidlingsevner - både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Har høj arbejdskapacitet, er processtærkt og trives med mange arbejdsopgaver og tidsfrister
  • Arbejder effektivt, analytisk og struktureret og leverer høj kvalitet i dit arbejde – også når det skal gå stærkt
  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for egne opgaver
  • Trives i en politisk styret organisation, har et godt overblik og kan håndtere skiftende prioriteringer og deadlines
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og har flair for at opbygge netværk og relationer
  • Er robust og kan agere i en hverdag med mange aktører på et område med stor politisk interesse og mediebevågenhed
  • Har en positiv indstilling, er omgængelig og bidrager til en god stemning på arbejdspladsen.


Yderligere information

Har du spørgsmål i øvrigt, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef i Internationalt Migrationssamarbejde Louise Berth Andersen på tlf. 61 98 33 20 eller kontorchef i International Arbejdskraft og EU-ophold Charlotte Barslev på tlf. 61 98 34 67.



Er du vores nye kollega?

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis mv. senest onsdag den 12. august 2026.

I forbindelse med din ansøgning må du gerne tilkendegive, hvis der er et af de to kontorer, som du er særligt interesseret i.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 34.



Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten og vil blive indplaceret som fuldmægtig eller konsulent afhængig af dine kvalifikationer og erfaring. Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Der er tale om faste stillinger på fuldtid med gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.

Stillingerne er med tiltræden snarest muligt.

Ansættelsesområdet er Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, og arbejdsstedet er departementet Slotholmsgade 10-12, 1216 København K.

For at kunne blive ansat hos os skal du kunne bestå et sikkerhedstjek eller opnå sikkerhedsgodkendelse til FORTROLIGT eller HEMMELIGT afhængigt af, hvilket kontor du ansættes i. Du kan læse om, hvordan vi behandler dine persondata her.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen. Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet er medlem af Foreningen Lige Adgang.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
At TAL, we’re committed to helping Australians live a life filled with choices, options and freedoms. As a Senior Actuarial Analyst in Pricing and Value, you’ll play a key role in shaping the pricing insights and strategies that support sustainable growth, strong customer outcomes and sound risk management. Working at the intersection of data, analytics and commercial decision-making, you’ll help influence outcomes across the business while driving continuous improvement in how we understand and respond to changing customer needs. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a purpose-led organisation.

In this role you will:

  • Deliver pricing insights and recommendations that drive sustainable growth and customer value.
  • Develop and enhance actuarial models to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Analyse complex business and customer data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Drive automation and analytical improvements that strengthen pricing capability and efficiency.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to influence decisions and deliver strategic outcomes.
  • Coach and share technical expertise to uplift team capability and foster continuous improvement.
  • Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret complex data and support sound business decisions.
  • Use data, modelling and programming tools such as Excel, SQL, Python or R to generate actionable insights.
  • Translate technical analysis into clear commercial recommendations that deliver value for customers and the business.
  • Bring curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset, exploring new ideas, technologies and innovative solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders through effective communication and collaborative partnership.
  • Draw on actuarial or broader quantitative expertise in disciplines such as mathematics, statistics, economics or data science, with progress towards professional qualifications welcomed.

TAL is one of Australia’s leading life insurers, committed to inclusion, and supporting the career growth of our diverse workforce. We’re proud to be:

  • Diversity Champions – Member of Diversity Council Australia, Australian Disability Network, Pride in Diversity and Champions of Change

You’re always accountable for your actions. You never give up. You strive to find the best outcomes for customers and partners. And you value working together to find the best solutions for problems.

As part of the recruitment process, there are several checks which may be conducted to demonstrate your eligibility for a role at TAL including Criminal History, Bankruptcy, Entitlement to Work, Regulatory and Reference Checks.

title: VYR. ANALITIKĖ (-AS) DIDMENINĖS RINKOS DEPARTAMENTE (TERMINUOTA SUTARTIS)
description:

Take YOUR part in #Energysmart

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Atsakant už ataskaitų ruošimą, savalaikį raportavimą, rezultatų vertinimą;
  • Vykdant veiklos rodiklių analizę, duomenų rinkimą, sisteminimą, apdorojimą, išvadų ir pasiūlymų veiklos gerinimui teikimą;
  • Užtikrinant duomenų kokybę, kursi kontrolės priemones, dalyvausi projektinėje veikloje;
  • Prisidedant prie analitinių įrankių kūrimo (analizė, procesų optimizavimas, procesų stebėsena, automatizavimas);

  • Dalyvaujant didmeninės elektros energijos prekybos duomenų sisteminimo procese ir derinime su kitais rinkos dalyviais.
  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas (ekonomikos ar tiksliųjų mokslų srityse);
  • Ne mažesnė nei dviejų metų darbo patirtis duomenų analitikoje;

  • Platus požiūris ir gebėjimas matyti sąsajas/prieštaravimus, daryti išvadas;
  • Geri darbo MS Office pagrindinėmis programomis (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) įgūdžiai;
  • Puikios lietuvių kalbos žinios, geros anglų kalbos žinios.

Privalumas būtų

  • Elektros energijos rinką reglamentuojančių teisės aktų ir didmeninės rinkos prekybos modelių išmanymas būtų privalumas;
  • Patirtis duomenų analitikoje energetikos sektoriuje;
  • „Power BI“ įgūdžiai.
  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą, kurį sudaro sveikatos draudimas ir sveikatinimosi išmoka;
  • Finansinį skatinimą už kandidatų rekomendavimą;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Dėmesį fizinei ir emocinei sveikatai: gerovės mentorių iniciatyvas ir psichologinę pagalbą, tinklinio ir krepšinio komandas ir t.t.

  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms;
  • Mentorystės principais grįstą kultūrą, įgalinančią darbe vadovautis vertybėmis ir siekti bendro tikslo.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Data / ML Automation Intern
description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.

Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs. We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator.

About the Job

Duration: 6 months
Type: Internship

We’re looking for a Data / ML Automation Intern to help build reliable data workflows, reporting tools, and AI-assisted automations for operational teams. You’ll work across data engineering, analytics, machine learning, and software development to turn manual processes into scalable systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
  • Basic SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, and filtering.
  • Familiarity with data structures, APIs, Git, and software-development fundamentals.
  • Interest in data engineering, machine learning, analytics, or automation.
  • Comfortable working with imperfect data and learning unfamiliar systems.
  • Able to communicate clearly in English and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GCP and BigQuery.
  • Familiarity with dbt, Airflow, Databricks, Apache Kafka, or ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Exposure to machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Experience using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, agent workflows, or evaluation pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, Terraform, or ArgoCD.
  • Experience building dashboards with Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Personal projects involving data pipelines, automation, analytics, or machine learning.

Tech you may work with

title: Senior Product Manager, Redis Core (Document Database) - Product Management - UK
description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

The Team

Document-oriented workloads are at the heart of many modern applications, and in this role you’ll help shape how developers build them using Redis. You will own and evolve Redis’s document data capabilities, enabling developers to work with JSON-based application data in a fast, intuitive, and scalable way across a wide range of real-world use cases.

You’ll work on a highly visible and deeply technical product area, collaborating closely with experienced engineers, architects, and customer-facing teams. The challenges you’ll tackle span data modelling, performance, memory efficiency, scalability, and developer experience, with direct feedback from customers running document-centric workloads at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how Redis is used beyond caching, while balancing simplicity and flexibility with the needs of open source users and enterprise customers in cloud and self-managed environments. If you enjoy turning complex data problems into clear, intuitive product experiences and seeing your work adopted quickly and widely, this is the role for you

The Role

Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap for Redis’s document-oriented data capabilities as well as advanced ways to query them

  • Translate customer and market needs around JSON-based data models, document access patterns, scalability, and reliability into clear product requirements

  • Partner with GTM, sales, and marketing to help position and explain Redis’s document use cases

  • Gather customer feedback through direct engagement, usage data, and market research

  • Drive successful launches and measure adoption and impact


What You’ll Bring to Redis

Your experience and strengths:

  • 5+ years of experience in software product management or equivalent experience in an enterprise organization

  • Strong understanding of document-oriented data models and application data patterns (e.g., JSON-based data, document storage and access patterns, or similar systems)

  • Ability to articulate both high-level concepts and detailed technical requirements concisely, verbally and in writing

  • Comfortable with code and capable of collaborating closely with engineers on technical design

  • BSc in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience

    • Experience managing database, infrastructure, or storage products

    • Experience building developer-centric APIs, SDKs, or tools

title: BIM Modeller
description:
Organisation Overview:

Founded in 2017, GWS Living Art was born out of Chop Ching Hin Pte Ltd, one of the top green commodity suppliers in Southeast Asia which was established in 1987. We take pride in promoting sustainable living and creating a green environment that is appealing to our urbanised cities.

GWS Living Art is on a mission to promote and advance the use of nature-based solutions in creating sustainable and liveable communities. We believe that nature provides us with the answers to many of the challenges faced by our cities, and we are dedicated to leveraging this power to create liveable, healthy and thriving environments.

As a BIM Modeller at GWS Living Art, you will play a key role in supporting the planning, design, and implementation of our urban greening and sustainability projects. You will work closely with our design and project teams to produce accurate, detailed BIM models and technical drawings that bring our nature-based solutions to life in urban spaces.

Your responsibilities will involve producing and managing digital models for green infrastructure systems, assisting with design coordination, and contributing to technical innovation in the built environment.

  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.

  • Flexibility to work after office hours and on weekends when necessary.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries. They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

Key Responsibilities

Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role

Managerial

  • Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

    • Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

Technical

  • Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include:

    1. Working with patients to identify physical problems.

      1. Developing and reviewing treatment programs.

      2. Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.

      3. Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.

      4. Writing patient case notes and reports.

      5. Collecting patient statistics.

      6. Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.

    2. Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

    • Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.

    • Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.

    • Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.

    • Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.

    • Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.

    • Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.

    • Maintaining a safe work environment.

    • Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.

    • Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.

    • Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.

    • Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

Quality and Safety

  • Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

    • Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable

    • Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections

    • Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections

    • Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed

    • Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

Continuous Education

  • Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

    • Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)

    • Participating in the orientation and training of new employees

    • Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions

    • Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.

    • The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems

  • Comply with all OSH and infection control policies, standards and procedures and cooperate with hospital management to comply those requirements

    • Notifying OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments, incident reports

    • Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs

    • Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures

    • Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.

    • Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures

    • Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety

    • Comply with Waste management procedures and policies. Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible

    • Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.

    • Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained

Prevention and Control of Infection (PCI):

  • PCI is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC PCI Policy and Strategy in an effort to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.

    • The strictest hand hygiene, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times

Qualifications & licensure

  • Knowledge of the range and type of services available for aged/disabled person.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to review procedures and implement new models of service delivery to satisfy client and organizational requirements.

  • Demonstrated commitment to quality outcomes and ability to consult with staff regarding continuous improvement.

  • Sound computer skills including knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

Experience required in addition to the Qualifications mentioned above

Currently licensed in country of origin and with DHA license to practice in Dubai U.A.E.

Governance and Compliance

title: Technical Lead, Native Commerce Integrations
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We are building the foundational protocol and API layer that allows AI agents to interact directly with commerce back ends. We were featured during Google's 2026 I/O Keynote.

In this role, you will be defining the standard schema and handshake mechanisms for agent-to-merchant interactions (discovery, cart, checkout). You will be developing the end-to-end commerce journeys on AIM, Gemini, and other agentic Google surfaces, and will build these over UCP in close collaboration with teams across Search, DeepMind, and other key Google organizations. You will be building the reference implementations and connectors that bridge first-party commerce systems with external and Google agent ecosystems and will also ensure agentic transactions are verifiable, secure, and compliant by default.

People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Lead a team of engineers to design, build, and scale infrastructure and systems that enable businesses to connect with Google’s AI commerce ecosystem.
  • Drive the technical strategy and product roadmap for AI-driven commerce infra, partnering closely with cross-functional leaders to identify growth opportunities and technical solutions.
  • Contribute directly to the codebase and system design across the full technical stack, while also supporting the development of new infra for partners.
  • Manage and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on rapid delivery, technical excellence, and long-term career growth.
  • Collaborate with global infrastructure and platform teams to ensure seamless integration across different technical environments and geographic locations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience with enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with full-stack development.
  • Experience with people management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
  • Experience working with large-scale distributed systems, reliability engineering, throughput and latency.
  • Experience coding in Java.

Description -

Role Summary
The Scenario Supply Planning AI Lead is an individual contributor within the Global Supply Chain Planning organization who will help to transform supply chain planning from static, reactive analysis into dynamic, AI-enabled scenario modeling. The role is responsible for improving the quality, speed, and consistency of planning decisions through structured scenario analysis, simulation, and analytical decision support.

The role partners closely with Global Supply Chain Planners to evaluate complex planning questions, develop reusable scenario frameworks, standardize analytical workflows, and improve planner productivity through the effective use of enterprise AI tools, automation, and analytics.

This is not an AI engineering, Machine Learning, or Data Science role. AI is used as an enabling capability to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work, and improve decision quality.

Scenario Planning & Decision Support

- Translate ambiguous business questions into structured what-if analyses with clear assumptions, constraints, and expected outcomes.
- Evaluate capacity trade-offs across service, cost, utilization, inventory, and operational risk.
- Develop decision-ready recommendations with supporting evidence, sensitivity analysis, and quantified business impact.
- Support planners during capacity disruptions, supply constraints, demand changes, new product introductions, and strategic planning exercises.
- Continuously improve scenario templates based on business outcomes and planner feedback

- Fundamental knowledge on Supply planning, Global Supply Chain Planning, S&OP / S&OE
- Experience working with large datasets, planning systems, ERP data, forecasting outputs, or supply chain performance metrics.

- Executive-ready scenario summaries
- Scenario comparison dashboards

title: Elektriker til industri og erhverv i Roskilde
description:
Vil du have firmabil, ordentlig løn og et hold omkring dig?

Vi mangler en elektriker til industri, erhverv og renovering i Roskilde.

Du bliver en del af et større hold, hvor service, drift og vedligehold er en del af hverdagen. Kunderne er især virksomheder, ejendomme og steder hvor aftalerne skal passe ind i en travl drift. På eldelen arbejder du i sjak med industri, erhverv og renovering, typisk i Roskilde og området omkring. Det er et setup hvor god kommunikation betyder noget, fordi kunden ofte har flere serviceaftaler samlet samme sted.

Du får firmabil, og du møder ind som en voksen fagperson der kan tage ansvar i sjakket. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører ud til opgaver i området. Der er et bagland at spørge, men hverdagen er lagt an på at du kan tage ansvar sammen med sjakket.

Det får du

Løn: 220-250 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Roskilde og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Industri, erhverv og renovering

Din hverdag

Dagen bliver planlagt med sjakket, så rækkefølgen passer med pladsen og det der haster mest. Du bruger firmabilen til opgaverne og holder styr på aftaler, materialer og ændringer undervejs. Når noget ikke stemmer, får du det meldt videre, så næste fag kan komme til.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Laver elarbejde på industri- og erhvervsopgaver
  • Arbejder med renovering i boliger og erhverv
  • Fremfører kabler og ledninger på pladsen
  • Monterer belysning og armaturer
  • Løser mindre tavleopgaver når sjakket har brug for det

Det skal fungere for kunden, men også for dem der skal arbejde videre efter dig. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du afleverer ordentligt og taler klart med folkene omkring dig.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som elektriker
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde stabilt i sjak
  • Taler ordentligt med kunder og kolleger
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både erhverv, industri og renovering før. Men det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt og tager ansvar for det du afleverer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 2 uger.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en elektriker mere i Roskilde, og det kunne sagtens være dig.



Industri og erhverv, Renovering

title: Senior Product Manager, Redis Core (Document Database) - Product Management - Germany
description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

The Team

Document-oriented workloads are at the heart of many modern applications, and in this role you’ll help shape how developers build them using Redis. You will own and evolve Redis’s document data capabilities, enabling developers to work with JSON-based application data in a fast, intuitive, and scalable way across a wide range of real-world use cases.

You’ll work on a highly visible and deeply technical product area, collaborating closely with experienced engineers, architects, and customer-facing teams. The challenges you’ll tackle span data modelling, performance, memory efficiency, scalability, and developer experience, with direct feedback from customers running document-centric workloads at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how Redis is used beyond caching, while balancing simplicity and flexibility with the needs of open source users and enterprise customers in cloud and self-managed environments. If you enjoy turning complex data problems into clear, intuitive product experiences and seeing your work adopted quickly and widely, this is the role for you

The Role

What type of work will you be doing:


Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap for Redis’s document-oriented data capabilities as well as advanced ways to query them

  • Identify and prioritize document-centric use cases where Redis delivers strong customer value

  • Work with our alliances team to establish relationships with key partners in the document-centric application and data ecosystem, and drive joint customer value

  • Translate customer and market needs around JSON-based data models, document access patterns, scalability, and reliability into clear product requirements

  • Partner with GTM, sales, and marketing to help position and explain Redis’s document use cases

  • Gather customer feedback through direct engagement, usage data, and market research

  • Drive successful launches and measure adoption and impact


What You’ll Bring to Redis

Your experience and strengths:

  • 5+ years of experience in software product management or equivalent experience in an enterprise organization

  • Strong understanding of document-oriented data models and application data patterns (e.g., JSON-based data, document storage and access patterns, or similar systems)

  • Ability to articulate both high-level concepts and detailed technical requirements concisely, verbally and in writing

  • Comfortable with code and capable of collaborating closely with engineers on technical design

  • BSc in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience

    Extra great if you have

    • Experience managing database, infrastructure, or storage products

    • Hands-on experience with popular document databases (e.g., Couchbase, Firestore, or Aerospike)

    • Experience building developer-centric APIs, SDKs, or tools

    • Prior experience with NoSQL or real-time databases (extra points for Redis experience)

  • Hybrid working options from both home and the office

  • One-time home-office setup allowance

  • Health and dental insurance for you

title: Process Quality Engineer
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for management of Asia Quality System, Policies, Programs and Initiatives. Part of the Global Quality Team to maintain global quality system and drive global initiative.

Role and Responsibilities

Quality System

1. Develop, implement and maintain QMS documentation to maintain compliance with applicable standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or GMP

2. Monitor regulatory changes and update the QMS accordingly

3. Conduct internal audits and support external audits (external auditing bodies, suppliers and customers)

4. Analyze quality data and metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement

5. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure that the quality standards are integrated into processes

Management Representative

1. Reports on QMS performance to top management and recommend improvement

2. Point of contact for certification bodies

3. Lead Management Review and follow up action items

Product Quality Management

1. Analyze and capture recurring product complaints, collaborate with Operation and Technology teams to address compound specified failures

2. Operational Quality Support. To facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, by providing on the floor support through use of quality tools and coaching teams to build ownership and proactive engagement with quality processes.

Customer Complaints Management

1. CCAR Manager. Manage the customer complaints handling process to ensure that all complaints are logged with right information for investigation till auditing process

2. Collaborate with cross functional team during the investigation, resolution and communication of customer complaints

3. Review interim CCAR reports to ensure that root cause is data driven and corrective action(s) address the root cause

Supplier Complaints Management

1. SCAR Manager. Approve SCAR – Supplier related complaints and defects, review and monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions

2. Collaborate with Procurement, Supplier and internal stakeholders to investigate issues and resolution

3. Collaborate with Procurement, Operation and Technology to assess risk and quality impact of raw material on finished goods

Global Quality Team Collaboration

1. Support the implementation of global quality initiatives, systems and tools

2. Ensure that local QMS aligns with global practices and corporate policies

3. Share best practices and lessons learned across global sites

Support Quality Contracts/Documentation

1. Review customer documents and quality related agreements for compliances to ensure clauses are relevant, assess the risks.

2. Response to customer request for certifications, compliance/quality related/audit documents

System

1. Conduct training for staff in Quality Procedure, Standards and Tools.

2. Lead processes identified by the Global Quality Team such as PPAP, QIR, CCAR, SCAR and Mastercontrol for the Asia Region

Requirements:

· Degree or equivalent experience in a field of study such as chemistry, business, accounting, engineering, etc.

· Certificate in Quality Engineering is preferred.

· 4-6 years of quality management experience. Junior with 1-2 experience in related field can also apply

· Demonstrates introductory understanding and ability and with guidance, applies competency in typical situations.

· Able to design quality systems to meet customer expectations and internal needs. New approaches and continuous improvement must be ongoing.

· Good experience into customer & supplier audit and able to conduct training

· Good interpersonal skills to be able to communicate and collaborate with all stakeholders and deal with situation proactively

· Occasionally overseas travel and weekly conference call is required for the role

· This position required to communicate closely with vendors in China.

Working hours:

Mon to Fri 8.30am - 5.30pm ( 1 day hybrid )

title: Program Manager II, Transportation Controllership

- Developing metrics for continuous tracking of process improvement and helping the leadership for data based fast decision making
- Simplifying operational and financial complexities through innovative long term solutions

title: Product Led Growth Intern
description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 3,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Every high-growth SaaS company runs on great operating systems. Behind every renewal, customer success initiative, revenue forecast, and business decision is a team building the processes and insights that make growth predictable.

As a Revenue Operations Intern, you'll help build those systems.

Working closely with Customer Success, Renewals, Sales, Finance, and Product, you'll solve operational problems, analyse business data, improve workflows, and help teams make better decisions. You'll learn how a modern SaaS business operates from the inside—not by observing from the sidelines, but by contributing to projects that have real business impact.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving structured problems, and want to understand how fast-growing companies scale, you'll thrive here.

Where You'll Leave Your Mark?

  • Build and ship small AI-powered tools, prototypes, and experiments that support growth initiatives (e.g., Founder focussed skills, developer support tools/skills, ).
  • Tinker with the broader LLM and AI app ecosystem — Claude (including Claude Skills and Artifacts), ChatGPT (custom GPTs, Apps), and other frontier model APIs, agent frameworks, and prompt tooling — to quickly test and validate ideas.
  • Build user-facing apps/plugins on top of LLMs — think custom Claude Skills, ChatGPT Apps, or lightweight AI-powered tools that solve a specific growth or workflow problem
  • Work with the growth team to identify opportunities where AI can improve conversion, activation, retention, or engagement.
  • Partner with product and engineering to take promising experiments from prototype to production-ready features.
  • Track and analyze the impact of shipped experiments, and iterate based on data and user feedback.
  • Stay on top of what's new in the AI/LLM space (new models, Claude/ChatGPT features, agent tooling) and bring in relevant ideas, tools, or techniques.
  • Participate actively in growth and product discussions, contributing ideas beyond just execution.

    • The Kind of Builder We're Looking For -

  • Currently in your 3rd or 4th year, pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Solid programming fundamentals (Python and/or JavaScript) and comfort picking up new tools/frameworks quickly.
  • Genuine curiosity about LLMs and the AI app ecosystem, hands-on experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools (skills, custom GPTs, apps, agents) is a big plus, even if mostly self-taught or project-based (side projects, hackathons, personal experiments all count).
  • A builder's mindset: excited to prototype fast, ship, and iterate rather than over-plan.
  • Interest in growth and product, curious about why things work for users, not just how to build them.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative team.
    • Nice to Have
  • Experience building Claude Skills, ChatGPT Apps/custom GPTs, or apps using LLM APIs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
  • Any personal projects, GitHub repos, or hackathon work involving AI apps — happy to see what you've built.
  • Basic familiarity with product/growth concepts (funnels, A/B testing, activation metrics).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus but not required.

    • You will enjoy Sprinto if -

    • Stepping in before someone has to step up.
    • Wearing multiple hats without counting them.
    • Leaving egos at the door and winning as one team.
    • Taking the harder right over the easier wrong.
    • Shipping, learning, repeating.
    • Staying curious and never staying in your lane.

    Inclusion & Diversity -

    At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

    We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

description:
Job Summary

The R&D and Product Manager will lead innovation, product development, and product lifecycle management for KompacPlus material solutions. This role is responsible for researching new surface materials, improving fabrication processes, managing product strategy, and ensuring products are technically strong and commercially successful.

The position bridges technical development and market strategy, working closely with Production, Sales, Procurement, Marketing, and Quality Assurance teams to ensure products are competitive, cost-effective, and aligned with customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Research & Product Development

  • Lead development of new surface materials, carpentry systems, and fabrication solutions.
  • Conduct research on material performance, durability, sustainability, and cost optimization.
  • Develop prototypes, mock-ups, and samples for testing and validation.
  • Improve existing products to enhance quality, functionality, and aesthetics.
  • Evaluate new technologies, materials, and industry trends.

2. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Develop and execute product strategies for KompacPlus product lines.
  • Manage full product lifecycle from concept to launch and discontinuation.
  • Define and maintain product roadmap aligned with company goals.
  • Conduct market research on trends, competitors, and customer demands.
  • Monitor product performance, profitability, and market positioning.
  • Recommend product enhancement, expansion, or phase-out plans.

3. Process Innovation & Production Improvement

  • Analyze production processes to improve efficiency and reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with CNC operators and production teams to refine fabrication methods.
  • Implement lean manufacturing and process optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure product designs are manufacturable and scalable.
  • Identify opportunities for automation or technical upgrades.

4. Technical Testing & Quality Management

  • Conduct material testing (heat resistance, moisture resistance, strength, chemical resistance, etc.).
  • Establish product specifications, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Work with QA team to ensure compliance with industry standards.
  • Investigate product issues and implement corrective actions.

5. Commercial & Market Support

  • Work closely with Sales team to gather market feedback and identify opportunities.
  • Support technical presentations, tender submissions, and client meetings.
  • Analyze sales performance, margins, and product profitability.
  • Develop product value propositions and key selling points.
  • Conduct product training for internal teams and customers.

6. Pricing & Cost Control

  • Conduct feasibility studies and cost analysis for new products.
  • Work with Procurement to source materials and evaluate suppliers.
  • Review cost structures and recommend pricing strategies.
  • Monitor raw material cost impact on margins.

7. Project & Budget Management

  • Manage R&D and product development timelines and budgets.
  • Prioritize projects based on business strategy.
  • Report progress and performance to senior management.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously.

8. Compliance & Sustainability

  • Research environmentally sustainable materials and practices.
  • Ensure products comply with local regulations and building standards.
  • Explore green certifications and eco-label opportunities.

Job Requirements

Experience

  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in R&D, product development, or manufacturing.
  • At least 2–3 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
  • Experience in solid surface materials, carpentry, cabinetry, or building materials industry preferred.
  • Experience in product lifecycle management is an advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of surface materials (solid surface, quartz, laminates, wood panels, etc.).
  • Familiar with CNC machining and fabrication processes.
  • Understanding of material testing and quality control standards.
  • Proficient in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) preferred.
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles.
  • Strong understanding of product costing and margin analysis.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strategic thinking with commercial awareness.
  • Leadership and team management ability.
  • Good communication and presentation skills.
  • Detail-oriented and innovation-driven mindset.
  • Ability to balance technical feasibility with business objectives.

Dit mødested vil være midt i Maribo by, tæt på Naturpark Maribo Søerne og kun få kilometers kørsel fra motorvejen.

Du bliver en del af et udekørende team midt i Maribo by med cirka 140 borgere. Vi er et team bestående af elever, social- og sundhedshjælpere, social- og sundhedsassistenter, en daglig planlægger, en sygeplejefaglig koordinator og en teamleder.

Teamet dækker dag-, aften- og nattevagter, og vi vægter faglighed og godt arbejdsmiljø højt.

Vi arbejder med en rehabiliterende tilgang og helhedspleje, hvor vi har fokus på at støtte borgerne i at bevare og udvikle deres egne ressourcer og selvstændighed. Helhedspleje betyder hos os, at borgeren får den nødvendige hjælp og støtte med udgangspunkt i hele deres situation, så de kan leve et så selvstændigt liv som muligt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på borgerens selvbestemmelse og et tæt samarbejde – både med borgeren selv, de pårørende og på tværs af faggrupper.
