title: Lease Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Lease Administrator to support the administration of our national property portfolio. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate lease data, ensuring compliance requirements are met, and providing administrative support to the wider Property team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

About the Role

As a Lease Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining lease records, managing property-related documentation, supporting lease transactions, and responding to internal stakeholder queries. You will work closely with Leasing Managers and a range of internal and external stakeholders to ensure property processes are delivered efficiently and accurately.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and administer the Lease Management System and lease database.
  • Ensure lease and property documentation is accurate, compliant, and up to date.
  • Manage and respond to internal property-related queries.
  • Review, allocate, and reconcile rent and outgoing accounts to ensure payment accuracy.
  • Support and maintain property systems and processes.
  • Provide administrative support to Leasing Managers as required.
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate property and fleet lease transactions.
  • Provide guidance on property policies, procedures, forms, and processes.
  • Support property projects and initiatives throughout the year.
  • Respond to employee and leader enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Assist with process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives within the Property function.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will be a proactive and organised administrator with strong attention to detail and excellent stakeholder management skills.

Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in administration, lease administration, property administration, or a similar role.
  • Experience with ProLease Enterprise (highly desired)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Experience managing and maintaining large-scale systems and databases.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organisation.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities to meet deadlines.
  • A professional and confident approach when working with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and willingness to contribute to process enhancements.

Why Join APM?

At APM, you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive team where your contribution makes a real impact. We offer a dynamic environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to be involved in projects that support our national property operations.

If you're a detail-oriented administrator who enjoys working with systems, data, and stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now!

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the role

Our Azure SaaS estate keeps service management running for thousands of organisations worldwide, under SLA-backed 24/7 availability. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you own the reliability of that estate as an engineering problem — you set the SLOs, engineer out the toil behind them, and make the platform faster to change and cheaper to operate without trading away resilience.

You sit in the SaaS infrastructure function, working alongside cloud engineering and the product squads shipping to production. You bring our AI-native ways of working into reliability: agents and bounded automation with observability, approvals, containment, and rollback — self-healing systems, not runbooks worked by hand.

What this is not A ticket-driven, break-fix ops role kept away from the code. This is reliability as engineering — you own SLOs and error budgets, automate what you repeat, and design the platform to recover itself rather than reacting incident by incident.

The team

We are a group of social technicians who value transparency, open feedback, and a healthy work-life balance — and who treat reliability as a shared, measurable objective, not a firefight.

What you'll own

  • SLOs and error budgets. Define and own service-level objectives across the Azure (and potentially multi-cloud) estate, and use error budgets to steer the balance between shipping change and protecting reliability.
  • Toil elimination and self-healing automation. Identify toil, classify it, and engineer it out — feeding self-healing automation and your findings into the reliability roadmap. Stand up an agent-based support layer that owns recurring toil and continuously feeds improvements back into reliability.
  • Observability consolidation. Standardise metrics, alerting, and tracing across all datacenters, close coverage gaps on cloud workloads, and measurably reduce the alert-to-incident ratio from baseline.
  • Incident response and blameless postmortems. Lead incidents to resolution, run blameless postmortems, and turn every learning into a durable fix or an automation candidate.
  • Reliability of releases. Harden CI/CD and progressive delivery — canaries, safe rollouts, automated rollback — so change velocity and reliability rise together.
  • Capacity and performance. Model capacity, load-test critical paths, and keep the platform within its performance envelope as it scales across regions.
  • AI-native reliability. Bring agents and bounded automation — with observability, approvals, containment, and rollback — into detection, diagnosis, and remediation.
  • Runbooks that get used. Every alert links to a runbook; every runbook links to an automation candidate. You leave things more legible than you found them.
  • Capacity and cost forecasting. Own capacity and cost planning across the multi-cloud estate, model usage and growth trends, and forecast short and long term infrastructure needs so spend and scaling decisions stay ahead of demand rather than reacting to it.

How you approach the work

  • Automate what you repeat — if you have done it manually twice, the third time is a design problem.
  • Measure before optimising: SLOs, baselines, and dashboards before opinions.
  • Design for failure — assume things break, and make recovery automatic and observable.
  • Consultative, not gatekeeping: you pair with product engineering teams and transfer knowledge as you go.
  • Treat cost and reliability as joint objectives, not a forced trade-off.
  • Pro-active collaboration with product teams. You are involved in the early phases of product development, including design to help the teams make optimal choices and timely introduce appropriate SRE practices.

Technical environment

  • Scale: 10+ global datacenters; SLA-backed, 24/7 multi-tenant SaaS serving millions of end users.
  • Cloud: Azure across all production regions, with a mature landing-zone and networking architecture.
  • Compute: Kubernetes / Azure AKS alongside traditional VM infrastructure, all managed as code.
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform via CI/CD and GitOps workflows; configuration management with Puppet and Ansible across Linux and Windows.
  • Observability: metrics, alerting, and tracing across cloud-native and self-managed layers (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Influx).
  • Automation: Python and automation tooling — and we expect you to take the reliability stack to the next level, not just operate today's.
  • Legacy: Java, MS SQL, heritage architecture — being decomposed. The SRE role is not responsible for the Java application code.
  • How we build: Claude Code as our primary AI-native SDLC tool; subagents and multi-agent workflows; MCP tool integrations; shared prompt, agent, and eval libraries.

Success in your first year

  • SLOs and error budgets are defined for the estate's critical services and actively used to steer delivery decisions.
  • The alert-to-incident ratio is measurably down, and runbooks you wrote are used by the on-call shift without escalation.
  • Toil you identified is automated — or has a credible, documented roadmap to be — and self-healing covers at least one high-frequency failure mode.
  • Postmortems produce durable fixes, not repeat incidents; recurring-incident rate is trending down against a documented baseline.
  • Product squads consult you during design, not only after incidents.

Required

  • Proven hands-on experience (5+ years) as a Site Reliability, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineer running a production cloud environment at scale (Azure).
  • Fluent with SLOs, error budgets, and reliability engineering practice — you have set them, not just read about them.
  • Strong observability skills at scale — Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, or equivalent — including alerting and tracing.
  • Kubernetes at operator level: Helm, namespace management, ingress controllers, RBAC, persistent volumes.
  • Coding for automation (Python or equivalent) and Terraform delivered via CI/CD.
  • Linux system administration — you understand what Puppet or Ansible is doing, not just whether it ran green.
  • Comfortable leading incidents in an on-call rotation with real SLA obligations, and the maturity to know when to escalate.
  • Strong written communication — your postmortems, runbooks, and architecture notes are unambiguous.

Nice to have

  • Experience with progressive delivery — canaries, feature flags, automated rollback.
  • Experience working within or migrating toward an Azure Cloud Adoption Framework or enterprise landing-zone structure.
  • Current, personal practice of AI-native software delivery (Claude Code or equivalent).
  • Experience with EU data residency / sovereign cloud requirements.

What's in it for you

  • Extra 5 additional days of leave on top of the basic annual leave
  • Holiday allowance: 8% of the annual gross salary (paid in December)
  • Fitness membership (Life1 gym)
  • Private health insurance (Medicare)
  • Cafeteria
  • Company massage
  • Flexible working hours
  • Home office
  • Personal development (no fixed budget)
  • Anniversary bonus
  • Sabbatical

Want to apply?

Does this sound like your next step? Apply with your CV and a short motivation letter via the application form. Tell us about a service you made more reliable — the SLOs you set, the toil you engineered out, and the outcome (uptime, incidents reduced, or recovery time improved).

title: BIM Engineer
description:
Als BIM Engineer bij Zwart doe je veel meer dan het maken van een goed 3D-model. BIM is binnen onze organisatie volop in ontwikkeling en juist daarin ligt jouw kans. Jij krijgt de ruimte om jouw kennis en ervaring in te zetten om BIM verder te professionaliseren én mee te bepalen hoe we er binnen Zwart mee werken.

Je werkt aan technisch complexe en klant specifieke noodstroomprojecten, onder andere voor datacenters en andere mission critical omgevingen. Je vertaalt 3D CAD-modellen en ontwerpen naar slimme BIM-modellen in Revit, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder dan het model zelf. Hoe kunnen processen slimmer? Welke standaarden hebben we nodig? En hoe zorgen we ervoor dat Engineering, Projectmanagement, klanten en leveranciers optimaal samenwerken binnen BIM?

Samen met ervaren Mechanical Engineers, Project Engineers en Projectmanagers bouw je aan oplossingen die technisch moeten kloppen én uitvoerbaar moeten zijn. Met jouw BIM-expertise verbind je de verschillende disciplines en help je collega's om BIM steeds beter toe te passen.

Kortom: een rol voor een ervaren BIM Modelleur, BIM Engineer of BIM Coördinator die niet alleen wil modelleren, maar ook zichtbaar invloed wil hebben op processen, kwaliteit en de verdere ontwikkeling van BIM binnen Zwart.

Binnen onze afdeling Mechanical Engineering werk je samen met verschillende technische specialisten. Je loopt mee in het volledige proces van onze projecten en bent dé specialist als het gaat om BIM. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het vertalen en converteren van 3D CAD-modellen, onder andere vanuit Inventor, naar Revit.

  • Het beheren, controleren en bewaken van BIM-modellen.

  • Zorgen dat modellen technisch kloppen, uitvoerbaar zijn en voldoen aan de afgesproken BIM-kwaliteitseisen.

  • Het opstellen, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van BIM- en BUP-plannen en protocollen.

  • Het ontwikkelen van een goede werkwijze voor de conversie van 3D CAD naar Revit.

  • Het verbeteren en standaardiseren van BIM-processen, procedures en werkmethodieken.

  • Het signaleren van afwijkingen en knelpunten in ontwerpen en deze bespreekbaar maken.

  • Het ondersteunen van projecten bij BIM-vraagstukken.

  • Het afstemmen met Engineering, Project Engineering, Projectmanagement, klanten, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers.

  • Het vertegenwoordigen van Zwart op BIM-gebied tijdens projectvergaderingen.

  • Het delen van jouw BIM-kennis met collega's en daarmee verder professionaliseren van onze organisatie.

Kortom: jij modelleert niet alleen binnen onze BIM-werkwijze, je helpt die werkwijze ook vorm te geven.

We zoeken iemand die begrijpt wat BIM betekent voor techniek, samenwerking, processen en kwaliteit. Je hebt:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde technische MBO-4-opleiding en HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Bouwkunde of vergelijkbaar.

  • Enkele jaren ervaring binnen het BIM-vakgebied, bijvoorbeeld als BIM Engineer, BIM Modelleur of BIM Coördinator.

  • Ruime ervaring met Revit - dit is voor deze functie een must.

  • Kennis van BIM-methodieken, standaarden, protocollen en BIM/BUP-plannen.

  • Affiniteit met én kennis van werktuigbouwkundige installaties.

  • Ervaring met het werken volgens en bij voorkeur verbeteren van BIM-processen en protocollen.

  • Bij voorkeur kennis van 3D CAD-programma's zoals Inventor.

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met software zoals Navisworks, AutoCAD, BIM 360/ACC en/of BIMcollab.

  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Daarnaast werk je nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, neem je gemakkelijk initiatief en durf je collega's en andere stakeholders aan te spreken wanneer iets technisch of procesmatig beter kan.

🛡️Welke garanties kun je verwachten?

Bij Zwart krijg je een functie waarin je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Je krijgt de kans om niet alleen aan onze projecten te werken, maar ook zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de manier waarop we BIM binnen Zwart organiseren en verder ontwikkelen. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een inhoudelijke BIM-rol met ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

  • Technisch complexe en unieke projecten.

  • Veel samenwerking met verschillende engineeringdisciplines.

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.400 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Mogelijkheid om parttime te werken vanaf 24 uur per week.

  • Mogelijkheid tot max. 20% van je werktijd vanuit huis te werken.

  • Collectieve eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Vakantietoeslag van 8% van het bruto jaarloon, uitgekeerd in juni.

  • Totaal 30 verlofdagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Werkzaam onder de CAO Metaal & Techniek – Technisch installatiebedrijf.

Ben je klaar om je energie in deze rol te stoppen en je skills een boost te geven?

title: Section Head QA – OSD
description:
Role Purpose

To lead In‑Process Quality Assurance activities for OSD formulation manufacturing, ensuring cGMP compliance, data integrity, inspection readiness, and Right‑First‑Time execution, in line with Quality Management System and global regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

IPQA – Manufacturing & Packaging

  • Ensure real‑time QA oversight during dispensing, granulation, blending, compression, coating, ampoule and packing operations.
  • Review and ensure compliance of BMRs/BPRs, in‑process checks, and critical process parameters.
  • Manage line clearance, batch initiation, and batch closure activities.
  • Ensure adherence to ALCOA+ principles and data integrity requirements.
  • Support process validation, cleaning validation, and technology transfer batches.

Investigations & Quality Managment Systems

  • Lead and support deviations, OOS/OOT, incidents, and market complaints (if applicable).
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and ensure robust CAPA implementation and effectiveness checks.
  • Participate in change control, risk assessment, and continual improvement initiatives.

AQA – Analytical Quality Assurance

  • Review and approve analytical data related to raw materials, in‑process, finished products, stability, and cleaning samples.
  • Ensure compliance with analytical SOPs, test methods, specifications, and pharmacopeial requirements.
  • Review and support investigations related to OOS, OOT, atypical results, laboratory incidents, and method-related deviations.
  • Ensure data integrity compliance in QC laboratories, including audit trails, CDS, LIMS, and manual records.
  • Review method validation, method transfer, and analytical change control documents.
  • Participate in stability program review, trend analysis, and analytical risk assessments.

Educational Qualification

  • B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc (Chemistry or relevant discipline)

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in QA – OSD formulation manufacturing
  • Minimum 2–3 years in a senior executive / team leadership role
  • Exposure to AQA, OOT and OOS Investigation

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

Technical Skills

title: Research Assistant (Psychology / Cognitive Neuroscience)
description:
The Centre for Research and Development in Learning (CRADLE) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) supports multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary research across NTU devoted to transforming learning in higher education. Leveraging on knowledge and methods from education, psychology, neuroscience, and technology design, CRADLE aims to develop and test theories to explain learning in all of its forms.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/cradle.

The successful candidate will work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team and contribute to research design, data collection, analysis, and reporting. This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support research collaborations by liaising with internal teams and external partners, including educational institutions.

  • Conduct literature reviews and prepare research reports, summaries, and presentation materials for stakeholders.

  • Prepare and maintain ethics applications and documentation in accordance with institutional review board (IRB) requirements.

  • Collect research data using established psychological and neuroimaging methods (e.g., cognitive assessments, MRI, fNIRS).

  • Assist in the development, implementation, and maintenance of research protocols and data analysis workflows.

  • Perform data analysis using relevant statistical and research software.

  • Provide administrative support for research activities, including procurement and coordination of resources.

  • Maintain research data systems, including ensuring proper data management, security, and documentation.

  • Coordinate meetings and prepare progress updates for project stakeholders.

  • Provide guidance to student assistants involved in research activities, where applicable.

  • Carry out other related duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience, or a related field.

Skills and Competencies

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare research documentation and reports.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in statistical software (e.g., SPSS, R).

  • Familiarity with neuroimaging tools and techniques is advantageous.

  • Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to adapt to evolving research needs.

  • Willingness to travel to research sites, where required.

Experience and Knowledge

  • Prior experience in research (e.g., cognitive neuroscience, psychology, or related fields) is preferred.

  • Exposure to neuroimaging methods (e.g., fMRI, DTI, fNIRS) is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with academic research processes and publications is a plus.

  • Basic understanding of cognitive neuroscience concepts is beneficial.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Warehouse Operative - Nightshift
description:
Prefer to work overnight? Our Argos Local Fulfilment Centres (LFC’s) are a 24-hour operation, we offer a brilliant choice and quick service to our customers. We offer online ordering, home delivery and click and collect services to our customers, and to do this efficiently we need brilliant colleagues to move and manage our stock to make sure our customers get exactly what they have ordered and receive a brilliant experience.

What makes this different?

It’s our customer focus. We don’t have to wait for a spreadsheet or graph to tell us how well we’re doing, because we’re getting feedback directly from the customers. So, you’ll hear firsthand the kind of impact you’re making.

You’ll work overnight, guided via headset where the orders are in the depot, pick the right ones, and deliver those quickly to waiting drivers and customers. You’ll also be putting deliveries away in the correct place.

The centre is built on teamwork, and you’ll soon get into the rhythm of the job with friendly colleagues around to help you.

These are new environments, so you’ll be joining a team at the beginning, quickly making yourself indispensable to the team. You’ll really benefit from the supportive, family feel and helpful management.

We’ve got more than enough room for people who want part-time, or job share roles too, so let’s talk about your availability.

Alongside this, we also offer a great range of benefits for all our colleagues, including:

  • After you've worked with us for more than 4 weeks, we'll send you two colleague discount cards – one for yourself and one for a second user who lives permanently at the same address as you.
  • Your discount card gives you 10% discount off on your shopping at Sainsbury’s, Argos, Tu and Habitat. This increases to 15% discount off at Sainsbury’s every Friday and Saturday
  • Food and hot drinks is provided in colleague areas in all our Local Fulfilment Centres

  • Wellbeing support – access to emotional support, counselling, legal and financial advice

You must be above the school-leaver age in your country School leaving age - GOV.UK

You must be fully licenced to drive and have held a full UK/EU driving licence for at least 12 months with no more than 6 points on it.

Whilst many of our roles will be temporary over the festive period, there may also be permanent opportunities available - please check the contract type and schedule hours before applying to ensure that the role is right for you.

title: ADF Rehabilitation Consultant
description:
Join Acumen Health and be part of a national team delivering meaningful outcomes in occupational rehabilitation. With strong local support, exposure to complex and psychological injury cases, and clear governance around your work, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your capability while making a real impact.

Support people where your rewards are truly meaningful and purposeful.

As an ADF Rehabilitation Consultant, you will apply your clinical reasoning skills to support ADF personnel who have sustained a physical and/or psychological injury. This is a unique role to be part of the team that gets our military fully fit and ready to defend and protect Australia.

  • Taking a holistic care approach, work within a multidisciplinary team to support the journey from rehab to healing

  • Collaborate with a variety of stakeholders including the employee who has suffered injury, illness, or trauma, medical specialists, other treatment providers and allied health professionals
  • Develop, implement and monitor rehabilitation plans.

KPI’s based on service delivery outcomes, NOT billable hours. Genuine person-centred focus and goal setting.

Set working hours means you can truly have WORK / LIFE balance – no overtime, no outside of work hours work. Enjoy early starts and early finishes: 7:30am - 3:30pm Monday to Friday. You will be located at Lavarack Barracks in Townsville.

Why you’ll love working at Acumen Health, part of the APM Group

At Acumen Health, you’ll work within a national network with strong local teams, giving you the opportunity to manage diverse and complex cases while being supported by experienced colleagues and leaders.
You’ll build capability in complex and psychological injury, working with structured approaches including trauma-informed practice and validated assessment tools.
Our teams are supported by clear clinical governance and practical systems, giving you the confidence to make decisions, manage risk and deliver strong outcomes for your clients.

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

Enjoy all the perks of a global conglomerate including access to the Fitness Passport program plus discounts at hundreds of retail outlets.

  • Current unrestricted registration or membership with the relevant industry body (AHPRA, ESSA, ASORC or AASW)

  • Passion to help people rehabilitate

title: Financial Services Consultant
description:
Build Your Advisory Career with Manulife

Are you looking for higher earning potential, industry-leading incentives, sponsored professional certification programmes, multi-product accessibility and a professional advisory platform where you can deepen your expertise, grow your client portfolio and progress towards leadership opportunities?

Manulife is seeking experienced Financial Services Consultants to join its established advisory team. With premium infrastructure, modern office facilities and a collaborative environment, this opportunity is designed for professionals who are passionate about delivering high-quality financial advice while building a sustainable and rewarding career.

As a Financial Services Consultant, you will provide regulated financial advisory services across protection, health, wealth accumulation, retirement, investment and legacy planning. You will conduct comprehensive financial needs analyses, develop tailored recommendations, build long-term client relationships and maintain the highest standards of professional conduct in accordance with Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct client consultations, fact-finding and financial needs analyses.
  • Perform risk profiling and develop tailored financial planning recommendations.
  • Provide advice across protection, health, wealth accumulation, retirement, investment and legacy planning.
  • Build and maintain long-term client relationships through networking, referrals and business development.
  • Manage ongoing client servicing, portfolio reviews and claims support.
  • Maintain accurate client records, suitability assessments and regulatory documentation.
  • Collaborate with compliance, underwriting and operations teams to deliver an exceptional client experience.
  • Achieve agreed advisory activity and performance objectives.

Requirements

  • Minimum 21 years of age (MAS regulatory requirement).
  • Diploma* or higher.
  • CMFAS certifications: RES5, M9, M9A and HI (M8/M8A advantageous).
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in financial advisory, insurance, wealth management or financial planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, engage and build long-term client relationships.
  • Experience within a multi-product or multi-insurer advisory environment is advantageous.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship management skills.
  • Professional, ethical and client-focused approach to financial advisory.

*Diploma must comprise a minimum of 900 study hours, be at least 50% examination assessed, and qualify for university admission.

What's on Offer

Joining Manulife provides access to a professional advisory platform designed to support your long-term success.

Benefits include:

  • Industry-leading incentives and competitive remuneration.
  • Sponsored higher professional certification programmes and continuous learning opportunities.
  • Access to a comprehensive suite of protection, wealth, investment and legacy planning solutions.
  • Premium central office facilities and dedicated client meeting spaces.
  • Modern digital advisory tools and technology platforms.
  • Flexible working arrangements that support productivity and work-life integration.
  • Structured mentoring, coaching and career development.
  • Leadership progression opportunities within an established advisory practice.
  • Dedicated operational, compliance and specialist support, allowing you to focus on client relationships and business growth.

Who Thrives Here

This opportunity is ideal for Financial Services Consultants who demonstrate integrity, professionalism and accountability, and who are committed to delivering client-first financial advice. You enjoy building trusted relationships, continuously developing your expertise and working within a collaborative, high-performing environment where quality, ethics and long-term success are valued.

Already an Established Financial Services Consultant?

If you are an established Financial Services Consultant, speak to us about joining Manulife and learn more about the attractive transition incentives available to experienced advisers.

Successful candidates may be eligible for enhanced earning multipliers, attractive sign-on financial incentives and structured transition support, providing the opportunity to maximise earnings while continuing to build a successful long-term advisory career on an established platform.

Next Steps

If you are an experienced Financial Services Consultant seeking an established platform, outstanding professional support and significant earning potential with Manulife, we invite you to apply today.

title: Pædagog/PA til Elevhjemmet Neptun
description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for børn og unge med høretab?
Elevhjemmet Neptun søger en robust og engageret pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent, der trives i et specialpædagogisk miljø med hjerterum og høj faglighed.

Om os
Elevhjemmet Neptun er et specialiseret elevhjem under Specialcenter Syddanmark. Vi huser 7 børn og unge i alderen 6-25 år, som alle har høretab som fællesnævner. Udover deres hørenedsættelse kan vores beboere have kognitive, følelsesmæssige eller sociale udfordringer, hvilket kræver en nærværende og individuel pædagogisk indsats.

Vi er nabo og tæt samarbejdspartner til Fredericiaskolen – Center for Høretab og STU Merkur. Vores fornemmeste opgave er at skabe en tryg og udviklende base for de elever, der bor hos os – enten på grund af geografisk afstand til hjemmet eller et behov for socialt samvær med ligestillede. Elevhjemmet Neptun er normeret til at huse 8 børn. Botilbuddets lovgrundlag er omfattet af Barnets lov §43, stk. 1, nr. 6 og stk. 3 samt Servicelovens §107.

Din profil
Vi leder efter en kollega, der træder ind i opgaven med både ro og empati. Du er uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent og genkender dig selv i følgende:

  • Relationsstærk: Du er dygtig til at opbygge tillid og skabe trygge rammer for børnene.
  • Faglig funderet: Du har kendskab til (eller interesse for) Low Arousal og konfliktnedtrapning som værktøjer til at håndtere udadreagerende adfærd.
  • Robust og tydelig: Du hviler i din professionelle rolle, er psykisk robust og formår at sætte tydelige, men omsorgsfulde rammer.
  • Nysgerrig og reflekterende: Du ser bag om adfærden og søger at forstå de underliggende årsager til barnets reaktioner.
  • Holdspiller: Du bidrager aktivt til teamet med gåpåmod og en positiv indstilling.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til tegnsprog eller Tegn til Tale (TTT), men det vigtigste er din lyst til at lære det – vi sørger for oplæringen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor du bidrager til trivsel og læring hos børn og unge med forskellige ressourcer og potentialer
  • Et fællesskab med humor, kollegial sparring, og hvor et godt sammenhold, vægtes højt
  • Et team med stort engagement og villighed til at hjælpe hinanden
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel, dialog, samarbejde, og hvor der tilbydes løbende supervision
  • Undervisning i tegnsprog som en integreret del af din kompetenceudvikling.
Arbejdstider

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer. Som personale dækker vi vagter i huset alle årets dage, døgnet rundt. Dette betyder, at du vil indgå i et vagtrul, hvor der forekommer både dagvagter, aftenvagter, rådighedsvagter (sovende nattevagt med rådighedsfunktion) samt arbejde hver 2. weekend.

På Elevhjemmet er der kultur for gensidig fleksibilitet. Dette betyder, at medarbejderne har gode muligheder for at få indfriet ønsker til arbejdsplanen, men samtidig er der også en pligtopfyldende kultur i forhold til at hjælpe til, hvis der opstår særlige, eller uforudsete behov på arbejdspladsen.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst på området.

Region Syddanmark indhenter offentlig straffeattest ved alle ansættelser på sociale tilbud og specialundervisningstilbud. Da du vil få kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes også børneattest.

Tiltrædelse
Snarest muligt eller senest d. 01.10.2026

Ansøgningsfrist
Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende og senest d. 26.08.2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte os for en uformel snak om stillingen:

  • Vagtplanlægger Emma Olling-Larsen, mail: emma.olling-larsen@rsyd.dk / tlf: 2399 5521
  • Vagtplanlægger Julie Nygaard Petersen, mail: julie.nygaard.petersen@rsyd.dk / tlf: 2360 7203
  • Skoleleder Simon Vaaben, tlf: 2022 9133
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen Pædagog/PA.
Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension som Socialpædagog (Pædagog) i Socialpædagogisk personale ved døgninstitutioner m.v. - overenskomst 32.38.1 - løn pr. 1.4.2026.
Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension som Pædagogisk Assistent (PA) i Omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælpere samt pædagogiske assistenter - overenskomst 34.06.1 - løn pr. 1.4.2026.
Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

title: Lead TechOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Job Responsibilities

Incident Response
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation, responding promptly to major production incidents
  • Serve as the incident coordination hub, assembling relevant teams (R&D, SRE, Security, Risk, PR, CS, etc.), chairing emergency meetings, and driving business recovery
  • Determine incident severity and escalation timing, keeping management informed of incident impact, response progress, recovery expectations, and next steps
  • Unify the factual narrative when information is incomplete, and coordinate with PR and CS on external communications
Incident Post-Mortem & Risk Closure
  • Lead incident post-mortems: reconstruct timelines, document incident impact, response actions, and key decisions
  • Organize technical teams to complete root cause analysis, identify gaps in monitoring/alerting, system resilience, change management, and processes; drive incident classification, accountability assignment, and action item confirmation
  • Track action items to on-time completion, verifying effectiveness through testing, drills, or monitoring data
  • Regularly produce reports on incident trends, recurring issues, and major risks
Process & Capability Building
  • Establish and continuously optimize incident response SOPs, Runbooks, escalation paths, and compliance reporting processes; maintain on-call schedules and escalation chains
  • Organize emergency response training and cross-department drills; drive incident management tooling, data dashboards, and automation capabilities
──────

Who We're Looking For
  • Experience independently leading major incident response, including on-site coordination, management reporting, post-mortems, and risk closure
  • Ability to coordinate multiple technical and business teams without direct authority, continuously driving resolution under pressure
  • Strong technical comprehension — able to understand system architecture, service dependencies, monitoring/alerting, and incident chains, and judge whether root cause analysis and remediation plans are complete
  • Ability to quickly distill key information, deliver concise and clear briefings to management, take ownership of outcomes, and follow through until issues are closed
  • Strong written communication skills — able to produce well-structured post-mortems with factual evidence and clear conclusions
  • Experience with large-scale internet, fintech, payments, trading platforms, or other high-availability systems
  • Working proficiency in English — able to participate in English meetings and handle routine written communication
  • Willingness to accept 24/7 on-call rotation
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience in crypto, exchanges, payments, or financial trading systems
  • Experience in SRE, production operations, technical support, or reliability engineering
  • Familiarity with PagerDuty, Datadog, Grafana, or similar monitoring and alerting tools
  • Familiarity with ITIL, Incident Management, or Problem Management frameworks

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Research Fellow (Photo(electro)catalysis)
description:
The School of Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) provides a vibrant and nurturing environment for staff and students to carry out inter-disciplinary research in key areas such as Computational Materials Science, Characterisation Materials Science, Defence Composite Materials, Functional Composite Materials, Energy, Nanomaterials, Low Dimensional Materials, Biomaterials Materials, Biological Materials, Bioinspired Materials and Sustainable Materials.

The Andrei laboratory develops unconventional approaches to renewable energy harvesting, focusing on solar-driven conversion of small building blocks into useful fuels and chemicals. To this end, our team specializes in rational (photo)electrocatalyst design to increase device efficiency and steer product selectivity, moisture encapsulation techniques to improve stability, as well as reactor engineering towards real-world applications. Our recent highlights include the introduction of floating artificial leaves, pixelated oxide-based photocathodes for long-term hydrogen production, thermoelectric modules for solar waste heat harvesting, or perovskite-silicon devices for light-driven chemical synthesis.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/mse/research.

We are seeking to hire a Research Fellow to develop photo(electro)catalytic (PEC) systems for unassisted solar fuel and chemical synthesis. The role will focus on developing PEC artificial leaves and nanoparticle photocatalysts for water splitting, CO2 reduction and oxidative organic reactions. The successful candidate will contribute to setting up a state-of-the-art photo(electro)catalytic characterization platform including a solar light simulator, potentiostat, customized PEC cell and gas chromatograph. The candidate will also contribute to establishing and maintaining reproducible procedures for gas and liquid product quantification, and benchmarking demonstrator devices under outdoor conditions. The applicant is expected to develop novel concepts in the areas outlined below, by combining their own expertise with the core capabilities of the lab.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in conducting research projects with team members to ensure completion of deliverables
  • Produce high quality reports and documents that consolidate research findings
  • Develop a bespoke photo(electro)catalytic characterisation setup and protocols for product analysis
  • Maintenance of equipment and supplies that include procurement and liaison with suppliers
  • Work together with internal and external collaborators on sustainable technologies
  • Daily mentoring of junior group members

Job Requirements:

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or related fields
  • Proficiency in perovskite device/oxide photoelectrode fabrication, or nanoparticle photocatalyst/quantum dot/nanocrystal synthesis is essential
  • Expertise in photo(electro)catalytic experiments, catalyst synthesis, organic and gas product analysis (gas chromatography, NMR, HPLC) is highly desirable
  • Expertise in 3D CAD rendering, reactor engineering or organic synthesis is desirable but not essential
  • Competency in data analysis, plotting and interpretation, manuscript drafting
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, excellent organizational and time management skills

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Accountancy deeltijd WO
description:
Wil jij werken en studeren combineren met het deeltijd wo-traject Accountancy bij Joanknecht in Eindhoven? Met ons duale wo-programma werk je aan uitdagende opdrachten én volg je academisch onderwijs aan de universiteit. Zo ontwikkel jij je fulltime, terwijl je waardevolle werkervaring opbouwt in de accountancy. Klaar voor een vliegende start van jouw carrière? Solliciteer direct op ons deeltijd accountancy traject!

Een dag als Associate Audit bij Joanknecht

Via het praktijkgerichte deeltijdtraject Accountancy combineer je studeren met werken. Na het behalen van je vwo-diploma, werk je vier dagen per week en volg je één dag per week college. Je leert in een omgeving waar theorie en praktijk elkaar versterken: wat je op vrijdag in de collegebanken leert, pas je direct toe in je werk. Zo bouw je al vroeg aan je professionele ervaring én aan je carrière.

Je werkt in wisselende teams, bezoekt klanten, analyseert en controleert financiële gegevens en leert hoe bedrijfsprocessen in elkaar zitten. Door de afwisseling in werkzaamheden en de directe toepassing van je kennis ontwikkel je je snel, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Je krijgt al vroeg verantwoordelijkheid en wordt goed begeleid door ervaren professionals die je meenemen in het werkveld. Daarnaast volg je trainingen die je helpen groeien in je rol, van vakinhoudelijke vaardigheden tot communicatie en samenwerking.

Het traject is zeer geschikt voor studenten met vwo-niveau die liever leren door te doen dan fulltime studeren. Je hoeft niet per se een studiebol te zijn: motivatie groeit zodra je merkt wat je al kunt bereiken.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een leerzame werkplek waar je begeleid wordt door ervaren professionals.

  • Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, ook als je niet fulltime wilt studeren — wij helpen je op weg!

  • Een combinatie van praktijkervaring en theoretische verdieping, waarbij je 4 dagen meewerkt in de praktijk en 1 dag in de week je kennis verrijkt aan Nyenrode. Deze opleiding betalen wij. Meer informatie over het traject: Bachelor of Science in Accountancy in deeltijd

  • Toegang tot de Joanknecht Academy voor workshops, specialistische trainingen en opleidingen bij hogescholen en universiteiten.

  • Je werkt voor een breed klantenbestand in de Brainport regio, van familiebedrijven tot internationale organisaties.

  • De mogelijkheid om tijdens werktijd als vrijwilliger bij te dragen aan maatschappelijke projecten via de Joanknecht Foundation.

  • De ruimte om met eigen ideeën te komen en deel te nemen aan projecten buiten je vakgebied.

  • Flexibele werktijden en werken bij klanten op locatie of op ons mooie kantoor!

  • Een marktconform salaris, 29 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband), goede pensioenregeling, keuze tussen mobiliteitsbudget of leaseauto en een leasefiets, maandelijkse massages, en elke dag verse lunch en fruit op kantoor.

Dit neem je mee

  • Een vwo-diploma met wiskunde A of B.

  • Affiniteit met cijfers en economische vakken.

  • Een sterk analytisch vermogen.

  • Doorzettingsvermogen, ook als het even tegenzit!

  • Communicatief vaardig en jezelf goed kunnen uitdrukken in woord en schrift in het Nederlands. Goede beheersing van de Engelste taal is een pré.

  • Praktisch ingesteld en leert door te doen.

Leer onze mensen kennen!

Onze organisatie is 175 collega’s sterk, met diverse specialistische kennis om allerlei verschillende klanten in de Brainport regio te kunnen bedienen. Met verschillende ervaringsniveaus van stagiair tot ervaren accountant, hebben we veel kennis in huis om collega’s goed te begeleiden en te ondersteunen in de ontwikkeling. Bij Joanknecht houden we van teamwork én gezelligheid. Van koffiemomenten tot onze vrijdagmiddagborrel in de lounge, dus je leert je collega’s snel kennen! Lees ook onze medewerkersverhalen om te zien hoe het is om deel uit te maken van ons team.

Maak het verschil bij Joanknecht

Neem gerust contact op met onze recruiters om de mogelijkheden te bespreken, via werkenbij@joanknecht.nl of 040 844 7000!

title: Research Fellow (Environmental Engineering/Microbiology)
description:

title: Government Escalation Advisor
description:
About Us

Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer-centric financial super-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in the region and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA and Amazon, as well as small and medium businesses.

Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.

Your Role

We are looking for a Government Escalation Advisor to join our Customer Experience team in the UAE. In this role, you will be the accountable UAE-based point of contact for complaints escalated through regulatory channels — including Sanadak (Central Bank of the UAE Ombudsman Unit) and the AECB Dispute & Complaints Management framework.

You will act as the reviewer and submitter of record for all regulator-facing case responses, ensuring that Tamara meets its obligations to CBUAE and other regulatory bodies with accuracy, quality and within required timelines. This is a compliance-critical role that carries personal accountability under UAE regulatory requirements.

This role is on-site based in Dubai and requires the holder to be a UAE resident with a valid Emirates ID.

Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Tamara's designated UAE-based complaints reviewer and submitter for all cases raised through Sanadak and, as it goes live, the AECB Dispute & Complaints Management platform.
  • Review case investigations and draft responses prepared by the Care Operations maker team, validate the quality, accuracy and completeness of the response, and submit final responses to the regulator within required timelines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for direct calls, queries and clarifications from Sanadak, AECB and CBUAE case officers during business hours.
  • Track and manage regulator-driven case SLAs; escalate any cases at risk of breach to the Head of Care Operations and Compliance ahead of time.
  • Coordinate with the internal Care Operations team, Compliance, Product and Tech teams to ensure the underlying root cause of each escalated complaint is identified and, where relevant, remediated.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready case records for every regulator-facing case, including all correspondence, decisions and supporting evidence.
  • Prepare periodic reports on regulator complaint volumes, resolution rates, SLA adherence and root-cause themes for internal governance and for CBUAE / regulator inspections.
  • Support Care Operations and Compliance in responding to CBUAE audits and inspections, including providing the complaints team org chart, case samples and supporting documentation as requested.
  • Flag process, product or policy gaps surfaced through regulator complaints and drive them to closure through the appropriate internal owners.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Tamara's complaint handling framework in the UAE, including SOPs, decision matrices, response templates and quality standards.

Your Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree, ideally in Business, Law, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years' experience in complaints handling, customer operations, compliance operations, or a regulatory-facing role — ideally within banking, fintech, BNPL, insurance, or another regulated financial services environment.
  • Direct experience handling regulator escalations (Sanadak, CBUAE, SAMA, or equivalent) is strongly preferred.
  • Native or fluent Arabic and strong professional English — both written and spoken.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, factual, regulator-appropriate case responses.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make defensible decisions on case classification, remediation and compensation within a policy framework.
  • Detail-oriented, structured, and able to operate under tight regulator-driven timelines.
  • Comfortable coordinating across multiple internal teams and holding others to timelines without direct reporting authority.
  • UAE resident with a valid Emirates ID (UAE Nationals and Residents welcome).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar case management tools is a plus.

All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

title: Helpende (plus) psychogeriatrie
description:
Maak het verschil in een thuis waar elke dag telt.

Dit ga je doen

Als helpende (plus) op locatie Odendael in Sint-Oedenrode zorg je ervoor dat bewoners zich thuis voelen en iedere dag zoveel mogelijk kunnen leven zoals zij dat graag willen. Je leert bewoners goed kennen, weet wat voor hen belangrijk is en stemt jouw ondersteuning daarop af. Samen met collega's en naasten draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin eigen regie, aandacht en welzijn centraal staan.

Je ondersteunt bewoners vanuit de gedachte: Wat wilt u? Wat kunt u zelf? En waarbij kan ik u ondersteunen? Zo help je bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf te blijven doen en maak je iedere dag van betekenis.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

  • Persoonlijke verzorging en begeleiding. Je ondersteunt bewoners bij de dagelijkse verzorging, zoals wassen, aankleden en eten. Als helpende plus reik je daarnaast medicatie aan en dien je deze toe.

  • Bijdragen aan welbevinden. Je creëert een warme, huiselijke sfeer en sluit aan bij de gewoontes, wensen en het ritme van bewoners. Samen zorg je ervoor dat iedere dag zoveel mogelijk voelt als thuis.

  • Samenwerken aan passende zorg. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, familie en andere naasten. Zo bied je ondersteuning die aansluit bij wat voor de bewoner echt belangrijk is en help je hen zoveel mogelijk de regie te behouden.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Misschien wil een bewoner vroeg opstaan voor een bezoek van familie, terwijl een ander liever rustig de dag begint. Jij beweegt mee met wat de bewoner nodig heeft en krijgt de ruimte om daarin je eigen inzicht en creativiteit te gebruiken.

Je bent er op de mooie momenten, maar ook wanneer het leven kwetsbaar is. Met jouw aandacht, betrokkenheid en warme persoonlijkheid bied je bewoners en hun naasten vertrouwen, rust en een vertrouwd gezicht. Juist dat maakt werken op een kleinschalige PG-afdeling zo bijzonder.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd voor 16 tot 36 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw beschikbaarheid;

  • Als helpende een salaris en FWG 25 en als helpende plus een salaris in FWG 30 volgens cao VVT;

  • Aandacht voor jouw gezondheid en vitaliteit, onder andere met gratis fruit op de werkvloer;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling, 8% vakantiegeld, collectieve verzekeringen en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% (dat is een volledige dertiende maand);

  • Goede begeleiding en een tal van opleidingsmogelijkheden door onze eigen academie en via het online learning platform van GoodHabitz;

  • Meerkeuze in arbeidsvoorwaarden met fiscaal voordeel, zoals een laptop- of fietsregeling;

Dit ben jij

Je hebt een diploma tot helpende of helpende plus.

Daarnaast

  • Zie jij de mens achter de zorgvraag en haal je energie uit het creëren van een fijne dag;

  • Stimuleer je eigen regie en kijk je naar wat de bewoners zelf nog kunnen, waarbij je ondersteunt waar nodig;

  • Ben je betrokken en werk je graag samen met collega’s, familie en naasten om de bewoners de best passende zorg en ondersteuning te bieden.

title: Ombudsman, Banking and Finance (Small Business & Transactions)
description:
AFCA’s Banking & Finance (Small Business and Transactions) team is looking for an Ombudsman to join its team. The Small Business & Transactions team and the Banking & Finance team form part of AFCA’s broader banking team. The Small Business & Transactions team focusses on complaints involving small business (e.g. loans, merchant payments and general banking relationship) and also complaints involving banking and payment transactions more generally (e.g. scams, account restrictions and closures, recalls, recharges, KYC questions), across consumer and small business accounts and payments services.

We are looking for an Ombudsman to join our busy and collegiate decision-making team to help resolve standard and complex banking and finance disputes, with a focus on either small business or transactions related issues. The Small Business & Transactions team is managed by Lead Ombudsman, Suanne Russell, and this role reports to a Senior Ombudsman in the team.

The role will would suit senior legally qualified professionals with a strong track record of significant achievement and particularly with a background in the banking and finance sector. You are likely to be at a stage of your career where you have an interest in using your well-developed skills and experience in a role which contributes to good community outcomes in the banking and finance sector.

Your role will be to make decisions, individually or as part of a panel, on standard and complex complaints in accordance with the AFCA rules and fairness principles. The decisions are likely to make a real difference and influence the banking and finance industry as they are binding on them when accepted by the complainant.

You will also have the opportunity to provide professional and technical leadership across AFCA and to coach and mentor Adjudicators, case workers and others. There may also be opportunities to develop AFCA approaches, and to present at external conferences as a subject matter expert. The role also involves supporting AFCA’s relationships with small business and consumer groups, government bodies, regulators, AFCA members, member organisations and other Ombudsman networks.

This is a Board appointed role.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Legal qualifications and a significant track record of achievement at senior executive level within the banking and finance industry or a tribunal, EDR scheme, regulatory agency or related business entity or in private practice
  • Strong analytical skills, the ability to quickly get to the heart of complex issues and to efficiently and independently handle a busy caseload, with a clear outcomes focus
  • A demonstrated high level of written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with a wide cross-section of the insurance sector and the broader community.
  • Resilience, focus, determination and excellent engagement skills and the ability to effectively manage challenges, external criticism and public scrutiny.
  • Silver AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

title: Sygeplejerske til aftenvagt
description:
Trives du med at arbejde om aftenen? Kan du se værdien i at være en del af helhedsplejen omkring vores beboere? Så er det måske lige netop dig vi leder efter.

På Lindegården søger en flok engagerede kolleger, der alle dyrker det faglige fællesskab og holdånden, dig, der vil være med til at videreudvikle vores dejlige arbejdsplads.

Stillingen er på 37 timer i fast aftenvagt. Har du ønske om enkelte dagvagter kan dette imødekommes. Vi er flexible omkring timetallet, så ønsker du færre timer kan vi imødekomme dette. Du kan forvente at skulle arbejde hver 4. weekend.

Som sygeplejerske i fast aftenvagt bliver du en del af det fremmøde der er i afdelingen. Dvs du er en del af de opgaver der er i afdelingen, som kan være alt fra at gøre aftensmad klar, hjælpe beboere med toiletbesøg, hjælpe beboere i seng, dokumentere i vores omsorgssystem CURA mm. Derudover vil du have en tilkaldefunktion fra de andre afdelinger på Lindegården, hvor du kan blive kaldt ud til vurdering af dårlige beboere, medicinændringer, palliativ pleje og hvad der ellers måtte komme af sygeplejefaglige opgaver i løbet af en aften.

I afdelingen hvor vi søger en sygeplejerske til fast aftenvagt er der 13 beboere. Dine kollegaer vil være en blanding af SOSU-assistenter, sosu-hjælpere, ufaglærte og sygeplejersker. Desuden har vi elever fra sosuskolen, som også kan være en del af fremmødet om aftenen.

Flere gange om ugen har afdelingen fast tilstedeværelse af terapeuter i forhold til det fysiske arbejdsmiljø og vejledning i brug af de mange hjælpemidler. Derudover har vi tilknyttet en centerlæge, som kommer fast i afdelingen hver 2. uge.

På Lindegården arbejder vi alle ud fra Marte Meo metoden og vi har siden 2019 været certificeret som Marte Meo plejecenter. Der findes på landsplan kun to plejecentre, der er Marte Meo certificeret og de er begge placeret i Herning Kommune.

At arbejde med Marte Meo metoden oplever vi som en stor styrkelse af fagligheden. Metoden er dynamisk og tager udgangspunkt i hverdagssituationer fra praksis, hvor filmoptagelser gør det muligt at få øje på, hvad der lykkes i de aktuelle samspil og derved give præcis den støtte og hjælp beboeren har brug for til at opnå følelsen af at mestre livet. Marte Meo metoden fremmer trivslen hos beboerne og styrker arbejdsglæden hos personalet

Din arbejdsdag vil være alsidig og vi forventer, at du som sygeplejerske kan bidrage med:
  • At indgå i den daglige helhedspleje herunder sygepleje til beboere med komplekse problemstillinger, tage ansvar for koordinering og strukturering samt prioritere tid og opgaver.
  • Tage lederskab på det faglige område.
  • Gode kommunikative evner og kan skabe relationer præget af respekt, samarbejde og anerkendelse.
  • At sikre dokumentation i Herning kommunes dokumentations system CURA, udarbejde og følge op på sygeplejefaglige handleplaner i samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Sikre kvalitet i medicinhåndtering.
  • Tidlig opsporing af sygdom og forebyggelse af indlæggelser.
  • Tæt og involverende samarbejde med beboerne, pårørende, kolleger, frivillige og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • Støtte, rådgive, undervise og udvikle med henblik på stadig kompetenceudvikling i personalegruppen samt uddannelsen af studerende og elever i afdelingen.
  • At medvirke til et godt arbejds- og læringsmiljø og have øje for trivsel.

Vi tilbyder dig:
  • En alsidig og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor kompetenceudvikling, trivsel og samarbejde er i fokus.
  • Plads til og respekt for forskellighed.
  • En god introduktion og løbende undervisning.
  • Introduktion til og oplæring i Marte Meo metoden.
  • Åbenhed, imødekommenhed og hjælpsomhed.
  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter værdighed højt.

title: Klinisk sygeplejespecialist til Dagkirurgisk afsnit OLAV og Modtageafsnit O4, Ortopædkirurgisk Afdeling O, OUH
description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens sygepleje og styrke de dagkirurgiske og elektive patientforløb på OUH?

Vi søger en engageret og udviklingsorienteret klinisk sygeplejespecialist til Dagkirurgisk afsnit OLAV og Modtageafsnit O4 med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at kombinere klinisk praksis med faglig udvikling og kompetenceudvikling af sygeplejersker i en højt specialiseret afdeling, hvor innovation, kvalitet og patientcentrerede forløb er i fokus.

Om stillingen Som klinisk sygeplejespecialist bliver du en central drivkraft i udviklingen af sygeplejen på tværs af flere kirurgiske specialer. Du bliver medansvarlig for at understøtte og implementere evidensbaseret sygepleje samt sikre fortsat kompetenceudvikling blandt afdelingens sygeplejersker.

Stillingen er nyoprettet i OLAV/O4, og du får derfor en unik mulighed for at være med til at forme funktionens indhold og rolle i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Udvikling af sygeplejen på tværs af specialerne
  • Oplæring og kompetenceudvikling af plejepersonale med afsæt i kompetencekort og MySkills
  • Udvikling af fremtidens dagkirurgiske patientforløb med fokus på Nyt OUH
  • Styrkelse af sygeplejerskers kliniske karriereveje
  • Implementering af evidensbaseret sygepleje i klinisk praksis
  • Facilitering af læring, refleksion og supervision af kolleger
  • Deltagelse i og ledelse af forbedrings- og udviklingsprojekter
Du vil indgå i et tæt samarbejde med oversygeplejersker, øvrige kliniske sygeplejespecialister, specialeansvarlige sygeplejersker og stedfortrædere for oversygeplejersken omkring den faglige og organisatoriske udvikling.

Stillingen er en kombinationsstilling med både kliniske funktioner og dedikeret udviklingstid.

Om OLAV/O4 OLAV/O4 er en del af Ortopædkirurgisk Afdeling O på OUH og udgør ét af ti teams på Ortopædkirurgisk Operationsgang.

Vi modtager børn og voksne inden for følgende specialer:

O – Ortopædkirurgi

  • Dagkirurgiske patienter
  • Elektive patienter med efterfølgende indlæggelse
L – Urologi

  • Dagkirurgiske patienter
  • Elektive patienter med efterfølgende indlæggelse på urologisk sengeafsnit
A – Abdominalkirurgi

  • Dagkirurgiske patienter
V – Anæstesiologi

  • Opvågning og hjemsendelse af dagkirurgiske patienter


Vi er en engageret personalegruppe med bred faglig viden og et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, udvikling og samarbejde. Sammen arbejder vi målrettet med at optimere patientforløb og skabe de bedst mulige forudsætninger for patienternes behandling og oplevelse.

Som afdeling er vi kendetegnet ved en høj social kapital, hvor tillid, respekt og samarbejde danner grundlag for vores fælles opgaveløsning. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af funktioner, faggrupper og specialer og arbejder tæt sammen med læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige samarbejdspartnere om at skabe sammenhængende og effektive patientforløb.

Vi værner om et arbejdsmiljø, hvor høj faglighed går hånd i hånd med arbejdsglæde, nærvær og humor. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer og et godt kollegialt fællesskab er en forudsætning for både trivsel, udvikling og kvalitet i patientbehandlingen, og derfor ser vi udvikling som et fælles ansvar, hvor alles kompetencer bringes i spil.

Vi tilbyder
  • En spændende og udviklingsorienteret stilling i en højt specialiseret afdeling
  • Mulighed for at sætte tydelige faglige aftryk på fremtidens sygepleje
  • Stor indflydelse på udviklingen af dagkirurgiske patientforløb frem mod Nyt OUH
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger
  • Tæt samarbejde med ledelse, kliniske specialister og specialeansvarlige sygeplejersker
  • Fokus på kompetenceudvikling, karriereplanlægning og faglig sparring
  • En afdeling med ambitioner om kontinuerlig læring og udvikling
Vi søger en kollega, der
  • Er autoriseret sygeplejerske
  • Har relevant master- eller kandidatuddannelse
  • Har solid klinisk erfaring, gerne inden for kirurgisk sygepleje
  • Har stærke pædagogiske kompetencer og erfaring med undervisning, vejledning og supervision
  • Er dygtig til at formidle faglig viden og omsætte evidens til praksis
  • Trives med udviklings- og forbedringsarbejde
  • Kan tænke innovativt og omsætte idéer til handling
  • Har gennemslagskraft og evnen til at skabe engagement omkring udviklingsopgaver
  • Ønsker at være en synlig faglig rollemodel for kollegerne

title: Product Marketeer
description:
Als Product Marketeer ben je de onmisbare schakel in elke productlancering bij Locinox. Je duikt diep in onze innovatieve producten, begrijpt ze tot in de kleinste technische details en vertaalt die complexiteit moeiteloos naar een helder, sterk en begrijpbaar klantverhaal.

Je vormt de cruciale brug tussen Sales, Marketing en Product Management en zorgt ervoor dat elk product met maximale impact in de markt wordt gezet. Je beheert de volledige go-to-market roadmap van concept tot lancering. In deze rol rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Marketing Director.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • In jouw rol als Product Marketeer coördineer en stuur je het volledige traject van de product launches, waarbij je de planning, verschillende milestones en deliverables nauwgezet opvolgt. In deze rol krijg je de kans om de NPI-meetings met de verschillende interne stakeholders te leiden.
  • De volledige ownership opnemen rond de interne productcommunicatie. Enerzijds train je ons salesteam en externe partners en anderzijds ondersteun je ons marketingteam in het ontwikkelen van consistente content op onze verschillende kanalen.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met product management en geeft jouw input vanuit de markt. Bij eventuele productaanpassingen neem je het heft in handen om uniformiteit te garanderen. Je bewaakt de correctheid, volledigheid en consistentie van alle productinformatie.
  • Je brengt heldere en overtuigende value propositions en vertrekt steeds vanuit de ‘why’: je zet de technische features om naar concrete voordelen voor de klant. Deze vertaalslag van technische informatie naar begrijpbare en commercieel sterke communicatie is van groot belang.

Wat breng je mee als Product Marketeer?

  • Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Marketing, Business Administration of Communications
  • 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in product marketing binnen een B2B-omgeving (link met technische producten is een grote troef)
  • Kennis en ervaring met PIM (Perfion, Akeneo, Salsify) is een grote plus
  • Andere tools: CMS, Microsoft 365, DAM, ODS of ERP
  • Je communiceert vloeiend in NL en EN; Frans en/of Duits zijn een plus

Wat je krijgt als Product Marketeer bij Locinox:

  • Een competitieve verloning met bijhorende extralegale voordelen (maaltijdcheques van €8, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, CAO90, ecocheques …), afgestemd op jouw ervaring en kennis
  • Je komt terecht in een internationale B2B-werkomgeving die bezig is aan een heel mooi groeiverhaal. Een team van Builders of Better!
  • Een uitdagende functie met de nodige verantwoordelijkheid en interactie met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
Around the world, SYSTRA’s specialists plan, design, integrate, test, commission, project manage and deliver mass transit and mobility solutions that are relied on by more than 50 million people every day.

For more than 60 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their transport infrastructure with sustainability, accessibility and innovation at the heart of our designs. With over 10,300 colleagues globally and around 1000 in the UK & Ireland we are growing significantly and seeking out the very best talent to join the SYSTRA signature team and be part of leading the way in infrastructure design.

Context

We are looking for a Senior Design Manager with demonstrable experience of delivering projects for water company clients in the regulated water sector to support programme and project delivery. The individual should be capable of leading complex packages of work, coordinating multidisciplinary inputs and maintaining strong client relationships.

Missions/Main Duties

The postholder will lead the design delivery of allocated water sector work packages, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality, regulatory and client standards. They will apply effective project controls, monitor progress against programme and budget, and ensure compliance with relevant health, safety and environmental legislation, including CDM Regulations, while supporting the delivery of safe, efficient and sustainable outcomes across water and wastewater projects.

Working closely with clients, project teams, contractors and stakeholders, the postholder will:

  • coordinate resources
  • manage the flow of design information and support collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
  • contribute to planning, procurement, reporting, tender preparation and stakeholder engagement,
  • promote high standards of technical delivery and behaviours aligned with SYSTRA’s values of excellence, respect, empowerment and teamwork.

The postholder will also maintain effective financial and project controls across allocated projects, including the preparation and management of forecasts, cost and revenue budgets, and resource allocation plans. They will ensure that changes to fees, programme or scope are properly managed and documented, and will provide clear reporting to the Project Manager on programme performance, resource requirements and budget status to support efficient, well-controlled project delivery.

Profile/Skills

Skills and KnowledgeStrong leadership, interpersonal and communication skills, with good commercial awareness.Good client, stakeholder and relationship management skills.Knowledge of systems and procedures that support high-quality, safe and environmentally responsible project delivery.Knowledge of BIM, CAD, project controls and analysis tools, resource management systems, Integrated Management Systems, and current HSE/CDM legislation.

ExperienceExperience in the design delivery of civil or water engineering work packages, with a focus on client requirements, value for money and innovation.Experience in developing and maintaining resource allocation plans, applying project controls and procedures, and monitoring progress against programme and budget.Experience in project controls, programming, monitoring and reporting.Experience in the development, review and application of design management documentation, including compliance with Integrated Management Systems.Experience in supporting contract preparation, project planning and programming.Experience in supervising and supporting team members, including Assistant Project Managers, Graduates and Apprentices, while assisting engineering or project management as required.Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary design teams, including UK-based and overseas teams, as well as contract partners, to achieve project objectives.

QualificationsDegree qualified in Civil Engineering, Water Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.Chartered Engineer status (CEng), or working towards chartership with a recognised engineering institution such as ICE, IMechE or equivalent.A project or programme management qualification would be advantageous.
