title: Shock Responsive Social Protection (SRSP) Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

Save the Children believes every child deserves a future. In Bhutan and around the world, we give children a healthy start in life, the opportunity to learn and protection from harm. We do whatever it takes for children – every day and in times of crisis – transforming their lives and future we share. Save the Children expects that anyone associated with it abides by its Safeguarding and other Zero Tolerance Policies.

Under the guidance of the Senior Shock Responsive Social Protection Coordinator and the Head of Field Programme Operations at the Surkhet Field Office, The position holder will be responsible for implementing Save the Children’s component of the People in Need (PIN)-led consortium project, Pratibaddha IV: Whole-of-Society Approach to Strengthening and Scaling Shock Responsive and Anticipatory Multi Hazard Preparedness and Response in Western Nepal, across the project districts of Sudurpaschim, Karnali, and Lumbini Provinces. The position holder will be responsible for coordinating with the SCI team, PIN, other consortium partners, and government stakeholders at the district and local levels to plan, implement, and monitor project activities in accordance with the agreed Detailed Implementation Plan (DIP), ensuring that the required technical support is provided. The position holder will also be responsible for ensuring the implementation of the MEAL plan, documenting and promoting project learning for scale-up, and enhancing the visibility of Save the Children’s work on Shock Responsive Social Protection (SRSP).

In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

Technical Assistance and Quality Assurance:
  • Serve as the district and local level technical focal person for Shock-Responsive Social Protection (SRSP) within the context of Disaster Risk Management (DRM) governance.
  • Facilitate and coordinate capacity-building activities in collaboration with PIN and the Senior Shock Responsive Social Protection Coordinator, based on the capacity-building plan and in alignment with project outputs and indicators.
  • Lead the development and/or revision of SRSP-related Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and guidelines at the district and local level.
  • Make regular field visits and ensure the quality, identify best practices, identify issues to be addressed, and share with Senior Shock Responsive Social Protection Coordinator to seek technical advice
  • Ensure the use of consolidated multi hazard and multi-sector risk assessment tools/guidelines that fits in line with the SCI CSP, MEAL plan and learning from stakeholders.
  • Facilitate the SRSP part at the district and local level workshops and trainings
  • Lead the thematic discussion on SRSP at district level including mandates, roles and responsibilities, coordinating arrangements, challenges and proposed solutions
  • Support multihazard risk analysis embedding social protection database

Project management /implementation:
  • Support to prepare and implement SRSP readiness action plan prioritize by targeted local governments
  • Takes lead role at district and local levels in delivery of SCI component in a consortium led by PIN and ensure SRSP result is delivered and is integrated in other results of the project
  • Ensure timely and quality technical support is available to the partner’s team on SRSP activities at the district and local levels through implementation of DIP.
  • Ensure the effective and efficient implementation of the project grants
  • Liaising closely with the field team, ensure clear roles, responsibilities and timelines are set for all project requirements such as reports, budget realignments etc.
  • Ensure development and implementation of project /detail implementation plans and budgets, procurement plans and provide guidance and solutions to problems to ensure smooth, quality implementation of MEAL plan and achievement of log-frame objectives and results.
Coordination:
  • Coordinate closely with consortium partners to ensure implementation of SCI deliverables
  • Build good working relationships with all the stakeholders working in Anticipatory Action and SRSP at district and local levels and across other teams within SCI
  • Work closely with the implementing partner deployed by PIN for the implementation of the SCI component of the project
  • Coordinate with local government and district government
  • Work with logistic team to ensure that programme supply needs are clearly defined and coordinated for implementation

Advocacy:
  • Coordinate with districts, municipalities and relevant stakeholders
  • Work as a district and local level focal point to coordinate with consortium partners
  • Development and implementationof advocacy strategy at the local levels

Documentation and reporting:

  • Conduct field visits to prepare high quality learning documents and reports as per SC and the donor’s requirements and timely submit to related stakeholders
  • Ensure quality progress reports and learning documentation are prepared and share them at appropriate level
  • Keep Senior Shock Responsive Social Protection Coordinator abreast regularly on the progress, consult for key decisions and way forward in the area responsible for.
  • Work with programme teams to ensure that reports are delivered according to SC and donor contractual requirements, within the agreed timescale and budget.
  • Ensure the compliance of programmes with internal SC requirements and any relevant external donor requirements

Qualifications and Experience:

  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in DRR/humanitarian/social protection sectors
  • Master’s degree with 3 years of experience or bachelor’s degree with 5 years of experience in relevant areas such as disaster risk management, social policy, social sciences or equivalent.
  • Solid project delivery, implementation, and monitoring skills with a proven history of delivering results
  • Experience of working on shock responsive social protection, anticipatory action, DRR and emergency preparedness work
  • Good understanding of shock responsive social protection, anticipatory action, DRR and Humanitarian programming or relevant thematic area
  • Proven experience in coordination with municipalities, district stakeholders’ other government partners and the ability to lead, motivate and develop others
  • Ability to analyze information, evaluate options and to think and plan strategically
  • Effective interpersonal skills including leadership skills and ability to motivate those line managed by you and provide constructive feedback on performance
  • Fluency written and spoken English and Nepali, as well as excellent report writing skills
  • Commitment to and understanding of Save the Children’s aims, values and principles including rights- based approaches

Desirable

  • Worked within the NGO community, donor agencies and government departments in relevant role
  • Ability and willingness to stay and travel to any parts of the country

Skills

  • Information Management
  • Communication
  • Coordination
  • Negotiation
  • Communication
  • Relationship Building
  • Report Writing

Required No.(s): 1 (Nepalese Citizen Only)

Contract length: Fixed Term

Location: Surkhet Field Office

The Organisation

We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard.

We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:

  • No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday
  • All children learn from a quality basic education and that,
  • Violence against children is no longer tolerated

We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive workplace where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

Application Information

Please apply using a cover letter and up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations.


We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our global anti-harassment policy.

Save the Children does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineer, Portugal
description:
Role highlights:

  • Role: Full Stack AI Software Engineer

  • Department: Engineering

  • Location: Portugal (Lisbon), must be based in-country

  • Reports to: CEO ICEYE Portugal

  • Working type: Hybrid

  • Career path: Launchpad into ICEYE's Forward Deployed Engineering track (embedded, customer-facing, higher travel)

  • Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances

  • Excellent communication skills in English, and C2 / near-native proficiency in Portuguese.

Why this role matters

You are the technical engine of ICEYE Portugal. You build the software that turns raw satellite intelligence into mission-critical decisions, full-stack, from robust data models to intuitive interfaces. This isn't just a feature-building role; you are architecting the reliability and scale required for global intelligence operations.

This is also a launchpad. It is where strong engineers build deep product and platform expertise and then grow into Forward Deployed Engineers, embedded directly with defence and intelligence customers, deploying and developing ICEYE's platform in the field. We are hiring builders who want the foundations now and the frontier next.

The Technical Challenges You’ll Tackle

We are architecting systems at the intersection of earth observation intelligence and distributed AI. You will own the implementation of complex services designed for high-stakes, resource-constrained operational environments, including:

  • Deterministic Agentic Orchestration: Engineering stateful, multi-agent workflows that move beyond simple inference to provide reliable outcomes in non-deterministic environments. You will build systems that resolve cross-modal semantic conflicts between high-resolution SAR signatures and heterogeneous SIGINT/OSINT feeds directly at the edge.

  • Geospatial RAG & Distributed Vector Consistency: Architecting hybrid RAG systems that maintain strict semantic alignment and vector consistency across air-gapped and DDIL (Denied, Disrupted, Intermittent, and Limited) environments, ensuring mission-critical data remains actionable without persistent cloud connectivity.

  • High-Concurrency Spatial Engineering: Optimizing geospatial data performance via advanced indexing and query tuning to enable ultra-low latency spatial analysis over massive satellite datasets within highly constrained hardware profiles.

  • AI & Mission Intelligence: Integrate AI into real workflows and products where it improves decisions and use AI-native engineering tooling day to day including services, APIs, and data flows that are reliable, observable, and scalable across cloud and on-prem environments.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 2–7 years of professional software engineering, shipping production systems end to end.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Aerospace, Electrical / Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Full-stack capability: strong backend (Python required, plus a typed language such as Go, TypeScript, or Rust) and comfort building modern web front ends (e.g., React / TypeScript).

  • Strong systems architecture fundamentals: designing services, APIs, and data flows that are reliable, observable, and scalable.

  • Solid database design and data modelling (relational, ideally spatial), able to write and optimise SQL.

  • Fully proficient with AI: building on LLMs, RAG, and AI-powered workflows, and working fluently with AI-native engineering tools.

  • Networking foundations: comfortable reasoning about protocols, latency, and data movement across networks.

  • Hands-on with Linux and Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.

  • High-intensity builder mindset: you thrive on shipping fast, iterating based on real-world mission needs, and owning the outcome of your code.

  • Excellent communication in English (written and spoken), plus C2 / near-native Portuguese.

  • Eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing (GDAL, Rasterio, PostGIS, GeoJSON, COG, Cesium).

  • Experience with observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), event-driven systems (e.g., NATS), and auth standards (OAuth, OIDC, JWT).

  • Experience in model inference and throughput optimization on local hardware

  • Experience deploying to secure / isolated / air-gapped environments.

  • Experience in defence, intelligence, or government operational environments.

  • Signal / RF, embedded, or edge-to-cloud systems background (EE / aerospace crossover).

  • Genuine interest in a Forward Deployed path — working embedded with customers on mission-critical problems.

Application process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Take home task

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Hiring Team Interview

  • Offer Decision


Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com

title: Pedagogisch Professional VVE El Amien 1
description:
Dit is jouw plek

Voorschool El Amien 1 in Amsterdam Osdorp is er voor nieuwsgierige peuters van 2 tot 4 jaar. Spel staat bij ons centraal: kinderen ontdekken, bewegen en leren in een omgeving die uitnodigt tot ontwikkeling.

We werken met het Voor- en Vroegschoolse Educatie (VVE) programma Piramide Digitaal, dat aansluit op het basisonderwijs. Binnen dit programma werken we aan taal, sociale vaardigheden en de eerste rekenprikkels.

We werken met een enthousiast team van professionals. Bovendien is de locatie goed bereikbaar met de fiets en het openbaar vervoer.

Je komt op de locatie te werken op meerdere stampgroepen en jouw werkdagen zien als volgt eruit;

Maandag ochtend: of taakuren van 08.00 – 12.30 of combinatie functie van 08.30 tot 12.30.

Maandagmiddag van 13:00-18:15 uur groep E naast F. (zelfde collega als donderdag) in groepsruimte 2

Dinsdag ochtend: of taakuren van 08.00 – 12.30 of combinatie functie van 08.30 tot 12.30.

Dinsdagmiddag van 13:00-18:15 uur. Groep F naast collega D. in groepsruimte 2

Donderdagmiddag: 13.00 – 18.15 Groep A naast collega F(zelfde collega als maandag). in groepsruimte 1
Vrijdagochtend: van 07:45-13:00 uur. Groep B naast collega N. in groepsruimte 1

Zo ziet jouw dag eruit

Je begeleidt een groep van maximaal 16 peuters volgens een vast dagritme en een doordacht educatief programma samen met een collega. Met leuke activiteiten stimuleer je hun ontwikkeling en bereid je hen stap voor stap voor op een fijne overgang naar de basisschool.

Je hebt oog voor de groep en voor het individuele kind. Je betrekt ouders/verzorgers actief bij de ontwikkeling van hun kind(eren).

Samen met je collega’s zorg je voor structuur, warmte en een positieve sfeer, zodat kinderen zich veilig voelen en met plezier leren.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Opleiding: Je hebt een SPW-3/4 diploma of een relevante mbo-opleiding voor de kinderopvang. Check hier of jouw diploma kwalificeert voor de kinderopvang.

  • VVE-certificaat: Je bent in het bezit van een VVE certificaat of je bent bereid om dit te behalen.

  • Taaleis: Je voldoet aan de taaleisen voor de VE-regio Amsterdam, met een minimaal niveau van 3F voor spreken, lezen en luisteren, en 2F voor schrijven.

  • Affiniteit met peuters: Je werkt graag met peuters en vindt het leuk om spelenderwijs bij te dragen aan hun ontwikkeling.

  • Samenwerking: Je bent betrokken, communicatief sterk en werkt graag samen.

  • Maatschappelijke betrokkenheid: Je voelt je thuis in onze maatschappelijke missie en wilt bijdragen aan optimale ontwikkelkansen voor ieder kind.


Dit krijg je van ons

  • Salaris: Een aantrekkelijk salaris volgens cao kinderopvang schaal 6 of 7 tussen € 2.641 en € 3.992 per maand, afhankelijk van je opleiding en werkervaring.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,25 per km met eigen vervoer of 100% vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Zorgverzekering: Een tegemoetkoming in je aanvullende zorgverzekering.

  • Eindejaarsuitkering: 8% extra waardering aan het einde van het jaar.

  • Vakantietoeslag: 8% vakantietoeslag en extra verlof bovenop wettelijke vakantiedagen (144 wettelijke en 66 bovenwettelijke uren bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur).

  • Vitaliteitsbudget: € 200 per jaar om te besteden aan sport, ontspanning of gezondheid.

  • Ontwikkeling: Ruimte om je te blijven ontwikkelen met (interne) scholing, certificaten en het online leerplatform GoodHabitz.

  • Personeelskorting: Voorrang en korting als je kind bij ons naar de opvang gaat.

  • Bonus: Een bonus van € 500 als je een nieuwe collega aanbrengt.

  • Team: Een multicultureel team dat graag samenwerkt, elkaar ondersteunt en met plezier voor de kinderen klaarstaat.

Wie zijn wij?

Ieder kind verdient de beste start. Daarom hebben Akros, Impuls, Combiwel voor Kinderen en Elan de krachten gebundeld in Groep Maatschappelijke Kinderopvang (GMK). We geloven dat door samenwerking tussen kinderopvang, onderwijs en welzijn we samen meer kunnen betekenen voor de ontwikkelkansen van kinderen en gezinnen.

Die missie leeft niet op papier, maar op onze locaties. In de teams die elke dag het verschil maken voor kinderen, ouders/verzorgers en gezinnen in de wijk. Dáár wordt het verschil gemaakt.

Werken bij GMK betekent werken in een organisatie die in beweging is. We bouwen aan duidelijkheid en kwaliteit, en zijn open over wat nog niet af is. Transparantie en vertrouwen staan daarbij voorop. Zo ontstaat er ruimte om te doen waar het om draait: werken voor kinderen en gezinnen in de wijk, in hechte teams waarin collega's elkaar kennen en steunen. De kracht van GMK zit in de combinatie van lokale warmte én slagkracht van een grote maatschappelijke organisatie.

Bij GMK doe je werk dat ertoe doet. Elke dag weer.

Past dit bij jou?

Wil jij samen met ons het verschil maken in het leven van kinderen en gezinnen in Amsterdam? Solliciteer direct!

Ben je nieuwsgierig geworden, maar wil je eerst de sfeer proeven? Je bent van harte welkom om kennis te maken met de locatie. Mail ons via werkenbij@gmk.nl.

title: Senior Shock Responsive Social Protection (SRSP) Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

Save the Children believes every child deserves a future. In Bhutan and around the world, we give children a healthy start in life, the opportunity to learn and protection from harm. We do whatever it takes for children – every day and in times of crisis – transforming their lives and future we share. Save the Children expects that anyone associated with it abides by its Safeguarding and other Zero Tolerance Policies.

Under the guidance of the Humanitarian Manager (POD) and the Head of Field Programme Operations at the Surkhet Field Office, the role will be responsible for leading and implementing Save the Children’s component of the People in Need (PIN)-led consortium project, Pratibaddha IV: Whole-of-Society Approach to Strengthening and Scaling Shock Responsive and Anticipatory Multi Hazard Preparedness and Response in Western Nepal, across Sudurpaschim, Karnali, and Lumbini Provinces. The role will be responsible for coordinating with the SCI team, PIN, other consortium partners, and government stakeholders at the provincial and local levels to plan, implement, and monitor project activities in accordance with the agreed Detailed Implementation Plan (DIP), ensuring that the required technical support is provided. The role will also be responsible for ensuring the implementation of the MEAL plan, documenting and promoting project learning for scale-up, and enhancing the visibility of Save the Children’s work on Shock Responsive Social Protection (SRSP).

In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

Technical Assistance and Quality Assurance:
  • Serve as the provincial technical lead for Shock-Responsive Social Protection (SRSP) within the context of Disaster Risk Management (DRM) governance.
  • Lead the planning and coordination of technical project activities, including capacity-building initiatives for consortium partners and relevant government personnel at the provincial and local levels, as required.
  • Facilitate and coordinate capacity-building activities in collaboration with PIN and the Humanitarian Manager, based on the capacity-building plan and in alignment with project outputs and indicators.
  • Lead the development and/or revision of SRSP-related tools, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and guidelines at the provincial level.
  • Support to ensure quality of programmes in the field including benefiting to the vulnerable population.
  • Support for the development and implementation of Minimum Standard for SRSP and other delivery
  • Make regular field visits and ensure the quality, identify best practices, identify issues to be addressed, and share with Humanitarian Manager to seek technical advice
  • Ensure the use of consolidated multi hazard and multi-sector risk assessment tools/guidelines that fits in line with the SCI CSP, MEAL plan and learning from stakeholders.
  • Coordinate to ensure that all project implementation materials /guidelines are reviewed by relevant technical team
  • Faciliate the SRSP part at the provincial level workshops and trainings
  • Lead the thematic discussion on SRSP at provincial level including mandates, roles and responsibilities, coordinating arranngements, challenges and proposed solutions
  • Lead in co-creation of operational blue print for SRSP embeded with AA and Response at provincial and local levels
  • Carrry out multihazard risk analysis embeding social protection database

Project management /implementation:
  • Takes lead role at province level in delivery of SCI component in a consortium led by PIN and ensure SRSP result is delivered and is integrated in other results of the project
  • Ensure timely and quality technical support is available to the partner’s team on SRSP activities through implementation of DIP.
  • Ensure the effective and efficient implementation of the project grants
  • Liaising closely with the CO team, ensure clear roles, responsibilities and timelines are set for all project requirements such as reports, budget realignments etc.
  • Ensure development and implementation of project /detail implementation plans and budgets, procurement plans and provide guidance and solutions to problems to ensure smooth, quality implementation of MEAL plan and achievement of log-frame objectives and results.
  • Development of manual with specification for emergency support stockpiling for local governments
Coordination:
  • Coordinate closely with PIN to ensure implementation of SCI deliverables
  • Build good working relationships with all the stakeholders working in Anticipatory Action and SRSP at province and local levels and across other teams within SCI
  • Work closely with the implementing partner deployed by PIN for the implementation of the SCI component of the project
  • Coordinate with local government and provincial government in coordination with the CO team
  • Work with logistic team to ensure that programme supply needs are clearly defined and coordinated for implementation
  • Provide assistance to SCI staff to the local coordination with partners, municipality and clusters,

Advocacy:
  • Coordinate with provinces, municipalities and relevant stakeholders
  • Work as a province level focal point to coordinate with PIN
  • Development and implementation of advocacy strategy

Documentation and reporting:

  • Organize field visits to ensure to prepare high quality learning documents and reports as per SC and the donor’s requirements and timely submit to related stakeholders
  • Encourage SCI team and partners to document the innovative approaches, best practices, lesson learned, and case studies
  • Ensure quality progress reports and learning documentation are prepared and share them at appropriate level
  • Keep Humanitarian Manager abreast regularly on the progress, consult for key decisions and way forward in the area responsible for.
  • Work with programme teams to ensure that reports are delivered according to SC and donor contractual requirements, within the agreed timescale and budget.
  • Ensure the compliance of programmes with internal SC requirements and any relevant external donor requirements

Qualifications and Experience:

  • A minimum of 4 -5 years’ experience in DRR/humanitarian/social protection sectors
  • Master's degree in relevant areas such as disaster risk management, social policy, social sciences or equivalent with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree with min 6 years of experience of relevant experience.
  • Solid project delivery, implementation, and monitoring skills with a proven history of delivering results
  • Experience of capacity building on shock responsive social protection, anticipatory action, DRR and emergency preparedness work
  • Good understanding of shock-responsive social protection, anticipatory action, DRR and Humanitarian programming or relevant thematic area
  • Specific knowledge and skills on disaster information management and communication
  • Proven experience in coordination with municipalities, district stakeholders, other government partners and the ability to lead, motivate and develop others
  • Ability to analyze information, evaluate options and to think and plan strategically
  • Effective interpersonal skills including leadership skills and ability to motivate those line managed by you and provide constructive feedback on performance
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Nepali, as well as excellent report writing skills
  • Commitment to and understanding of Save the Children’s aims, values and principles including rights- based approaches
  • Prior experience of using GIS in humanitarian/DRR works

Desirable

  • Worked within the NGO community, donor agencies and government departments in relevant role
  • Ability and willingness to stay and travel to any parts of the country
  • Skills related to participatory methods, computer literacy and team management

Skills

  • Information Management
  • Communication
  • Coordination
  • Negotiation
  • Communication
  • Relationship Building

Report Writing

Required No.(s): 1 (Nepalese Citizen Only)

Contract length: Fixed Term

Location: Surkhet Field Office

The Organisation

We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard.

We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:

  • No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday
  • All children learn from a quality basic education and that,
  • Violence against children is no longer tolerated

We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive workplace where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

Application Information

Please apply using a cover letter and up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations.


We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our global anti-harassment policy.

Save the Children does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Loss Prevention Officer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions, perimeter alarm system, duress alarms, and fire life safety system. Lock property entrances when required. Conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Notify appropriate individuals in the event of accidents, attacks, or other incidents. Defuse guest/employee disturbances. Call for outside assistance if necessary. Complete incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Resolve safety hazard situations. Escort any unwelcome persons from the property without interrupting the orderly flow of property operation. Report to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents; release information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations and gather evidence. Conduct interviews with relevant parties.

Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Public Programs Coordinator
description:
SUMMARY:

Harvard University Graduate School of Design seeks an energetic, unflappable individual to take up the mantle of Public Programs Coordinator in the Department of Communications. The Communications Department handles public programming, publications (Harvard Design Press and Harvard Design Magazine), exhibitions, the GSD’s online presence, and public relations across the school. The Coordinator is a crucial member of the Public Programs team, which produces approximately 50 events per year.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Public Programs, the Public Programs Coordinator provides support in the planning, organization, and assessment of the GSD’s official public programs and acts as the primary on-site staff member for in-person events. Their key duties include event staffing; budget tracking; logistical coordination (incl. travel, catering, setups, audience and speaker inquiries); event-related outreach and social media communications; event webpage creation and maintenance; committee work; and providing guidance to GSD/Harvard partners about the event planning process, among other tasks. This is a service-oriented role that requires on-site event responsibilities and interaction with invited guests, vendors, and attendees. Quick thinking, adaptability, a confident demeanor, a generous spirit, and rigorous attention to detail are essential in this role.

The ideal candidate will be creative and proactive: identifying opportunities to improve event operations and contribute to the lively community at the GSD through events.

The position is hybrid (in-person and remote). During the academic year, occasional evening and weekend hours are required.

TYPICAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Acts as primary on-site event staffer, ensuring events begin and end on time and that guests, hosts, and attendees are cared for. Other on-site duties include setting up signage, fielding participant inquiries, and general troubleshooting. Handles live social media posting during events.
  • Provides administrative, technical, and logistical support for the public programs series, such as: correspondence with invitees/attendees; preparing itineraries and briefings; securing event spaces; making dinner and catering arrangements; booking travel and hotel accommodations; drafting and/or formatting slide presentations; and producing materials for events (e.g. placards, posters, place cards, etc.).
  • Tracks all lecture-related expenses; works with Finance staff to process financial paperwork, payments, and honoraria. Participates in the budget forecasting and budgeting process each year.
  • Manages the communications needs of Public Programs, which includes creating, maintaining, reviewing, and updating relevant content for the GSD’s website, e-newsletters, and email marketing. Conducts research to develop new audiences. Drafts and sends weekly event announcements to GSD community.
  • Participates in or leads GSD-wide event-related committees. Provides event guidance to student groups, department staff & faculty, Harvard-wide partners, and related parties on the planning and execution of events and implementation of policies related to event planning at the GSD.
  • Performs general administrative duties (e.g., making and responding to phone calls; maintaining files and archives; entering and updating contact databases (such as Mailchimp).
  • Provides efficient and accurate customer service to internal staff members and external clients such as the Dean’s Office, faculty, donors and/or alumni, other departments with the GSD and the University, and the public. Responds to inquiries received by the outward-facing events email address and phone number.
  • Tracks key data points from events to support analysis and feedback.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • There are no supervisory responsibilities associated with this position.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • May require lifting, moving, and opening boxes of office supplies and event materials. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience organizing or running events, or related transferable experience. Knowledge of academic communities with an interest in design and arts-related missions preferred.
  • Strong computer skills and familiarity with Mac platforms. Advanced word processing and spreadsheet knowledge, confidence using a variety of social media platforms, and familiarity with web editing software. Comfort with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint (and/or Keynote) are required; experience with WordPress and Adobe Photoshop strongly preferred.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; outstanding administrative and organizational skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Must be comfortable interfacing with people both inside and outside the organization.
  • Ability to demonstrate exceptional resourcefulness, creativity, and flexibility; display good judgment; problem-solve and take initiative; exercise tact and diplomacy at all times.
  • Must be able to work independently.
  • Must have the ability to handle confidential materials with discretion.
  • BA/BS or equivalent preferred; a degree in Communications, Arts Administration, Art/Architectural History, Art Education, English, Design, or Studio Art is desirable.

This position affords a chance to learn what it takes to produce high-profile public events while gaining insight into the wider activities of the Communications Department at one of the top design schools in the country.

This position is hybrid, with a 35-hour-per-week schedule, Monday through Friday, 7 hours/day, including evenings and occasional weekend hours during the semester. The schedule of in-office and remote hours will be determined in conversation with the supervisor. Position may require overtime during peak periods.

  • Salary Information: The specific annualized hiring range for this position will be $65,000-75,000.
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 054. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

title: Vi søger afsnitsledende overlæge til ungdomspsykiatrisk ambulatorium B299
description:
Har du mod på at være en del af et tværfagligt ledelsesteam bestående af dig, en afsnitsledende psykolog og en oversygeplejerske? B299 søger nu en overlæge for at gøre sit ledelsesteam komplet.

Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center (BUC) i Region Hovedstaden er et center i vækst og med store ambitioner. Vi har i den ambulante afdeling 16 afsnit, hvoraf B299 er et af vores ungdomspsykiatriske afsnit. B299 er beliggende på Sydvestvej i Glostrup.


B299s hovedopgaver og målgruppe
Målgruppen for afsnittet er for nuværende unge i alderen 14 til 17 år ramt af moderat til svær psykisk sygdom samt deres familier. De kliniske opgaver består både af udredning og behandling af en bred vifte af forskellige psykiske vanskeligheder og psykisk sygdom så som autisme, opmærksomhedsforstyrrelse, depression, angst m.m. Opgaverne løses i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde mellem læger, sygeplejersker, psykologer, fysioterapeuter, socialrådgivere og sundhedsadministrativt personale. I afsnittet er ansat cirka 40 medarbejdere.

Du bliver leder af et afsnit, hvor vi har et ønske om at kombinere klassisk specialiseret børne- og ungdomspsykiatri med en ny tilgang til udredning og behandling. Du vil få mulighed for at præge denne udvikling og de nye indsatser. Disse nye tiltag inkluderer tanker om øget digitalisering og psykoterapi.

Der vil i processen være tæt samarbejde med centerets forskningsenhed og den øvrige ledergruppe.


Hvem er du?
Vi ønsker os at du med ro i maven kan nikke til flere af nedenstående kompetencer og erfaringer:

  • Du har omfattende faglig indsigt og klinisk erfaring med det børne- og ungdomspsykiatriske område. Herunder meget gerne ambulant erfaring.
  • Du har gerne erfaring med psykoterapi og en specialistuddannelse.
  • Du har interesse for og erfaring med at arbejde med den lægelige videreuddannelse.
  • Du er optaget af at forstå de unges og familiernes behov (set fra deres perspektiv) og er modig nok til at inddrage disse i ambulatoriets udviklingsarbejde.
  • Du har en organisationsforståelse; herunder evnen til at arbejde struktureret med udviklings- og implementeringsprocesser.
  • Du er en erfaren og motiverende leder der kan skabe følgeskab og opbygge en stærk faglig og udviklingsorienteret kultur
  • Du er visionær og er komfortabel med at tænke nyt. Det betyder, at du bygger videre på etablerede erfaringer, men også kan se potentialer, hvor andre ikke nødvendigvis kan
  • Du formår at skabe en hensigtsmæssig balance mellem høj kvalitet i behandling af den enkelte patient, oprettelse af afsnittets uddannelsesforpligtigelser og et vedvarende fokus på at sikre rettidig hjælp og overholdelse af udrednings- og behandlingsret.
  • Du har blik for det samlede patientforløb og er derfor optaget af samarbejdsfladerne ud mod kommunerne i ambulatoriets optageområde og internt mod BUCs andre kliniske funktioner, fx vores døgnafsnit
  • Du kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag med mange bolde i luften. Du har en positiv og fleksibel indstilling til varierende arbejdsopgaver og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?
Vi tilbyder et sjældent og meningsfuldt job med en helt unik mulighed for at præge den måde, vi arbejder på i dansk børne- og ungdomspsykiatri. Du bliver en del af en række stærke fællesskaber i BUC: Du kommer til at indgå i en ledergruppe bestående af ca. 35 ledere i BUCs ambulante afdeling og får et tæt samarbejde med vores administration, kvalitets- og forbedringsenhed, centerledelsen og en række andre aktører. Sammen med den øvrige ledergruppe, får du mulighed for at præge udviklingen i børne- og ungdomspsykiatrien i fremtiden.

Det er vigtigt for os, at du bliver godt klædt på til at varetage de opgaver, som du skal udføre. Du får derfor grundig introduktion til jobbet og den regionale børne- og ungdomspsykiatri. Du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, så du bliver fortrolig med dine opgaver og din rolle.

Du bliver en del af noget større; nemlig landets største børne- og ungdomspsykiatriske center. Vi har mange af de fremmeste eksperter ansat. Som en del af dette hold får du både mulighed for at lære en masse og være med til at forme fremtidens psykiatri.


Løn og vilkår
Stillingen er på 37 timer og vi ønsker, at du starter snarest muligt.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for overlæger - 33.04.1

I henhold til lovkrav skal der ved eventuel ansættelse på Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center forevises ren børneattest. Centeret indhenter attesten hos Rigspolitiet med samtykke fra ansøgere, der indstilles til ansættelse.

Om Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center
Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center (BUC) er en del af Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital og dækker hele Region Hovedstaden. Centeret foretager udredning og behandling af børn og unge med alle former for alvorlige psykiske lidelser, der kræver en tværfaglig indsats i hospitalsregi. Centeret har to kliniske afdelinger Afdeling Ambulant og Afdeling Døgn fordelt på flere matrikler i regionen, samt en stor forskningsenhed.

Herudover har centeret en række støttefunktioner, herunder en administration og en kvalitets- og forbedringsenhed. Samlet er vi ca. 1.000 ansatte, der indgår i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde om de ca. 18.000 børn og unge i alderen 0-17 år, der årligt ses i centeret (2025). Nærmere information om Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center kan findes på BUC hjemmeside www.buc-regionh.dk.

title: Reservedelslager Nord ApS øger deltidsmedarbejder til 20 timer om ugen
description:

title: Buffister / køkkenmedarbejdere søges til køkkenet i Maximum Svendborg
description:
Er du serviceminded? Bliver du glad af at give folk en god oplevelse? Kan du lide at arbejde i et socialt miljø, hvor tingene går stærkt? Så er det muligvis dig vi leder efter. Travlheden er over os, og vi søger derfor nu nye medarbejdere til vores køkken.

Hvem er vi?

Bowl’n’Fun & Maximum er en del af en kædevirksomhed med dertilhørende restaurant The Grill. Kæden består i dag af 20 centre fordelt i hele Danmark. Vi leverer gode oplevelser til gæsterne med vores mange forlystelser såsom bowling, laser hero og escape room. I Restaurant The Grill serverer vi hver aften en lækker grillbuffet som dækker bredt til både børn, unge og voksne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Som buffist hos Maximum er din primære opgave at servicere vores gæster ude ved buffeten og grillen.
  • Du har medansvar for, at gæsterne får en skøn oplevelse og et godt produkt. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er meget serviceminded, smilende og kvalitetsbevidst.
  • Arbejdsopgaverne er primært i køkkenet og omkring buffeten, hvor du assisterer kokkene i køkkenet samt griller kød og står for udskæring ved grillen.
  • Det er intet krav at have kendskab til madlavning, men du må meget gerne have en lyst og et engagement for at lave mad.
  • Ad Hoc opgaver.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • At blive en del af Danmarks største bowling- og forlystelseskæde i en stilling, hvor du sammen med dine kollegaer forventes at skabe unikke resultater, som kan ses og mærkes.
  • At blive en del af en flad organisation med fokus på gensidig feedback i et harmonisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi passer på hinanden.
  • En arbejdsplads hvor der er mulighed for udvikling, og hvor vi tilbyder flere tiltalende personalegoder.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

  • At du har lyst til at give vores gæster en god oplevelse
  • Du har overblik og besidder evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når det går stærkt
  • At du kan lide at arbejde i et team
  • Du har sans for kvalitet og forstår vigtigheden af rengøring og god hygiejne
  • At du kan arbejde 2-3 gange om ugen
  • Du sætter pris på en varieret arbejdsdag med skiftende arbejdstider og weekendvagter

Arbejdstiderne vil hovedsageligt være aften- og weekendarbejde. Vi søger medarbejdere som ønsker 15-20 timer ugentligt.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

NB! Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores hjemmeside. Ansøgninger der sendes pr. mail vil blive besvaret med en vejledning videre til vores hjemmeside.

title: Recreation Associate
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Encourage, recruit, register, and schedule guests to participate in recreation activities. Promote a fun and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Provide information to guests about available recreation facilities and activities. Promote the rules and regulations of the recreation facility intended for the safety and welfare of guests and members. Observe activity in the recreational facility and respond appropriately in accordance with local operating procedure in the event of an emergency. Be aware of possible situations where guests are not able to safely participate in an activity and inform supervisor/manager. Clean and maintain recreational equipment and supplies.

Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Process payments for rental equipment, recreation activities, facility rentals, or retail sales. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

License or Certification: CPR Certification

Any certification or training required by local and state agencies.

title: Teamleider Trainee
description:
Binnen GGz Breburg willen we een collega de gelegenheid bieden om zichzelf te ontwikkelen in een leidinggevende functie. Deze ontwikkeling maak je binnen een of twee afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Afhankelijk van wensen en mogelijkheden wordt de route bepaald.

Wat ga je doen?

Voor de duur van 1 jaar, werk je onder begeleiding van de jouw toegewezen teamleider in de loop van de tijd steeds zelfstandiger op de volgende gebieden:

  • Je geeft op een coachende manier leiding aan het team/de teams die jou worden toegewezen;

  • Je zorgt samen met de teamleden en de behandelaars voor de best passende cliënten zorg;

  • Je draagt bij aan een cultuur waar het team en collega’s verantwoordelijkheid nemen en je stimuleert de verbetercultuur van GGz Breburg;

  • Je draagt mede zorg voor een gezonde en toekomstbestendige bedrijfsvoering van de afdeling;

  • Je prikkelt medewerkers om te werken aan hun persoonlijke en team ontwikkeling;

  • Je vertaalt het organisatie- en clusterbeleid naar operationeel beleid binnen de teams;

  • Je werkt mee aan het meerjarenbeleid 'Samen het sterkst in mentale gezondheid' waarmee wij onze zorg zo makkelijk, duidelijk en efficiënt mogelijk maken;

  • Je deelt onze belofte om GGz Breburg wachtlijstvrij te maken en cliënten de juiste zorg op de juiste plek te bieden.

Hoe ziet jouw werkomgeving eruit?

Wij bieden een omgeving die inspirerend en uitdagend is, waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar je in een fantastisch team werkt! Breburg bestaat uit enthousiaste, open en gemêleerde teams. We hebben met elkaar gemeen dat we samen met onze cliënten op zoek gaan naar hun krachten en mogelijkheden.

We zoeken op dit moment een teamleider trainee binnen de Acute Zorg.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding op minstens HBO niveau;

  • Je bent minstens 32 uur beschikbaar tijdens dit traject waarvan 16 uur in de trainee functie;

  • Je hebt nagedacht over jouw ontwikkeltraject;

  • Je bent in staat om jouw doelstelling in dit traject te beschrijven en verwoorden;

  • Verbinden en gezamenlijk doelen bereiken onderschrijf jij en kan je vertalen in praktische voorbeelden;

  • Resultaten bereiken ten behoeve van cliënten, hun naasten, collega’s en direct belanghebbenden zijn voor jou logische begrippen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

In het eerste half jaar behoudt je je huidige salaris, daarna zijn er, afhankelijk van je taken mogelijkheden voor een toeslag.

  • Een jaar waarin je uitgebreid kennis maakt met een leidinggevende functie en een mogelijkheid om jezelf op dit gebied te ontwikkelen.

  • Gedurende dit jaar verandert jouw functie niet, jouw werkzaamheden wel. Je wordt voor 16 uur vrijgemaakt van je huidige functie en in de gelegenheid gesteld om onderdeel te worden van het teamleiders team.

  • Je overige contracturen blijf je werkzaam in je huidige functie waarbij je terugkeergarantie hebt voor al je contracturen.

  • Begeleiding door een ervaren teamleider.

Nieuwsgierig geworden?

Voor inhoudelijke informatie kun je contact opnemen met Gijs Kok (teamleider) via tel. 06-51168653 of g.kok@ggzbreburg.nl of Nienke van der meer (manager bedrijfsvoering) via tel. 06-12244721 of n.vandermeer@ggzbreburg.nl. Maak gebruik van de button op deze pagina voor het doorsturen van je cv en toelichting.

De sluitingsdatum is vrijdag 28 augustus 2026.

Bijzonderheden

Deze vacature staat alleen open voor interne medewerkers van GGz Breburg.

title: Document Controller
description:
We are looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Document Controller to support our growing Main Contractor project team. The successful candidate will play a key role in managing project documentation, ensuring that all project teams are working with the latest approved drawings and documents, and maintaining an efficient document control system throughout the project lifecycle.

Job Requirements:

* Minimum 2–5 years of experience as a Document Controller in Singapore construction projects(Experience with project topping-out).

* Experience with a Main Contractor is preferred.

* Experience in A&A (Addition & Alteration), condominium, or commercial building projects will be an advantage.

* Familiar with construction drawings, technical documents, submissions, and project correspondence.

* Strong knowledge of document control procedures, drawing revision control, and document management systems.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

* Experience with Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), or other document management systems will be an advantage.

* Well organized, responsible, and able to work independently under pressure.

* Good communication and coordination skills.

* Good command of spoken and written English.

Responsibilities:

* Maintain and manage all project documents, drawings, and records.

* Control the issuance, distribution, revision, and filing of drawings and technical documents.

* Maintain and update the Drawing Register and Document Register.

* Track and monitor Shop Drawings, Material Submissions, RFIs, Method Statements, Inspection Requests, and Consultant Comments.

* Ensure all project personnel are working with the latest approved drawings and documents.

* Coordinate document submissions with Clients, Architects, Consultants, and Subcontractors.

* Prepare, record, and distribute meeting minutes and project correspondence.

* Maintain an efficient document filing system throughout the project.

* Provide administrative and document control support to the Project Manager and project team.

Location: Singapore

Salary: Negotiable (Based on experience)

Candidates who can join immediately or within short notice will be preferred.

title: Online Assistant
description:
What you’ll be doing:

  • Picking and selecting the best quality products on the shop floor that online customers have ordered ready for it to be delivered to their doorsteps – or providing brilliant substitutions where products are out of stock
  • Using a handset that plans your route around the store, what you need to select and how long you have to complete each shop
  • Working behind the scenes dealing with customer queries, processing orders and helping to load the vans for our Home Delivery Drivers
  • Always ready to serve our customers brilliantly, supporting with any questions, and proactively offering help
  • Build great knowledge about our products, services and promotions to help provide recommendations
  • Working flexibly across the store as required

What makes a great Sainsbury’s Colleague:

  • Happy with early morning starts (as most shifts start at 4am) and working in a fast-paced, physical and high energy environment, often on your own but also thrive in being part of a team
  • Friendly and welcoming with a genuine enthusiasm for helping customers
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced, physical and high energy environment, using initiative to solve problems and taking responsibility for owning tasks
  • Always ready to work flexibly and productively to a high standard across the store - you’ll be fully trained in a variety of skills, so you have opportunities to learn, develop and try new things
  • Comfortable in learning to use new digital tools and technology to do your job brilliantly and moving shopping containers up to 15KG.
  • Have great attention to detail, keeping the store clean and clutter free, always looking to create the best shopping experience for our customers

Working for us has great rewards:

We truly value our colleagues and provide market-leading benefits and training to reflect that:

  • Nightshift premium - in addition to the advertised hourly rate, a further £2.45 nightshift premium is paid for every hour worked between midnight - 5am (where applicable).
  • Discount card – 10% off at Sainsbury’s, Argos, Tu, and Habitat after four weeks, increasing to 15% discount at Sainsbury’s every Friday and Saturday
  • Free food and hot drinks - provided for Colleagues in all our stores
  • Generous holiday entitlement - based on the hours you work, plus maternity and paternity leave
  • Pension – we’ll match between 4-7.5% of your pension contributions
  • Sainsbury’s share schemes – buy Sainsbury’s shares at discounted prices
  • Shopping discounts – special offers on gym memberships, restaurants, holidays, retail vouchers and more
  • Wellbeing support – including free access to our Employee Assistance Programme which is a confidential service providing support and guidance on a wide range of issues

Please note that our vacancies may close quickly, so we encourage candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

If you need an update on your application, you should contact the store that you have applied to. You can find contact details for all Sainsbury's stores here.

Working in our stores:

Our stores are fast-paced environments where no two days are ever the same. They are at the heart of the local community providing outstanding value, quality and great service. As one of our Online Assistants, you’ll be the special ingredient that supports a joyful shopping experience for our online customers, so they get everything they shop at Sainsbury’s for.

Eligibility:

  • You must be above the school-leaver age in your country School leaving age - GOV.UK
  • If the shifts for this role cover hours earlier than 6am or later than 11pm, you will need to be at least 18 years of age.
  • You must have Right to Work eligibility in the UK

An inclusive place to work and shop

We are dedicated to being a truly inclusive retailer, where every colleague can achieve their full potential, and every customer feels welcome when they shop with us.

To support this commitment, our colleagues may be entitled to a range of enhanced discretionary leave for families, as well as support for carers. We provide our colleagues resources to help them understand and support their role and their team effectively. Our internal colleague networks seek to ensure true representation for everyone, helping us identify and remove barriers that our colleagues may face.

We are proud to offer a range of development opportunities, including mentorship, training, and career progression pathways, to help our colleagues grow and succeed. We also celebrate diversity through various initiatives and events, fostering a culture of inclusion and respect. If you would like to learn more about our commitment to inclusivity, please take a look here.

As part our commitment as a Disability Confident Leader, all candidates will have the opportunity to be offered an interview through our online assessment which will prioritise those candidates who achieve the highest score and therefore most closely match the essential criteria for the role.

Should you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview stages, please let us know, and we will endeavour to support you.

title: Project Manager - Vehicle Durability / Field Operational Test
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a large-scale autonomous vehicle testing program across multiple locations in the United States. This role will oversee comprehensive field operational test (FOT) activities involving a substantial fleet of test vehicles equipped with advanced sensor systems for data collection.

The successful candidate will manage all aspects of multi-site operations, including team coordination, vehicle fleet management, route planning, safety compliance, and client relationship management. This position requires strong leadership skills, technical understanding of autonomous vehicle systems, and the ability to manage complex logistics across distributed operations.

The Project Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for client communications, ensuring project deliverables are met on time and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality.

The project's success will create potential future opportunities for the Project Manager for business growth in different engineering fields in the United States, with support from international teams from IDIADA Headquarters and other IDIADA Business Units.

Professional Profile

  • Minimum 7 years of project management experience, preferably in automotive, technology, or field operations environments.

  • At least 5 years of experience in field operations management, public road durability testing or automotive testing programs (preferred).

  • Demonstrated experience with ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) or autonomous vehicle testing projects.

  • Proven track record managing multi-site operations with distributed teams across multiple geographic locations.

  • Strong budget management and financial oversight experience, including P&L responsibility (preferred).

  • Experience managing large teams (20+ people) with diverse skill sets and responsibilities.

  • Familiarity with safety protocols, regulatory compliance, and risk management in automotive or testing environments.

  • Valid US driver's license required; willingness to travel across the U.S. up to 30-40% of the time.

  • Experience working with international teams and clients is highly desirable but not required.

Essential Qualities & Competencies

  • Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.

  • Outstanding communication abilities, both written and verbal, with experience presenting to senior leadership.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills with ability to make decisions under pressure.

  • High adaptability and flexibility to manage changing priorities in a dynamic operational environment.

  • Technical aptitude with ability to understand and communicate complex autonomous vehicle systems concepts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain client relationships.

  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities with attention to detail.

  • Results-oriented mindset with focus on meeting deadlines and achieving project objectives.

  • Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across different departments and organizations.

  • Passion for automotive technology and commitment to advancing the future of mobility.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field (required).

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or related discipline (preferred but not required).

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent (highly desirable).

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or similar process improvement credentials (a plus).

  • Equivalent combination of education and extensive relevant experience will be considered.

Job Functions:

  • Must be physically able to support test preparation and execution in an outdoor environment.
  • Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours and weekends.
  • Meet all workplace health and safety requirements and practices.
  • This role requires the ability to sit, stand, and work for extended periods of time in an office setting.
  • This role may require occasional travel

Schedule:

  • Monday to Saturday

title: Teamleder til kontoret Digitalisering og Systemforvaltning – få vores IT-projekter sikkert i mål
description:
Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen søger en fagligt stærk teamleder, der er klar til at tage ansvaret for en større portefølje af IT-projekter og lede vores projektledere og generalister i realiseringen af forvaltningens mål. Vi har en ambitiøs strategi, der skal omsætte digitalisering til reel værdi for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder – og løfte hele forvaltningens digitale modenhed.

Hvis du brænder for at skabe fremdrift og rammesætning og er klar til at tage lederskab i en spændende og kompleks organisation, så er dette stillingen for dig.

Vores kerneopgave
Vi driver og udvikler Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningens brede og komplekse systemportefølje og sikrer en stabil drift, der lever op til de stigende krav til IT-sikkerhed og compliance. Vi står i spidsen for implementeringen af nye IT-løsninger – fra idé og behovsafklaring til udbud, kontraktindgåelse og igangsættelse af løsningen. Vi sørger for, at projekterne skaber reel værdi for forvaltningen samt for borgerne, foreninger og virksomheder i København.

Vi bidrager til at sætte den strategiske digitale retning og arbejder kontinuerligt for at løfte den digitale modenhed på tværs af organisationen i et tæt samarbejde med alle forvaltningens fagområder. Vores sekretariat understøtter den politiske og faglige betjening med bl.a. indstillinger til direktionen.

Om stillingen
Som teamleder refererer du til kontorchefen og får personaleansvar for 16 medarbejdere, herunder IT-projektledere med ansvar for forvaltningens digitaliseringsprojekter samt generalister, der blandt andet laver ledelsesbetjening samt projekt- og konsulentarbejde.

Forvaltningen er en kompleks organisation med stor mangfoldighed i fagområder og borgerrettede løsninger. Du bliver en del af et kontor med 35 dygtige medarbejdere, der er specialiserede inden for digitalisering og systemforvaltning.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • ansvar for metoder, projekter, udbud og faglig betjening af den politiske og administrative ledelse
  • sikre faglig udvikling af dine medarbejdere i en tid med stigende kompleksitet og samtidig fastholde den høje trivsel i kontoret
  • vedligeholde vores projekt-pipeline og medvirke til, at projektønsker er beskrevet i tilstrækkelig grad
  • indgå i styregrupper vedr. IT-projekter i forvaltningen
Fortsætte implementeringen af vores nuværende digitaliseringsstrategi og handleplan, som skal styrke forvaltningens digitale modenhed, service og brugerforståelse i samspil med kommunens samlede digitaliseringsstrategi

Er det dig?
Vi ønsker os en teamleder, der har lyst til at lede vores fagligt dygtige medarbejdere med tillid, uddelegering og empati. Vi forestiller os, at du er nysgerrig af natur, trives med kompleksitet og kan skabe overblik og sammenhæng mellem politiske, strategiske dagsordner og operationel eksekvering og drift.

For at kunne bestride stillingen skal du have erfaring med digitalisering fra en kompleks, politisk ledet organisation.

Du får succes i stillingen, hvis du

  • skaber følgeskab og balancerer målopfyldelse med empati og tillid
  • tør afprøve nye tilgange og har lærerige erfaringer i bagagen
  • ved, hvad det kræver at planlægge og følge op på pipelinen og aktuelle projekter
  • forstår forretningen og har viden om design-thinking, UX og brugerrejser – uden at være specialist
  • kan identificere og afdække kompetencebehov i de enkelte projekter og bemande herefter
  • kan engagere og motivere medarbejderne – og skabe stærke relationer internt og eksternt
Det er en fordel, hvis du har ledelseserfaring.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Du ansættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Dit arbejdssted vil være Nyropsgade 3, 1602 København V. Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt. Vi indhenter referencer i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Vil du vide mere?
Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Thor Dekov Buur på 21 57 48 79. Send gerne en sms, så ringer han tilbage.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 16. august 2026
Vi afholder samtaler i uge 34, torsdag den 20. august. Vi afholder eventuelt 2. samtaler i uge 35, og der vil i dette tilfælde skulle løses en case.

Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen
I Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe gode rammer for kultur- og fritidslivet i byen, og for at give københavnerne samt byens gæster en professionel og nærværende service. Fra biblioteker, kulturhuse og museer til idrætsfaciliteter, borgerservice og byens grønne rum – skaber vi rammer for fællesskaber, hvor københavnerne kan mødes og udfolde sig. Vores fælles mål er at gøre København til et godt sted at leve, mødes og engagere sig.

title: Loss Prevention Associate
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions, perimeter alarm system, duress alarms, and fire life safety system. Lock property entrances when required. Conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Notify appropriate individuals in the event of accidents, attacks, or other incidents. Defuse guest/employee disturbances. Call for outside assistance if necessary. Complete incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Resolve safety hazard situations. Escort any unwelcome persons from the property without interrupting the orderly flow of property operation. Report to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents; release information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations and gather evidence. Conduct interviews with relevant parties.

Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None
