title: IT Administrator
description:
We are looking for an experienced IT administrator to oversee IT systems and infrastructure across our German operations, which now include multiple offices. This hands-on role will be responsible for ensuring the security, reliability and compliance of our environment as the company grows quickly in Germany. The successful candidate will oversee network and systems administration, identity and access management, and cybersecurity operations, while driving the certifications and compliance work required to support our defence customers and joint venture. This is a fast-paced environment where priorities change quickly, so the ability to adapt quickly, manage multiple offices and maintain effectiveness under changing demands is essential. As the role involves handling export-controlled systems and information, specific compliance and eligibility requirements apply. You will work alongside an IT Support Engineer who is already based on site, and you will receive support and direction from the IT Manager, who will oversee the function.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own the administration and maintenance of network infrastructure across all German offices, including firewalls, switches and wireless networks.
  • Manage cloud platforms and licenses, ensuring availability and performance.
  • Administer and maintain VS-NfD network, ensuring it is configured, operated, and documented in line with the applicable classified handling requirements.
  • Drive and maintain the IT certifications and compliance controls required for defense work and the joint venture, working within applicable export control obligations.
  • Administer Identity and Access Management (IAM), including user provisioning, de-provisioning and periodic access reviews.
  • Manage cybersecurity tooling, including endpoint protection, vulnerability management, SIEM and phishing simulation platforms.
  • Support ad-hoc infrastructure projects, including office build-outs and onboarding of new tools as the company expands across sites.
  • Maintain clear documentation for network configurations, IAM processes, security policies and compliance workflows.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for infrastructure, security and access related issues, in coordination with the IT Manager.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in system administration or IT infrastructure, ideally in a regulated or security conscious environment.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, SSO management and IAM systems (preferred Google Workspace IdP).
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity practices, including endpoint security, threat detection and security auditing.
  • Preferred hands-on administration of Ubiquiti UniFi in a multi-site deployment (SD-Network, access control).
  • Proficiency supporting a mixed environment of Linux and macOS endpoints.
  • Experience with, or willingness to work within, export control and defense compliance frameworks is a strong advantage (ISO 27001, ISO 9001).
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. from CompTIA, ITIL, ISC2) are a plus.
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced, changing environment, able to adapt quickly, reprioritise.
  • Willingness to travel, predominantly within Germany.
  • Customer facing experience.
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English is a must.
  • German citizenship is required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan
  • Extended social security package
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Tømrer som makker til nybyg og renovering i Kirke Såby
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have en fast makker, firmabil og ordnede forhold?

Vi mangler en tømrer til både nybyg og renovering i Kirke Såby.



Du lander i en etableret tømrervirksomhed med cirka 30 ansatte, hvor fagligheden er i top, og opgaverne spænder bredt over både private boliger og erhvervsbyggeri. Her arbejder I altid i faste makkerpar, så du har en kollega at sparre med i hverdagen, uanset om I monterer nye vinduer og døre eller står for en totalrenovering. Pladserne ligger primært lokalt, så du slipper for at bruge hele dagen på landevejen.



Her får du stor frihed under ansvar til at planlægge dagens forløb sammen med din makker. Tonen er uformel og direkte, og der er styr på planlægningen, så materialerne er klar, når I skal bruge dem. Lønnen er stabil, og der er gode muligheder for at udvikle dine faglige færdigheder på tværs af forskellige projekttyper.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Kirke Såby og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 30 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i many år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering og arbejde i makkerpar

Din hverdag



Dagen starter typisk med, at du mødes med din faste makker og tjekker dagens projekter, der primært foregår inden for private hjem og erhverv. I kører ud i jeres fælles firmabil, som er pakket med det rigtige udstyr, og koordinerer selv rækkefølgen, så arbejdet glider nemt og effektivt. Materialerne er som regel leveret direkte på pladsen, så I kan koncentrere jer om det gode tømrerhåndværk.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Nybyg af boliger og erhvervsejendomme
  • Renovering og ombygning
  • Opsætning af vinduer og døre
  • Tagarbejde
  • Trægulve og isoleringsopgaver

Folk bliver hængende her, så du lander i et hold der kender hinanden.



Hverdagen er præget af god planlægning og tæt samarbejde i jeres makkerpar, så I aldrig står alene med en udfordring. Når arbejdsdagen er omme, afleverer I opgaverne med god samvittighed og i den kvalitet, I selv vil være bekendt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som tømrer
  • Har kørekort B
  • Er mødestabil og kan samarbejde i et makkerpar
  • Sætter en ære i at aflevere et ordentligt stykke arbejde
  • Taler og forstår dansk

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med både nybyggeri og renoveringsopgaver. Men det vigtigste er, at du er stabil og klar på at levere godt håndværk sammen med din makker.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 2 uger.



Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.
Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.
Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.
PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.
Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til a kort og uforpligtende snak.
Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

O que buscamos em você?

  • Possuir experiência em análise forense e resposta a incidentes: Ter vivência prática em investigações, análise de logs e atuação em incidentes de segurança, com bons conhecimentos em redes e sistemas operacionais.

  • Operar IA no fluxo forense, em situações reais: Capacidade de utilizar agentes/LLMs para triagem de incidentes, geração de hipóteses de hunting, revisão de logs em escala, geração e auditoria de scripts de análise.

  • Possuir habilidades em scripting e análise de dados: Desenvolver scripts em Python e/ou Bash escrevendo, revisando e estendendo código com apoio de IA, para análise, processamento de grandes volumes de dados e automação de investigações.

  • Ter familiaridade com ferramentas e mindset analítico: Utilizar ferramentas como Jupyter Notebooks, APIs, requisições web e soluções de análise de logs (ex: Splunk, ELK), e operar agentes de IA (Claude, GPT, Gemini) para investigação e automação, aliando pensamento analítico, boa comunicação e colaboração em ambientes críticos.

title: Pædagogisk medarbejder til Regnbuens børn i Valby
description:
Synes du også, at vuggestuebørn er seje og spændende at arbejde med? Og har du gejsten og visionerne om at give børn den bedst mulige start på livet? Så er det lige dig, vi søger til at understøtte børnenes udvikling fra første dag i Valbys mindste vuggestue.

Du skal være med til at gøre en forskel for børnenes udvikling i Regnbuen
Vores kerneopgave er at understøtte, at alle børn får lige muligheder for at udfolde deres fulde potentiale. Det kan kun ske, hvis hvert enkelt barn ses og høres. Vi forventer, at du som pædagog i Regnbuen vil være med til at løfte den opgave.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig og begynde et samarbejde med dig, der brænder for arbejdet med vuggestuebørn, og som tænker, at vuggestuebørn er de mest fantastiske små mennesker at skabe læring for. Det gør ikke spor, om du er nyuddannet eller har mange års erfaring, så længe du kan se dig selv i nedenstående.

Vores ønsker til dig

  • Er enige med os i, at vuggestuebørn er superseje
  • Er engageret, nysgerrig, ansvarlig og stabil
  • Er anerkendende og nærværende i interaktionen med børn, forældre og kollegaer
  • Tør at komme med små og store ideer til at udvikle pædagogik og faglighed
  • Stiller krav til egen og andres pædagogiske faglighed, både i teori og praksis
  • Kan formulere sig skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Kan arbejde systematisk med refleksion og dokumentation
  • Ser vigtigheden i et godt forældresamarbejde
  • Ser samarbejdet på tværs i huset som en styrke og kan indgå i den daglige praksis i hele huset
  • Kan lide at lege og være en del af legen sammen med børnene
Hvad vi kan tilbyde dig?
Et job som pædagog/PAU i en lille, hyggelig og velfungerende vuggestue, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med engagerede kollegaer, der brænder for at sikre det lille vuggestuebarns trivsel og udvikling.

Hos os vil du få en høj grad af medindflydelse på den pædagogiske ramme og retning i huset samt medansvar for, at den omsættes i praksis. Selvfølgelig sammen med en engageret gruppe af medarbejdere, der drømmer om fortsat udvikling med spændende inspiration fra dig.

En hverdag fyldt med højt humør blandt børn og voksne. En arbejdsplads hvor der er plads til forskellighed og en personalegruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

Vi har en meget positiv forældregruppe, der er meget glade for at have deres børn gående hos os.

Om os
Vi er en lille vuggestue i Valby med plads til 36 børn fordelt på tre stuer. Vi er en lille personalegruppe på 10 medarbejdere, der består af både pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælper og en pædagogisk leder. Vi er en god blanding af folk, der har været her længe og nogle, der er kommet til for nylig. Men vi har alle det til fælles, at vi bevist har valgt at arbejde i en lille institution.

Du lærer hurtigt alle børnene at kende, og du vil komme til at arbejde tæt sammen med alle dine kollegaer. Vi bakker op om hinanden på kryds og tværs af stuer og titler på ansættelseskontrakten, og mange af os har også ansvarsområder fx i klyngen ved siden af den almindelige vuggestuehverdag, vi sætter ekstra fokus på. Hos os får du indflydelse på din pædagogiske hverdag samt Regnbuens pædagogiske fremtid, og vi sætter både kollega- og forældresamarbejde højt på dagsordenen.

I vores vuggestue er faglig udvikling en del af hverdagen, og noget som både vores leder og klynge i det hele taget har fokus på. Vi tør spørge hinanden, hvorfor vi tager de beslutninger, vi gør, når det kommer til børnene. Den faglige sparring er med til at skabe en rød tråd i institutionen, og vi tror på, at vi bliver bedre voksne for vores skønne børn, når vi husker at reflektere over vores pædagogiske praksis.

Vi glæder os meget til at byde en ny kollega velkommen.

Ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Inden ansættelse indhenter vi referencer samt børne- og straffeattest.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse pr. 14. september 2026.

Vuggestuen har åbent fra kl. 7.00-17.00 mandag-fredag, og vi forventer, at du kan arbejde indenfor dette tidsrum og derudover kan deltage i ca. ét aftenmøde pr. måned i tidsrummet kl. 17.00-20.00.

Vi er en del af Valby/Vesterbro/Kgs. Enghave Klynge C.

Mere information
For yderligere information se Regnbuens hjemmeside eller kontakt pædagogisk leder Nathja Green på 23 70 37 49 eller på J85J@kk.dk.

Vedhæft uddannelsesbevis samt andre relevante dokumenter.

title: Network Operations Center Specialist - Glomfjord
description:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

About The Role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Network Operations Center (NOC) Specialist to join our team on-site at our data center in Glomfjord. Taking advantage of the region’s green energy resources, our facility relies on stable, round-the-clock monitoring to maintain maximum up time for our clients.

As a NOC Specialist, you are the first line of defense. You will be responsible for monitoring our network infrastructure, servers, and environmental systems in real-time. This is a technical, hands-on role where you will identify anomalies, troubleshoot initial issues, and escalate complex problems to senior engineers. If you love solving technical puzzles and want to be at the heart of data center operations, this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Monitor the health and performance of network infrastructure, servers, and critical data centre systems 24/7/365.
  • Respond to alerts, investigate faults, and perform first-line troubleshooting to restore services quickly.
  • Escalate complex network, infrastructure, and facility issues to senior engineers while providing accurate diagnostics and updates.
  • Monitor environmental systems, including power, cooling, and Building Management System (BMS) alarms, to help maintain data centre resilience.
  • Log, prioritise, and manage incidents through the ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution and clear documentation.
  • Perform routine operational checks and follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and escalation processes.
  • Support shift handovers by documenting active incidents, maintenance activities, operational risks, and outstanding actions.
  • Work closely with Network Engineering, Data Centre Operations, Facilities, and Security teams to support planned maintenance and operational activities.
  • Contribute to root cause investigations by collecting evidence and documenting incident timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, reduce recurring issues, and enhance operational efficiency through process improvements and automation.
  • Maintain accurate operational records, reports, and system documentation to support compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver excellent operational support while helping ensure high availability and uptime for customer environments.

About You

Experience & Education

  • Practical Experience: 1–3 years of experience in a NOC, IT helpdesk, technical support, or data center environment.
  • Education: Degree or vocational certificate in Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (relevant hands-on experience or certifications will also be highly considered).

Technical Skills

  • Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, switches, routers, and firewalls).
  • Monitoring & Systems: Familiarity with monitoring tools (such as Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, or SolarWinds) and ticketing systems (like Jira Service Management or ServiceNow).
  • OS Knowledge: Basic comfort level working with Linux/Unix command lines and Windows Server environments.
  • Certifications (A Plus): CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA, or ITIL Foundation certifications are highly advantageous.

Soft Skills & Core Traits

  • Situational Awareness: A high level of alertness and attention to detail—you notice when a metric looks slightly off.
  • Calm Under Pressure: Ability to remain methodical and focused when multiple alerts go off simultaneously.
  • Communication: Good written and verbal communication skills in English for clear documentation and team coordination (Norwegian language skills are an asset for local site communication).
  • Shift Flexibility: Comfortable working a flexible shift schedule (including nights, weekends, and holidays) to support our 24/7/365 operations.

What We Can Offer You

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the operating standards behind a next-generation AI cloud platform, working on complex infrastructure challenges with real ownership and impact. This is a chance to play a meaningful role in scaling high-performance, sustainable data centre operations in a fast-moving environment.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here.

You will quantify and document color requirements, establish standard operating procedures, and review emerging technologies to ensure optimal product development, sampling, and commercialization.

Key Responsibilities

This position is an on-site role located in Liverpool, NY.

  • Quantify, document, and establish color specifications, profiles, and matching standards for print processes associated with sublimated products, textiles, and printed substrate materials.

  • Assess incoming requests and review printed samples against technical design parameters, performing necessary color corrections to verify acceptance to customer and industry standards.

  • Minimum of 3+ years of related experience and/or training required.

  • Experience with print processes associated with sublimated products and textiles in the apparel industry is a plus.

title: Senior Research Fellow (Materials Chemistry and Chemical Engineering)
description:
The School of Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) provides a vibrant and nurturing environment for staff and students to carry out inter-disciplinary research in key areas such as Computational Materials Science, Characterisation Materials Science, Defence Composite Materials, Functional Composite Materials, Energy, Nanomaterials, Low Dimensional Materials, Biomaterials Materials, Biological Materials, Bioinspired Materials and Sustainable Materials.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/mse/research.

The School of Materials Science & Engineering is seeking to hire a Senior Research Fellow to undertake responsibilities in the design, synthesize, activation and characterize the porous polymer microspheres. This project will involve designing of upscaling processes including working with collaborators in doing the LCA for the scale up process. The project would involve a great deal of upscaling development and working with clinicians also on the testing of these materials. This candidate will be expected to work in a team consisting of chemist, biologists and material scientists.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct advanced characterization on porous particles including SEM/BET/etc.

  • Develop workflow for scaling up of processes.

  • Develop methodologies to conduct in-depth structural and functional studies and improve instrumentation setup.

  • Write reports.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholder on the area of development and understanding LCA and planning for clinical studies.

  • Mentoring interns, undergraduates and postgraduate students

  • Assist in grant writing.

  • Maintenance of lab or equipment or supplies that include procurement and liaison with suppliers.

  • Produce high quality reports and documents that consolidate research findings.

Job Requirement:

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or relevant field.

  • Experience morphological/structural techniques for materials characterization.

  • Experience in characterization techniques such as electron microscopy, NMR, BET, etc, will be an advantage.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team with strong initiatives.

  • Good communication and written skills.

  • Responsible and passionate self-starter.

title: Senior Energy Market Analyst (Solutions)
description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

As a member of the APAC Solutions team, the Senior Energy Market Analyst will be responsible for engaging directly with both potential and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical work. The successful candidate will help drive Energy Exemplar’s growth in markets across the APAC region, by working with the sales team to identifying relevant customer use cases and assist in the development of the go to market strategy. The Senior Energy Market Analyst will act as an energy markets subject matter expert, responsible for thought leadership towards customers. They will seek to understand the customers challenges, identify solutions within the Energy Exemplar product offerings, and articulate the value proposition within the marketplace. The role has a heavy modelling focus.

The successful candidate will be expected to heavily contribute to the building of energy market models for those regions, using Energy Exemplar’s flagship PLEXOS software tool (the role does not require programming/software development). The candidate should have a good understanding of fundamental market price drivers, and ideally have experience in stochastic optimization techniques.

This Senior Energy Market Analyst works in close collaboration with a team of technical subject matter experts. The position is supported by strong training, coaching, and mentoring and provides opportunity for professional growth and career advancement, as well as international travel to customer sites. Successful candidates will have a strong background in modelling, and good customer facing skills; as well as being outgoing, professional, driven, and able to multi-task in a dynamic and often changing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead technical discussions and provide strategic modeling insights to clients.
  • Develop and validate complex optimization models tailored to customer needs.
  • Guide junior analysts and provide mentorship in modeling best practices.
  • Conduct in-depth research on policy impacts, market developments, and emerging technologies.
  • Manage project lifecycles, from scoping to delivery, ensuring customer success.
  • Collaborate with the product development team to enhance software capabilities.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Deep knowledge of energy markets & associated economics
  • Expertise in model setup, custom configurations, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience in scripting, automation, and integrating market datasets.
  • Ability to communicate complex subject matter in an easy to understand manner
  • Strong commercial awareness
  • Top down approach to problem solving – ability to see the big picture
  • Strong interpersonal presence and skills - demonstrated ability to build rapport
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Strong listening and presentation skills
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
  • Self-driven, results-orientated with a positive outlook and a focus on quality
  • Thorough knowledge of standard Microsoft programs – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities
  • Sense of urgency for goal achievement
  • Strong desire for personal and career advancement

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field.
  • 5+ years of experience in energy market modeling, forecasting, or optimization.
  • Extensive experience in PLEXOS or similar optimization software.
  • Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

title: Junior Salesforce BA
description:
Job Description & Requirements

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Salesforce Business Analyst to join our team on a 1-year fixed-term contract. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project managers to gather business requirements, support Salesforce implementations, and contribute to the successful delivery of digital transformation initiatives.

This role is ideal for candidates with hands-on experience in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, and a good understanding of the insurance domain.

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from stakeholders.
  • Work closely with business users to understand current processes and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and user stories.
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions.
  • Coordinate with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), defect tracking, and issue resolution.
  • Prepare process flows, documentation, user guides, and training materials.
  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and requirement gathering sessions.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Support post-implementation activities and continuous process improvements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Good understanding of business analysis methodologies and requirement gathering techniques.
  • Experience creating functional specifications, process documentation, and user stories.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience supporting Agile or Scrum project delivery.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

title: Senior Data Scientist - GenAI
description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Lead the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models

Are you a seasoned AI professional with a passion for generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is looking for a Senior Data Scientist - Gen AI to drive innovation and lead cutting-edge projects. If you have at least four years of experience in AI and consulting, combined with a talent for project and team management, we invite you to shape the future of LLM-driven solutions with us in Brussels.

Who You Are

  • Experienced professional: At least 4 years of experience in AI, with a strong background in consulting and delivering impactful projects for diverse clients.
  • Leader and collaborator: Proven experience managing teams, guiding junior colleagues, and fostering collaboration in multidisciplinary environments.
  • Innovative thinker: Able to identify emerging trends in generative AI and apply them to real-world challenges.
  • Results-oriented: Comfortable handling end-to-end project delivery, from ideation and development to deployment and client engagement.
  • Eager to grow: Passionate about advancing your expertise in LLMs and generative AI while mentoring others.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we collaborate with top-tier clients across industries, including healthcare, manufacturing, and media, to harness the transformative power of generative AI. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. Our inclusive and forward-thinking culture encourages creativity, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and deliver LLM projects: Manage the design, development, and deployment of advanced LLM-powered solutions, including RAG systems, agentic AI architectures, and multi-modal applications for our clients.
  • Drive technical excellence: Architect and deploy advanced AI systems leveraging cutting-edge techniques such as parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), function/tool calling, multi-agent workflows, and emerging interoperability standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Establish evaluation frameworks: Design and implement comprehensive quality metrics and benchmarks to ensure production-ready, reliable AI solutions that meet client requirements.
  • Mentor and manage teams: Guide junior engineers and data scientists in implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, fostering best practices in LLM development and deployment.
  • Innovate and strategize: Drive experimentation with state-of-the-art LLMs to identify new use cases, optimize performance through techniques like quantization and inference optimization, and develop generative AI tools and products.
  • Build scalable infrastructure: Oversee the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including model serving, API development, vector databases, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and cloud infrastructure.
  • Engage with clients: Collaborate with client teams to translate their business needs into impactful AI solutions, providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout project lifecycles.
  • Shape our expertise: Contribute to the company's thought leadership by publishing insights, presenting at conferences, or driving internal training on emerging LLM technologies and best practices.

What You Bring

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field; advanced degrees (MSc or PhD) are a plus.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in AI, with a strong focus on Data, Machine Learning, LLMs, or generative AI.
  • Consulting experience, including managing client relationships and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Deep expertise in modern LLM techniques including fine-tuning, RAG systems, agentic AI, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and extensive experience with NLP/AI frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph, Agno, ….).
  • Leadership and project management skills, with a proven track record of managing teams and delivering complex AI projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Proficiency in English, Dutch, or French is required; additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your expertise and experience.
  • High-impact opportunities to work with state-of-the-art LLM technologies and solve real-world challenges.
  • A leadership role in a dynamic, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
  • Professional growth through dedicated resources for training, conferences, and thought leadership.
  • A chance to shape the direction of a fast-growing AI team within a global consulting firm.
  • A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.

This position is based in Brussels, with opportunities to collaborate on projects worldwide.

At Artefact Belgium, we value expertise, leadership, and a drive to innovate. If you're ready to lead and make a tangible impact in the world of generative AI, we'd love to hear from you

title: SAP Basis Consultant / SAP Administrator (d/w/m)

**Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen**

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwesen, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in den Bereichen Performance Tuning, Benutzerverwaltung, Systemkopien und Unicode-Konvertierungen
  • HANA-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil
  • Lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit dem ausgeprägten Wunsch, neue Technologien zu verstehen und zu adaptieren
  • Effektive Kommunikationsfähigkeit im Austausch mit internen Kunden und externen Auditoren.
  • Hohe Motivation und Tatkraft, um Projekte aktiv voranzutreiben
  • Souveräne Arbeitsweise, sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch kollaborativ in einem internationalen Team
  • Bereitschaft zum Lernen sowie zum Wissens- und Erfahrungsaustausch innerhalb des Teams.
  • Analytische Herangehensweise und eine ergebnisorientierte Denkweise
  • Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse (Advanced Level)

title: Jeg søger én fuldtids-, og én deltidsassistent til mit stabile team på Djursland
description:
OMRÅDE: 8550 Ryomgård

LIDT OM MIG:

Jeg bruger meget af min hverdag hjemme i min lejlighed, hvor jeg blandt andet hygger mig med PlayStation, iPad, YouTube, serier og alt muligt andet, der hører den digitale verden til. Det betyder ikke, at vi bare sidder og kigger ind i en skærm hele dagen – der er masser af plads til gode snakke, humor og en afslappet stemning, mens dagens opgaver bliver klaret.

Når weekenden rammer, kan det til gengæld godt gå lidt stærkere. Jeg elsker fodbold og musik og nyder at tage på stadion, opleve koncerter og festivaler eller en tur i byen med venner. Derfor er det helt klart en fordel, hvis du også synes, den slags er hyggeligt. Du behøver ikke være den største fodboldfan eller festivalgænger, men det er fedt, hvis du har lyst til at være med, når vi tager af sted.

JOBBESKRIVELSE:

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

Hjælp ved toiletbesøg, bad, påklædning og ind og ud af sengen.

Madlavning, almindelig rengøring og praktiske opgaver i lejligheden.

Ledsagelse, når jeg skal ud. (Dette er oftest i manuel kørestol)

Muligvis hjælp til administrative opgaver. Det vigtigste for mig er ikke, om du har masser af erfaring – men at du er mødestabil, har humor og er et rart menneske at være sammen med.

Jeg sætter stor pris på en afslappet omgangstone, og jeg synes, at et godt grin gør selv de mest almindelige hverdage lidt bedre. Derfor håber jeg også, at du ikke er bange for at byde ind med lidt humor.

Du bliver som handicaphjælper en del af et godt, fleksibelt og nødvendigt team af handicaphjælpere, der i fællesskab dækker alle vagter året rundt. Jobbet foregår i borgerens eget hjem, til fritidsaktiviteter, sociale arrangementer og de udflugter borgeren skulle have lyst til at deltage i.

title: Analyst-Compliance
description:
The Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) is part of American Express's Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) organization within Global Risk & Compliance. GFCSU partners closely with the U.S. Investigations Unit (USIU) to detect, investigate, and mitigate financial crime risk across the enterprise.

GFCSU is responsible for identifying and investigating potentially suspicious financial activity through transaction monitoring, data analysis, and investigative research. The team reviews complex cases involving money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and other financial crime risks. When appropriate, GFCSU supports the filing of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) and partners with internal compliance teams to meet global regulatory reporting obligations.

By leveraging advanced monitoring tools, analytical techniques, and cross-functional collaboration, GFCSU helps safeguard American Express from financial crime while ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA). The team's work is critical to protecting the company, supporting regulatory compliance, and assisting law enforcement in combating money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, identity theft, and other illicit activity.

The successful candidate will work in our hub in Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) to mitigate risk to the American Express enterprise through research and analysis of financial activity for suspicious patterns along with the review of records. Candidates must be flexible and willing to change responsibilities to meet business needs, should be comfortable reading and reviewing records from multiple jurisdictions, and be able to work with various teams across American Express, including international Market Compliance Officers, line of business representatives, and project teams, among others.

How will you make an impact in this role?

  • Conduct time-sensitive, meticulous financial crime investigations, analyzing each instance of potential suspicious financial activity across multiple jurisdictions and countries, utilizing a wide variety of research and analytical tools.

  • Demonstrate a keen attention to detail in investigation, analysis, and writing.

  • Produce well-written reports detailing and analyzing potentially suspicious activity.

  • Review other analysts' investigations and provide constructive feedback.

  • Ability to pivot smoothly between the different GFCSU workflows: AML, EDD, Screening and Anti-Corruption.

  • Meet performance expectations: productivity and quality goals.

  • Compliance with SLAs.

  • Collaborate on additional projects to assist the various CGFCSU teams.

  • To develop and maintain an adequate knowledge of the financial crime environment.

  • Build strong relationships with strategic partners across to ensure effective coordination of investigations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least two years of experience in one of the following areas is mandatory: AML compliance, transaction monitoring, sanction screening, EDD, regulatory compliance, law enforcement, fraud investigations and other financial crime investigations (two years minimum).

  • Knowledge of AML legislation and specific financial crime, sector and geopolitical issues.

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).

  • Microsoft Excel proficiency.

  • Proficiency in researching information for business related purposes.

  • Proven ability to work with and analyze large amounts of data in order to report critical information.

  • Effective communication and excellent writing skills.

  • High level of professionalism, self-motivation, and sense of urgency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of languages other than English would be a plus.

  • Certification in Compliance, AML or Financial Crime related fields.

  • Experience working in KYC, Transaction monitoring, Sanctions or EDD departments

  • Highly preferred bachelor’s degree (or equivalent). Ideally in one of the following, or similar, fields of study: Law, Justice Studies, Criminology, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Government & Public Services,

  • Knowledge of data processing and visualization, dashboarding and reporting, process automation and optimization.

title: Facilities Executive
description:
Job Summary

The Facilities Executive is responsible for the technical management, operation, maintenance, and performance of all hard services within the client's premises. Oversee vendors and contractors to ensure all building systems are maintained safely, efficiently, and in accordance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical expertise in Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) systems, facilities maintenance, troubleshooting, contractor management, and service delivery within a facilities management environment.

Key Responsibilities

Facilities Operations & Technical Management

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and maintenance of building services and M&E systems, including electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, UPS, generators, and associated infrastructure.
  • Ensure all preventive maintenance (PM), corrective maintenance (CM), and breakdown works are completed within agreed service levels and contractual requirements.
  • Conduct regular site inspections and technical audits to ensure facility assets are operating efficiently and safely.
  • Perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions for recurring equipment failures and maintenance issues.
  • Monitor plant and equipment performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives to optimize system reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure all facility assets comply with statutory requirements, local regulations, client specifications, and industry standards.

Contractor & Vendor Management

  • Supervise, coordinate, and manage third-party contractors, specialist vendors, and service providers performing maintenance and repair works.
  • Review contractor work quality, performance, safety compliance, and adherence to maintenance schedules and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Coordinate contractor activities to minimise operational disruptions and ensure timely completion of maintenance works.
  • Review maintenance reports, quotations, method statements, risk assessments, and permits submitted by contractors.
  • Ensure contractors comply with site safety requirements, permit-to-work procedures, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.
  • Evaluate contractor performance and identify opportunities for service improvement and cost optimisation.

Client & Service Delivery Management

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the client on all engineering and hard services matters.
  • Ensure contractual obligations, KPI targets, and service delivery standards are consistently achieved.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with clients, providing timely updates on maintenance activities, incidents, and ongoing improvement initiatives.
  • Prepare and present monthly operational reports, maintenance performance reports, and engineering updates to the client.
  • Support the Facilities Manager in business reviews, client meetings, and service enhancement initiatives.
  • Identify and support opportunities for additional works and value-added services to enhance service delivery and business growth.

Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

  • Ensure all maintenance activities comply with statutory regulations, local authority requirements, client policies, and company procedures.
  • Implement and enforce EHS policies, risk assessments, permit-to-work systems, and safe work practices.
  • Support audits, inspections, emergency preparedness exercises, and incident investigations.
  • Maintain all licenses, certifications, maintenance records, asset registers, and engineering documentation in an accurate and up-to-date manner.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Support execution of minor projects, asset replacement initiatives, fit-out works, and system upgrades.
  • Review technical proposals and recommend engineering solutions that improve operational efficiency and cost effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities for energy savings, sustainability improvements, and lifecycle asset management.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant facilities engineering experience, preferably within an integrated facilities management (IFM), outsourced FM, or service provider environment.
  • Proven experience managing hard services and coordinating multiple third-party maintenance vendors and contractors.
  • Strong hands-on technical knowledge of: Electrical systems, HVAC systems, Fire protection systems, Plumbing and sanitary systems, Generators and UPS, Building Management Systems (BMS)

Key Competencies

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing contractor performance and service delivery against KPIs and SLAs.
  • Good understanding of statutory compliance and workplace safety requirements.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
  • Proactive, hands-on, and able to work independently in a dynamic site environment.

title: The Hub | AI First Senior Software Engineer | All Gravy
description:
AI First Senior Software Engineer  
 Arbejdsgiver All Gravy  Remote Full-time 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           Competitive  
   
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
  All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail.   

  We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.  

  We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk.   

    About the role 

  We are looking for an ambitious AI-first Senior Software Engineer who will be a pivotal member of building and scaling the most critical parts of our product. This is a role for someone who has already made AI a core part of how they work. The kind of person who spots the problem worth solving and doesn't wait for permission to go after it. You're a builder who loves the pace of a startup or scale-up, where things move fast and ownership is real. As a Senior Engineer here, you won't just be maintaining a critical system, you'll be shaping how AI transforms what it can do.  

   What You Will Do  

  The ideal candidate possesses a versatile skill set, demonstrating capability across the entire spectrum of software development at All Gravy.  
 
 
  AI-Native Development: A versatile understanding of how to leverage AI in your day-to-day development workflow. The best candidates are top-tier at working with AI tools, can demonstrate concrete ways they've integrated them into how they ship code, and actively contribute back to how the wider team adopts and improves its AI-assisted ways of working.  
 

 
  Full-Stack Development: You will take ownership of features across the full application stack from the manager and employee-facing interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, to the robust, scalable back-end services and data layers that power them.  
 

 
  Hands-On Technical Approach: Comfortable reading and writing code (ideally TypeScript/Node.js, given our stack), reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You can ship a fix, not just file a ticket.  
 

 
  Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with our product teams to ensure everything integrates harmoniously across the All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.  
 
 
  We have a full-fledged TypeScript-based tech stack in All Gravy which means our current developer team seamlessly switches between development tasks.  

  All Gravy is undergoing high growth hence the job and responsibilities will develop over time, and there will be plenty of opportunities for you to learn and grow.  

   You'll thrive here if you  

  We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning  
 
 
  Genuinely AI-native. You can walk us through exactly how you use AI tools today, which ones, in what situations, and what's changed about how you build. This is a core part of the role, not a checkbox.  
 

 
  5+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.  
 

 
  Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.  
 

 
  Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.  
 

 
  Fluent English, spoken and written.  
 

 
  Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.  
 
 
  An advantage if you have experience in:  
 
 
  NestJS  
 

 
  MongoDB  
 
 
   Why All Gravy  
 
 
  Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.  
 

 
 AI at the center, not the side. We're not sprinkling AI on top, it's woven into everything we build. You'll use it, push it, and help define what it means for the future of work. 
 

 
  Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work  
 

 
  A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.  
 

 
  Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.  
 

 
  You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.  
 

 
  The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.  
 
 
   Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

title: Data Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.

About Verizol

Verizol is ZipNom's company intelligence and verification platform: 45+ APIs (KYC, KYB, bank, face, OCR, CKYC, eSign) built on a daily MCA data pipeline, sold through a single API key and prepaid credit wallet. Customers are CA firms, fintechs, NBFCs, and marketplaces. The engineering blueprint is written, the 8-week build plan is set, and the team is small enough that your name is on what ships.

The Role

You own the asset the entire company is built on. Every Verizol product — free search, daily alerts, KYB reports, watchlists — reads from one normalized, indexed database of Indian company registrations, and that database exists because your pipeline ingests, parses, and diffs MCA data every single day. This is the least substitutable seat on the team: when a government data source silently changes format at 2 AM, you're the one whose alarms catch it and whose parsers get fixed before customers notice.

This is not clean-API ETL. It's real-world data engineering against uncooperative sources — scraping, format archaeology, checksum validation, and building a system honest enough to know when its own data is stale.




Requirements

What You Will Do

  • Build source ingestors for MCA data (new incorporations, master data, index of charges, DIN registry, filing metadata) with raw-first storage to S3 — every byte stored before parsing, so parser bugs are always replayable
  • Write parsers as pure, fixture-tested functions: raw bytes in, typed rows out, with a fixture for every format variant ever observed in the wild
  • Build and own the snapshot + diff engine: detect exactly what changed for every company daily, and emit granular change events (director resigned, charge created, status changed) — the event stream that powers Alerts and Watchlists
  • Own the daily production schedule: ingest 02:00 → diff 04:00 → digests 06:30 → alert emails at 08:00 IST, with stage-level retries and a hard rule that stale data never silently ships
  • Build the alerts digest job: filter matching across all subscriber streams, email rendering, SES delivery — for CA subscribers, this email is the product
  • Build the monitoring that keeps you sane: row-count anomaly alarms, parser error rates, per-source freshness gauges
  • Maintain the reference tables (state/ROC mappings, NIC codes) and run the historical backfill (24+ months of incorporations)

Required Skills

  • 3–6 years of data engineering or backend work with production scraping/parsing experience against uncooperative sources — this is the non-negotiable; clean-API ETL alone won't prepare you for MCA
  • Strong Python: Celery (or equivalent task queues), lxml/BeautifulSoup, pandas, pdfplumber or similar document parsing
  • Solid PostgreSQL: bulk upserts, COPY, partitioning, and index design for time-series feed queries
  • Testing instincts for data: fixtures, golden files, replay tests — you can prove a parser change didn't corrupt yesterday
  • Operational maturity: your jobs run while everyone sleeps; you build the alarms first and take the 2 AM page seriously
  • Comfort with proxies, rate budgets, and being a polite, resilient client of fragile infrastructure

Preferred

  • Prior experience with Indian government/registry data: MCA21, GSTN, EPFO, court records, or similar
  • Familiarity with CIN/DIN structures, ROC organization, or corporate filings
  • AWS: S3 lifecycle policies, SQS, CloudWatch metrics/alarms
  • Email deliverability basics (SES, DKIM) — you'll co-own the digest send

title: Senior Specialist - Risk Management
description:
Individual Contributor role — you'll lead through analysis and judgment, not people management.

We're not hiring someone to fill out risk registers. We're hiring someone to figure out why a risk model missed something last quarter — and build the system that catches it next time.


Why this matters

Deriv's mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. Millions of traders, in multiple currencies, across regulatory regimes, around the clock. At that scale, risk doesn't wait for a quarterly review cycle — it moves as fast as the market does.

Real money, real regulations, real consequences. We're already building risk operations that run continuously: dozens of fraud detection models flagging money-movement patterns and trading abuse in production, AML review pulling risk metrics automatically instead of by hand, and vendor risk assessments run through document analysis instead of a checklist. Not experiments — systems that are already catching things a person reviewing spreadsheets would miss. You'll own the next layer of that.


Why Deriv

We're in production, not planning.
  • Fraud detection models running continuously across money movement, trading abuse, and document forgery
  • Automated AML review: data aggregation, risk metric computation, high-risk client flagging
  • Investigation portals that synthesise findings into unified risk profiles instead of scattered notes
We've proved the model works. You're not waiting for a pilot to get approved — you're extending something that already runs.


Scope of Work

This role focuses on risk assessment and modelling, with cross-functional work in stress testing and AI-assisted monitoring:

  • Risk Assessment & Modelling — Owning the frameworks that assess exposure across trading operations and catch what current models miss
  • Stress Testing & Scenario Design — Designing scenarios that test where our resilience actually breaks, not ones built to pass
  • AI-Assisted Monitoring — Directing how predictive models and automated flagging systems get used, and correcting them when their output is wrong
You'll own outcomes here, with influence into how the wider risk function operates.


What You'll Do

Own outcomes, not just analysis
  • Build and maintain the risk frameworks that assess exposure across trading operations — when they miss something, it's your problem until it's fixed
  • Design stress tests that actually stress something, and defend the results when they're inconvenient
  • Use AI tools to sift large datasets for patterns a manual review would take weeks to find
Work at the edge of the automated and the judgment call
  • Know when a model's flag is noise and when it's the start of something real
  • Feed findings back into the models so they get sharper over time, not just faster
  • Push back when a "risk" flagged by a dashboard isn't actually one
Set the standard, not just meet it
  • Present findings to executive stakeholders and make the case for action, not just visibility
  • Build the playbooks and frameworks that the wider risk team will use after you
  • Partner with compliance so what you flag as a risk holds up against what regulators actually require

Who You Are

  • You've assessed real risk, not just modelled it in theory. 5-8 years in risk management within financial services or trading. You know the difference between a framework that looks rigorous and one that catches actual problems.
  • You think in exposure, not in checklists. You can look at a trading operation and see where it's fragile before a stress test proves it.
  • You're comfortable with AI as a second analyst, not a black box. You understand what predictive models are good at — pattern detection at scale — and where they need a human to catch what they can't see. FRM, PRM, or equivalent certification expected.
  • You lead through the strength of your analysis. You don't need direct reports to have influence. When your risk assessment says something matters, people act on it because the reasoning holds — and the frameworks you build become what the function runs on.


The Honest Reality

This is demanding work. You'll own outcomes with incomplete data, because incomplete data is the only kind risk work ever gets. You'll navigate friction between trading, compliance, and leadership when they all want different answers. You'll establish standards that other analysts get measured against, and defend a risk finding to stakeholders who'd rather it wasn't true.

But you'll build frameworks that outlast the quarter they were written for. You'll work with AI tools that make your analysis sharper instead of slower. And you'll know that when you flag something, it's the reason it got fixed before it became a headline.

If you want risk work that's mostly documentation, this isn't it. If you want to find what the models miss, it might be.

title: Business Controller (afdeling Ouderen - Wonen)
description:
Voor Cordaan in Amsterdam zoeken wij een communicatieve business controller die sterk in zijn/haar schoenen staat. De komende jaren staat het domein Ouderen namelijk voor meerdere uitdagingen, waardoor je als business controller samen met je collega het verschil kunt maken. Klinkt dit voor jou als een interessante uitdaging en ben je klaar voor een volgende stap? Lees dan onderstaande vacature voor Business Controller – Ouderen-Wonen!

Wat krijg je van ons?

We bieden je een uitdagende positie binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam, Diemen, Huizen en Nieuw-Vennep te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT.

  • Contract: jaarcontract voor 32 – 36 uur per week, na een jaar met uitzicht op vast bij goed functioneren;

  • Salaris: FWG 65: min. €4.822,- en max. €7.263,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week;

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%)

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding van € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan;

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen via o.a. Goodhabitz;

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.

  • Hybride werken: Thuis, of op het mooiste kantoor van Amsterdam!

Waar ga je werken?

Cordaan is een ambitieuze, zorgorganisatie. Cordaan biedt jaarlijks 20.000 mensen voor een langere of kortere periode zorg vanuit 120 locaties in Amsterdam, Diemen en Nieuw-Vennep en 60 thuiszorgteams in al deze wijken. Dat doen zij met bijna 6000 medewerkers en ruim 2500 vrijwilligers. Cordaan is er voor iedereen die zorg, ondersteuning of begeleiding nodig heeft. Voor ouderen met dementie of lichamelijke ongemakken, voor kinderen en volwassenen met een verstandelijke beperking en voor mensen met psychische problemen.

Het domein Ouderen binnen Cordaan biedt ondersteuning aan Amsterdammers met een diverse problematiek. Altijd bedoeld om bij te dragen aan een waardevol leven. Niet de diagnose staat centraal, maar het stimuleren van ieders mogelijkheden. Inclusie bij Cordaan krijgt vorm doordat je kunt zijn wie je wilt zijn. Niemand blijft onopgemerkt en moet zo veel mogelijk het leven kunnen leiden dat hij of zij wenst. Liefst zo lang mogelijk in de eigen omgeving. En als dat niet meer kan, op een van onze woonlocaties.

Cordaan is een werkomgeving met veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, dit komt doordat Cordaan een brede zorgorganisatie is. Hierdoor kom je als business controller in aanraking met diverse financieringsstromen binnen de zorg. Ook op persoonlijk vlak is er aandacht en ruimte om je te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Business Controller bij Cordaan heb je een brede en uitdagende verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkt samen in een team van 4 Business Controllers Ouderenzorg, met een andere Business Controller voor het cluster Wonen. Jij bent de sparringpartner van het senior management Wonen en van het directieteam. Daarnaast ben je de vraagbaak op het gebied van financiën en bedrijfsvoering voor de locatiemanagers.

Iedere business controller ondersteunt zijn/haar directie, maar even belangrijk is dat er in het control team overkoepelend samengewerkt wordt om zo een efficiency in werkwijze, uitwisselbaarheid en het delen van kennis en kunde te bereiken. De afdeling bestaat in totaal uit 12 controllers en een manager.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

  • Adviseren van de directie en management Ouderen over het te voeren financiële beleid en bewaak je samen het resultaat van de bedrijfsvoering;

  • Op afroep adviseren tijdens bijeenkomsten met de Raad van Bestuur, hierbij draag je zorg voor een goede balans tussen het ambitieniveau en de haalbaarheid van de plannen;

  • Adviseren van managers binnen het domein bij (complexe) financiële vraagstukken;

  • Waarborging van de P&C-cyclus van de eigen directie en ondersteuning bij de Cordaanbrede cyclus. Het opstellen en bewaken van het budget wordt gedaan door de managers;

  • Het initiëren van verbeterprojecten op het terrein van informatievoorziening en efficiency.

Wie ben jij?

  • Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding bij voorkeur richting finance & control, economie en/of bedrijfseconomie;

  • Je beschikt over enkele jaren (relevante) werkervaring in een (soort)gelijke functie;

  • Je bent een energieke en verbindende persoonlijkheid. Je werkt namelijk veel samen met diverse onderdelen van de organisatie, binnen en buiten de afdeling financiën;

  • Je bent analytisch vaardig, proactief in handelen en geeft zowel gevraagd- als ongevraagd advies;

  • Je zoekt actief naar technologische ontwikkelingen om jouw werkzaamheden naar een hoger niveau te tillen.

Interesse?

Herken jij jezelf in deze functie, of lijkt deze functie je interessant? Dan spreken wij je graag! Solliciteren kan tot woensdag 19 augustus. Op donderdag 20 augustus zullen de eerste gesprekken plaatsvinden.

  • Voor vragen over je sollicitatie kun je terecht bij Rosanne Holmström (Recruiter) via rholmstrom@cordaan.nl of 06 – 28 18 23 88

  • Voor vragen over de inhoud van de functie kun je vanaf 10 augustus terecht bij Sebastiaan Room (directeur Financien) via sroom@cordaan.nl en vanaf 18 augustus bij Jan Jaap Weidema (manager P&C/ BC) via jweidema@cordaan.nl of 06-41278297

Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden.

title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

  • Package reliability expertise with 3–5+ years of experience evaluating semiconductor package construction (substrates, die attach, interconnects, and solder joints) and understanding the failure mechanisms associated with these technologies.

  • Understanding of high-speed I/O and RF reliability, including how reliability degradation impacts high-speed serial, RF, and optical interfaces (e.g., signal integrity, insertion loss, jitter, and eye closure over product lifetime). This expertise goes beyond conventional digital logic reliability and is a core requirement for this role. Experience with photonics reliability is highly desirable.

  • Solid foundation in reliability engineering, including FIT and MTBF calculations, mission profile development, acceleration models, and translating product use cases into measurable reliability requirements and targets.

  • Experience with industry qualification standards, including JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, and IEC, as well as the judgment to apply knowledge-based qualification approaches when existing standards are not sufficient.

  • Failure analysis expertise, with the ability to interpret results from techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, and SEM/EDX, and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.

  • Experience collaborating with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and external laboratories, including defining technical reliability requirements, reviewing qualification data, and driving technical discussions to ensure robust evidence for product qualification.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate reliability risks, trade-offs, and evidence gaps to architects, engineers, suppliers, and leadership.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, ownership, adaptability, and the ability to make progress in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

title: Inspector, Detail I
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Inspector Detail Component voer je inspectiewerkzaamheden aan onderdelen, modules en componenten van gasturbine motoren uit.


Wat zijn jouw taken?

Met gebruik van visuele middelen, mechanische en elektrische meetgereedschappen en/of instrumenten voor je, binnen de regelgeving, richtlijnen en bevoegdheden, inspectie werkzaamheden aan gasturbine motoren uit volgens de gestelde planning. Uiteraard zorg je voor een juiste administratieve verwerking van de uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en het correct vastleggen van inspectiebevindingen en meetgegevens.
Aan de hand van goedgekeurde technische onderhoudsinstructies, meetrapporten en werkinstructies interpreteer je de conditie van het luchtvaartcomponent. Ook verwachten wij van jou dat je tijdig productieverstoringen meldt aan de Production Cell leader of Production Planner.
We vragen je naar voorstellen tot en deelnemen aan de uitvoering van verbeterprojecten.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een technische opleiding en/of ervaring als Inspector Detail Component of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring in de luchtvaart industrie is een pré. Je hebt MBO werk -en denkniveau en een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, in verband met het kunnen lezen, begrijpen en interpreteren van (Engelstalige) technische informatie en/of voorschriften. De luchtvaartbranche eist correcte verslaglegging, dus eigenschappen als kritisch en nauwkeurig zijn belangrijk in deze functie,. Het is een functie met veel verschillende taken, dus je bent goed in het stellen van prioriteiten en communiceert makkelijk met collega’s.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een uitdagende en dynamische functie binnen een internationale luchtvaartomgeving

What will you be doing?

As a Detail Component Inspector, you will perform inspections on parts, modules, and components of gas turbine engines.

What are your responsibilities?

Using visual aids, mechanical and electrical measuring tools, and/or instruments, you will perform inspection work on gas turbine engines in accordance with regulations, guidelines, and your authority, following the established schedule. Naturally, you will ensure the proper administrative processing of the work performed and the accurate recording of inspection findings and measurement data.

It is a position with many different tasks, so you are good at setting priorities and communicate easily with colleagues.

ANÚNCIO DE VAGA

Responsável – Supply Chain (Maputo)

O(A) Responsável do Supply Chain é responsável pela entrega efectiva geral de todos os serviços da área de Supply chain necessários para entregar efectivamente o programa nacional da Save the Children International (SCI). Será responsável por desenvolver o plano departamental de Supply chain de longo prazo para apoiar projectos e fornecer liderança geral para as funções do Supply Chain, Aquisição, Frota e Armazém e Gestão de Activos.

O(A) titular da função vai liderar efectivamente o planeamento e a implementação do Escritório Central de todas as actividades de Supply chain de acordo com os padrões e procedimentos internacionais da SCI. Ele/ela também é responsável por desenvolver a capacidade de todo o Supply Chain e outros colaboradores do Escritório Central quando relevante.

O(A) titular da função é responsável por gerir todos os elementos do departamento de Supply Chain, no abastecimento em todas as 7 províncias de operação da SCI (Maputo, Gaza, Manica, Tete, Nampula e Cabo Delgado). Ele/ela supervisiona um portfólio anual de compras de aproximadamente US$ 13 milhões. Irá ainda maner contacto frequente com fornecedores e parceiros e, ocasionalmente, com autoridades locais e representantes de doadores.

  • Apenas os candidatos de nacionalidade moçambicana serão considerados para as fases subsequentes do processo de recrutamento e selecção.
  • Em caso de uma emergência humanitária grave, o titular da função deverá trabalhar fora do perfil normal da função e poderá variar o horário de trabalho em conformidade

Qualificações

• No mínimo, um diploma de bacharel em Administração de empresas, com viés em gestão de Supply Chain;

• Uma Pós-graduação ou Mestrado em um campo relevante é uma vantagem adicional;

• Qualificação Profissional em Gestão de Supply Chain - CIPS ou equivalente.
