  • Habilidades de planeamento de longo prazo necessárias para planear e implementar processos e procedimentos de Supply chain;
  • Espirito de trabalho em equipa de equipa orientado a soluções e serviços;
  • Boa experiência prática em programas de resposta a emergências;
  • Forte capacidade de gestão orçamentária e financeira;
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais: Capacidade de gerir o pessoal gestão de nível médio e relações entre eles e o pessoal do programa que eles apoiam;
  • Fortes habilidades de negociação, comunicação e análise;
  • Um estilo de gestão que enfatiza o apoio, orientação geral e delegação de autoridade, mantendo a supervisão;
  • Conhecimento básico de gestão de projectos;
  • Excelente capacidade de gestão de tempo e planeamento;
  • Compreensão (ou capacidade de aprender) dos doadores do setor de ONGs e requisitos legais nacionais para a função de Supply Chain, incluindo leis aplicáveis ​​e regulamentos de ONGs.
  • Alfabetização em informática, conhecimento de ERP e excelentes habilidades de documentação;
  • Bom entendimento de projectos relacionados à construção e gestão de frotas.

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Other Information

As a Lead Product Manager in our Discovery (Traveler) organization, you will be a core part of a cross-functional mission team—partnering closely with engineering, design, research, data/analytics, and peer product leaders.

Your mission

Your role is to set a clear product strategy and vision, translate it into measurable outcomes, and continuously iterate based on customer insights and data. While we care deeply about performance and metrics, we don’t optimize KPIs in isolation—we start from real traveler problems, validate them with evidence (qualitative and quantitative), and use measurement to ensure we’re delivering meaningful customer value.

We are looking for a leader who can think beyond the current product, champion the traveler perspective, and drive a compelling, coherent discovery experience across multiple surfaces. You’ll balance near-term impact with long-term systems thinking—building a strong learning agenda through experimentation and aligning cross-functional and cross-team stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and deliver customer and business impact by identifying opportunities, building alignment, and executing with urgency.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Drive sustained customer impact through a long-term (12 months+) roadmap, identifying areas for non-incremental impact.
  • Articulate and connect your product area’s strategy to the company’s mission. Break down the strategy into actionable steps, regularly update stakeholders on progress, and create excitement for your long-term vision. Build alignment across cross-functional teams, partner teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Drive coherence across multiple discovery entry points (e.g., browse, landing pages, inspiration modules), balancing short-term wins with a durable information architecture and scalable content strategy.
  • Synthesize customer feedback, research insights, and business metrics to identify and prioritize the most meaningful traveler problems. Define success measures and iterate based on evidence to ensure we deliver real customer value. Make strategic decisions on sequencing and prioritizing product work to maximize impact and learning.
  • Build and execute an experimentation strategy—developing a robust hypothesis pipeline, defining guardrails and a learning agenda, and ensuring high-quality measurement. Use experiment outcomes to derive actionable insights, inform roadmap decisions, and align cross-team priorities and trade-offs.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery, ensuring high-quality execution from discovery through launch and iteration, and enabling effective collaboration across engineering, design, research, and data.
  • Build strong relationships and alignment across partner teams that influence discovery quality (e.g., Search, Recommendations, Brand/Content, Commercial). Set clear expectations, align on shared goals and trade-offs, and drive cross-functional execution against your roadmap.
  • Represent the traveler perspective at all levels, communicate decisions with clarity and transparency with your team, peers, and executive leadership. Coach PMs and cross-functional partners to raise the bar on product thinking and execution and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of professional experience in product management and at least 2+ years as a Lead Product Manager.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with customer problems and value creation, using data and metrics to validate impact rather than as the starting point.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a significant product area with responsibilities for strategy, KPI definition, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.
  • Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.
  • Strong ability to lead in ambiguity, influence without authority, and align multiple teams around shared outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets.
  • Demonstrated passion for driving customer and business impact.
  • Bonus: Experience working in a marketplace or the travel industry is a plus, but not required.
  • Bonus: Experience owning consumer discovery/browse/search-adjacent top-of-funnel product areas at scale, including SEO- and landing-page ecosystems (content, templates, indexation, and measurement) is a plus but ot required.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

title: Director of Growth
description:
Growth Director

Zürich, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Stokke, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

As Growth Director, you will be the commercial driving force behind DEPT®'s growth in Switzerland. You will be responsible for winning new clients and exceeding our growth ambitions across Digital Experience, Technology, Commerce, Data & AI.

Our services span Digital Strategy, Customer Experience, CMS & Digital Experience Platforms, Commerce, Data & AI, and Digital Transformation.

Will you bring the next leading Swiss client such as CSS, Ricola, CONCORDIA or Lufthansa to DEPT®?

In this role, you will be part of the Swiss Growth team, working closely with specialists across Experience, Technology, Commerce, Data and AI. You will build and maintain a strong commercial pipeline, lead strategic business development initiatives, and own the complete sales lifecycle—from identifying new opportunities and leading pitches, tenders and RFPs through to commercial negotiations and seamless client onboarding.

To succeed in this role, you combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial instincts. You are strategic, relationship-driven, curious, and passionate about helping ambitious brands accelerate their digital transformation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead and win strategic pitches, tenders, RFPs, and new business opportunities across the Swiss market.
  • Build and develop a strong commercial pipeline through networking, executive events, roundtables, and client relationships.
  • Identify and qualify new opportunities while assembling the right cross-functional teams to create compelling, integrated solutions.
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle—from initial outreach and qualification through proposal development, commercial negotiations, contract signature, and successful client onboarding.
  • Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with C-level stakeholders, procurement teams, and key decision-makers.
  • Collaborate closely with our international teams on complex, multi-market opportunities.
  • Represent DEPT® at industry events, conferences, executive dinners, and networking opportunities across Switzerland.
  • Foster a commercial growth mindset throughout the organisation and help teams identify and develop new business opportunities.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • A proven track record of winning new business within a digital agency, consultancy, or technology company.
  • Experience selling Digital Experience, CMS, Commerce, Digital Platform, or Digital Transformation solutions.
  • Strong experience leading complex pitches and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across Strategy, Experience Design, Technology, Data, and AI.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging executive-level decision-makers.
  • An established network within the Swiss market is a strong advantage.
  • At least 5 years of experience in business development, sales, or growth within digital services.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, commercially driven, and eager to continuously learn.
  • Fluent in German (Swiss German is a strong advantage) and English, both written and spoken. French is considered a plus.

WE OFFER

  • Flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location);
  • 25 days holiday with the opportunity to take unpaid leave;
  • Flexible health budget and Wellness & personal day.
  • Learning & development budget.
  • Referral bonus program.
  • Occasional breakfast & lunch at the office, Smoothie Tuesday.
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform.
  • You can choose to work from the spacious and barrier-free location in Zurich; in Bern you can expect a small but nice and fully equipped office where you can hit the keys in peace.
  • Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
  • Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Research Assistant (Mathematics/Computer Science/Statistics)
description:
Join Our Team at the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore

The School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS) at NTU Singapore hosts research and education activities in two divisions: Division of Mathematical Sciences (MAS) and Division of Physics and Applied Physics (PAP). MAS covers diverse topics ranging from pure mathematics to the applications of mathematics in cryptography, computing, business, and finance. PAP covers many areas of fundamental and applied physics, including quantum information, condensed matter physics, biophysics, and photonics. Over the years, SPMS has attracted talented individuals from around the world and Singapore to join as scientific leaders and researchers.

Key Job Purpose:

We have an opening for the position of “Research Assistant” for a research project related to statistical learning of time-series models. The successful candidate will work with Hemant Tyagi (NTU Singapore) and Chew Lock Yue (NTU Singapore) in collaboration with Ernesto Araya (LMU Munich) on extending our recent work on matching correlated VAR time-series models. The duration of this project is expected to be between 4-6 months and could potentially lead to a PhD position at SPMS in NTU Singapore (based on performance).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development of algorithms

  • Develop codebase in Python and perform large-scale simulations on synthetic/real data sets

  • Report the findings in the form of a report/article, with the aim of publishing in ML journal/conference

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s in Mathematics/Computer Science/Statistics or related fields

  • Strong background in probability and statistics as evidenced by coursework

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Good knowledge of Python

  • Good interpersonal skills

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Senior Product Manager - Finance Automation (f/m/d)
description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

The role:

As our Senior Product Manager – Finance Automation Platform (f/m/d), you will own a brand-new Core Platform domain focused on Finance. Acting as the primary product partner for our Finance Automation team, you will translate financial and accounting requirements into scalable platform capabilities that automate reconciliation, improve data integrity, and enable reliable financial operations.

This is a true domain ownership role. You will define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the Finance Platform domain while working closely with Engineering and Finance to build reliable, scalable solutions. You will also help shape the future scope of the platform, including how far ownership should extend into finance systems and accounting processes.

Your tasks:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Finance Platform domain, aligning platform investments with Finance and business priorities.

  • Act as the primary product partner between Finance and Core Platform Engineering, building trusted relationships and translating financial requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Drive the automation of reconciliation, accounting workflows, and financial data processing, reducing manual effort and increasing operational reliability.

  • Translate accounting policies, financial controls, and compliance requirements into platform services, data models, and automation.

  • Ensure the reliability, integrity, and auditability of finance-critical data across platform services and infrastructure changes.

  • Partner with Finance to continuously improve reconciliation accuracy, financial reporting, and audit readiness.

  • Collaborate closely with Payments and other product teams to ensure finance-relevant data is generated consistently and reliably across the platform.

  • Establish scalable ways of working, including transparent prioritisation, request management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Define, monitor, and continuously improve KPIs such as reconciliation accuracy, automation coverage, finance data reliability, manual effort reduction, and audit outcomes.

  • Help shape the long-term ownership model for finance-related platform capabilities together with Finance leadership.

What you offer us:

  • Proven experience owning a product or platform domain end-to-end, including product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritisation, and stakeholder management.

  • Strong understanding of finance operations, accounting processes, reconciliation, financial controls, or financial reporting.

  • Ability to translate complex business and financial requirements into scalable technical solutions and platform capabilities.

  • Experience working closely with engineering teams on data-intensive or platform products.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across Finance, Engineering, and other business functions.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using KPIs and data to guide product decisions and measure impact.

  • Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where you help shape product scope, ownership, and long-term strategy.

  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central), audit processes, or regulated industries is a strong plus.

What we offer you:

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €2,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Project description

Our client is a leading Singapore-based financial institution embarking on an enterprise-wide AI transformation programme to accelerate the adoption of Generative AI across business and technology functions. The programme focuses on deploying and operating Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation solutions within a secure, highly regulated banking environment. As part of this strategic initiative, we are looking for an experienced AI DevOps Engineer / MLOps Engineer to build, automate, and manage AI model deployment pipelines, enabling secure, scalable, and reliable delivery of AI solutions across the bank. You will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Platform Engineers, Security teams, and Application Development teams to operationalise AI workloads on modern cloud and container platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment.
  • Deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) from Hugging Face and other model repositories into development, UAT, and production environments.
  • Automate model packaging, versioning, testing, and release using DevOps best practices.
  • Manage Kubernetes/OpenShift based AI platforms for model hosting and inference.
  • Build deployment pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Containerise AI applications using Docker and deploy them into Kubernetes clusters.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications using REST APIs and microservices.
  • Manage model lifecycle, rollback strategies, monitoring, and production support.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible) for AI platform provisioning.
  • Configure model serving platforms such as vLLM, Ollama, Triton Inference Server, or similar.
  • Monitor application and model health using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace, or Splunk.
  • Optimise GPU resource utilisation and troubleshoot model performance issues.
  • Collaborate with AI Engineers to productionise new models and inference pipelines.
  • Ensure security, governance, and compliance requirements are met within the banking environment.
  • Participate in production releases, incident management, and continuous platform improvements.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jenkins.
  • Strong knowledge of GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML models from Hugging Face or similar model repositories.
  • Strong Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift experience.
  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Hands-on scripting experience using Bash, Python, or Shell scripting.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline automation.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible.
  • Knowledge of container registries such as Artifactory, Nexus, or Docker Registry.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Understanding of GPU-enabled environments and NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem.
  • Experience configuring model serving platforms such as:
  • vLLM
  • Ollama
  • NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
  • Text Generation Inference (TGI)
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
  • Strong troubleshooting and production support skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to have

• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or AI Agent frameworks. • Experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector). • Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture. • Experience deploying Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, or other open-source LLMs. • Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, or other MLOps platforms. • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ. • Experience with API Gateway and service mesh technologies. • Knowledge of security scanning tools such as Trivy, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or Snyk. • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices. • Agile/Scrum delivery experience. • Previous experience within Banking, Capital Markets, or Financial Services. • Experience supporting AI platforms in production environments.

title: System Engineer (Digital)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Elicit, analyses, specify, and manage system and software requirements across the lifecycle, following ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 (requirements engineering) and the INCOSE Guide to Writing Requirements (GtWR) — every requirement necessary, unambiguous, singular, feasible, and verifiable, and every requirement set complete, consistent, and able to be validated.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability: stakeholder need → system requirement → architectural element → implementation → verification evidence. This is the artefact an auditor asks for, and it must exist as a living structure, not a retrofit.
  • Operate the requirements process within an ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 lifecycle-process frame (as codified in the INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook, 5th edition): stakeholder needs & requirements definition, system requirements definition, architecture definition, verification, validation, transition, operation.
  • Run a digital requirements engineering toolchain rather than documents-in-a-folder: requirements held in a managed repository with change control, baselines, and query-able trace links (e.g. Jama Connect, Polarion, DOORS or an equivalent the organisation standardises on.
  • Author and own verification & validation strategy: define acceptance criteria at requirement-authoring time (not after the fact), and map each requirement to its verification method — inspection, analysis, demonstration, or test.
  • Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement
  • Contribute production code across the stack — able to read, review, and where needed write both service-side and client-side code well enough to keep requirements honest against implementation reality.
  • Design and review APIs and service contracts as first-class interfaces (a system interface is a requirements artefact, not just a coding detail).
  • Work fluently with the platform's delivery mechanics: version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and the review gates that make changes auditable.
  • Translate abstract non-functional requirements (latency, availability, recoverability, security posture) into concrete, testable engineering targets and confirm they are met.
  • Architect and review solutions on cloud infrastructure with an emphasis on security, data residency, resilience, and cost — and record those decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) with the trade-offs made explicit.
  • Design for the platform's operating constraints: identity and access, secrets management, encryption with organization-controlled keys, network segmentation, and infrastructure-as-code as the source of truth.
  • Own or contribute to non-functional architecture: availability and recovery targets, capacity and scaling models, and observability — and ensure they trace back to stated requirements rather than being asserted.
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform-component decisions on evidence (supportability, licence terms, security maintenance status), not vendor narrative

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related discipline.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Demonstrable experience across at least two of the three core stacks (systems/requirements engineering, full stack, cloud) at depth, with working competence in the third and a credible path to depth.
  • Requirements engineering competence evidenced by real artefacts: requirement specifications, trace matrices, verification plans — ideally under a recognized standard (INCOSE GtWR, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148).
  • Hands-on software engineering experience: has written and shipped production code, understands testing, CI/CD, and code review as engineering controls.
  • Cloud architecture experience on at least one major cloud, with security and resilience as design drivers rather than afterthoughts.
  • Fluency with traceability and evidence as a working practice — comfortable being asked "how do you know this requirement is met?" and having an answer that points to an artefact.
  • Clear technical writing. In a regulated context, the specification is the deliverable.
  • Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Good communication skills.

Essential / Desirable Traits

  • Possess learning agility, flexibility and pro-activity
  • Comfortable with agile teamwork and user engagement

title: Postdoctoral staff scientist position (f/m/x)
description:
We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Postdoctoral staff scientist position (f/m/x) at the Department of Medicine University of Cologne

Cardio-Oncology, Single-cell & spatial omics in cardio-oncology

TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%)
limited to 3 years, corresponding to the duration of the project funding, and is subject to the provisions of the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG)
Salary is in accordance with pay grade E13 TV-L

Your tasks

We are looking for candidates with a strong background in single-cell and/or spatial immunoprofiling and experience in bioinformatic analysis of -omics datasets to interrogate immune system alterations. In close collaboration with scientists and clinicians from the Clinic I for Internal Medicine/Oncology department, the candidate will test established mouse models of cardio-oncology and aim to collect clinical specimens. The task focuses on identifying immune cell alterations in the tumor post cardiovascular injury and, vice versa, the tumor-induced changes on cardiovascular disease. With this data, we aim to elucidate the interplay between the failing heart and the growing tumor. In this role, you will help establish and drive the experimental and computational framework of the project, including developing single-cell and spatial omics pipelines, generating, analyzing, and integrating multi-omic datasets while collaborating closely with clinicians and interdisciplinary partners. The ideal candidate has the ability to work independently in an interdisciplinary environment and will engage in training and supervision of undergraduate and medical students.

Your profile

We are seeking talented scientists with a PhD in immunology, biomedical science, bioinformatics, computational biology or a related field, ideally with a strong track record of publications and proven experience with single-cell data and immune cell analysis (e.g., scRNA-seq; spatial or epigenomics is a strong plus). Basic knowledge of the immune system is required. Programming skills in R and/or Python as well as an interest in or willingness to engage in wet-lab work (sample preparation, mouse handling) are required. Prior experience with mouse handling is desirable (e.g. FELASA-certification). The working language is English, and excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills are essential.

Our offer

  • Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
  • Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.
  • Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
  • Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.

Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

A position is available jointly offered by the AG Riffelmacher and AG Winkels at the Faculty of Medicine, University Hospital Cologne, Germany, to investigate immune cell biology at the interface of cardiovascular disease and cancer. Our research focuses on the bidirectional interplay between cardiovascular injury and malignancy, examining how immune responses shape post-cardiovascular disease tumor development and how cancer and its therapies affect cardiac inflammation, remodeling, and repair. We combine mechanistic studies in mouse models with translational analyses of human samples to define immune pathways that drive disease progression or tissue regeneration, with the goal of developing new immunologically informed strategies for cardio-oncology.
Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification. The position is suitable for staffing with part-time employees.

title: Boyswear Apparel Designer - Licensed Brands - 12 Months Fixed Term Contract
description:
Working Pattern: Typically 5 days in the office, with core hours flexible between 8am-6pm.

Please note: Ideal start date September 2026.


The Role
As a Boys Apparel Designer within Next’s Fashion Brands team, you will act as a creative guardian for a prestigious brand portfolio, ensuring the brand's unique "DNA" is translated into elevated, commercially successful designs across boyswear!

By bridging the gap between trend research and technical execution, you’ll make a tangible impact on the aesthetic direction of our collections, reacting with agility to market data to keep our offerings ahead of the curve.

You will thrive in a highly collaborative environment, working side-by-side with partner brands and internal garment teams to bring concepts to life across diverse product categories. To ensure your success from day one, Next provides comprehensive brand immersion and technical onboarding, supporting your transition into our fast-paced, premium design landscape

What You’ll Take On

  • Design High-Impact Boyswear/Baby Apparel Collections ages 0-14: Create innovative, commercial boyswear and baby garments that blend technical functionality with licensed brand aesthetics.
  • Manage Factory Partnerships: Liaise directly with global factories and suppliers to oversee the manufacturing process, ensuring your design requirements and technical details translate perfectly into the final product.
  • Build Trusted Licensing Relationships: Foster strong, professional bonds with external license brand partners and internal teams to build a culture of confidence, trust, and seamless collaboration.
  • Coordinate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Garment Technologists, Buying, and Merchandising teams to develop fit-for-purpose ranges that meet rigorous performance standards while hitting critical path deadlines.
  • Translate Global Trends: Continually research and communicate emerging global trends in casual wear and formal wear silhouettes, fabrications, trims, and colour, turning trend inspiration into commercial and elevated design concepts.
  • Deliver Technical Precision: Produce detailed and highly accurate Tech Packs, specifying garment construction, fabrics, trims, and fit specifications to provide factories with clear guidelines that minimise errors and maximise efficiency.

What You’ll Bring

We are looking for an experienced designer who brings the following strengths to the team:

  • Versatile Boyswear Design Expertise: You possess an adaptable design "handwriting" and a high level of attention to detail that allows you to switch effortlessly between different licensed brands, trend aesthetics, age ranges, and product tiers across the boys market, to include both casual wear and smarter product categories, ensuring high quality standards and elevation across all product categories.
  • Technical Mastery: You are highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite and know how to build thorough tech packs that respect factory capabilities and price points.
  • Commercial Sharpness: You stay ahead of macro and micro trends, understanding how to design boyswear ranges that are commercially viable, highly functional, and perfectly aligned with a license partner's DNA.
  • Resilience and Agility: You thrive in fast-paced design environments, staying organised and positive even when priorities shift. You view fast-moving trends and brand changes as an opportunity to innovate rather than a hurdle.
  • Clear Communication: You can present your boyswear concepts with confidence and communicate complex technical and brand requirements clearly to both internal stakeholders, brand partners, and global suppliers.
  • Forward-Thinking Skills: While not essential, experience with 3D design software, AI visualisation tools will give you a significant head start.

Portfolios

To help us get a feel for your style, please attach a digital portfolio. We’re looking for work that demonstrates a sharp eye for the future of boys apparel designs and how these can be commercially viable for Next, and showcases your trend research, garment designs and CAD work within this as well! To help you put your best foot forward, we’ve put together a few top tips on what makes a portfolio stand out to our team.

Please ensure your digital samples are uploaded with your submission, as we are unable to consider applications that do not include a portfolio.

Sponsorship
Candidates wishing to apply who would require sponsorship for this role will be required to meet the Home Office sponsorship requirements. For further information please see: https://www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa.

We encourage early applications for our roles, as our recruitment process begins as soon as the role is advertised. If we successfully fill the position, this advert may close earlier than planned.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Grade 2 Dietitian to join our growing team. This role will be working 3 days per week, permanent part-time position. In this role, you will provide high-quality, evidence-based nutrition care across a diverse clinical caseload while working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to achieve the best possible outcomes for patients. The role encompasses working within inpatient and day rehabilitation settings, and may also involve servicing our private practice, Ramsay Health Plus (including appointments on-site and home visits).

You enjoy working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team, have excellent communication and rapport-building skills, and are committed to achieving positive patient outcomes through evidence-based practice. You are proactive, adaptable and thrive in a dynamic healthcare environment.

You will also bring:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Nutrition and Dietetics.

  • Demonstrated experience as a Grade 2 Dietitian or a minimum of 3 years’ post-graduate experience in a relevant clinical dietetics setting
  • Well-developed clinical assessment, counselling and clinical reasoning skills.
  • Demonstrated high level of knowledge and skills in rehabilitation dietetics
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective relationships with patients, families and healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise a varied caseload.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development and evidence-based practice.

  • A commitment to Ramsay Health Care's values of People Caring for People.

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Gadekæret
description:
I Gadekæret i Risskov leder vi ikke bare efter en men to pædagogmedhjælpere.

Nogle der brænder for af arbejde med børn og for at være en aktiv del af deres hverdag.

Nogle, der er nysgerrig på relationer og fællesskaber – og som har lyst til at bidrage til et miljø, hvor alle børn oplever, at de hører til.

Hos os handler det ikke kun om det, vi gør. Det handler også om måden, vi er sammen på.

Hvem er vi?
Gadekæret er en mindre integreret daginstitution med 17 vuggestuebørn og 30 børnehavebørn. Der er en stilling i begge grupper, men vi er ét hus, og vi hjælpes ad på tværs og du skal derfor have mod på arbejdet med alle børn (0-6 år).

Vi organiserer os i mindre grupper fremfor klassiske stuer, fordi det giver os bedre mulighed for at:

  • se det enkelte barn
  • skabe gode deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • tilpasse vores hverdag, når noget kalder på nye løsninger

Vi har et spændende hus i to plan med gode fysiske rammer, blandt andet gymnastiksal, atelier, vandleg og mange varierede legerum. Udenfor har vi en dejlig legeplads, og vi arbejder løbende med at udvikle vores læringsmiljøer både inde og ude.

Kom gerne forbi og oplev huset – ring og aftal en tid.

Det, vi er optagede af

Vi er optagede af børns trivsel, udvikling og fællesskaber.

Vi er nysgerrige på:

  • Hvad prøver barnet at fortælle os?
  • Hvordan kan vi støtte barnet bedst muligt?
  • Hvordan skaber vi deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn?

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når vi undrer os sammen og tør dele vores tanker med hinanden.

Det kalder vi på hos dig

Vi håber, du kan genkende dig selv i noget af dette:

  • Du har lyst til at arbejde med børn og være en vigtig del af deres hverdag.
  • Du er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og kan skabe gode relationer.
  • Du tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.
  • Du kan lide en hverdag med både leg, aktivitet og struktur.
  • Du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt.
  • Du deltager aktivt i legen og møder børnene i deres perspektiv.
  • Du kan samarbejde med både kolleger og forældre og deltager på møder mv.
  • Erfaring fra dagtilbud er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at være sammen med børn og bidrage til et trygt, udviklende og inkluderende miljø.

Hos os får du

Et hus hvor vi:

  • hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab
  • tager vores arbejde med børn alvorligt – uden at tage os selv alt for alvorligt
  • giver plads til spørgsmål, refleksion og nye idéer
  • arbejder målrettet med børnefællesskaber og læringsmiljøer
  • har fokus på både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet

Vi arbejder med Bredere Børnefællesskaber som en central del af vores udvikling. Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Forældresamarbejde

Forældrene er en vigtig del af barnets liv – og dermed også af vores arbejde.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du:

  • møder forældrene venligt og professionelt
  • deler de gode historier fra barnets hverdag
  • bidrager til et tillidsfuldt samarbejde

Du står aldrig alene – men du skal have lyst til at være en aktiv del af samarbejdet.

Til sidst – det vigtigste

Hvis du har lyst til at være en del af et hus, hvor vi:

  • tænker sammen
  • hjælper hinanden
  • udvikler os sammen
  • og hver dag arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene

så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Du bliver samtidig en del af Risskov Dagtilbud, hvor vi arbejder ud fra fælles pædagogiske værdier og et stærkt fokus på børns trivsel, udvikling og fællesskaber.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så skriv en motiveret ansøgning og fortæl, hvorfor vi skal vælge dig og hvad du brænder for i samarbejdet og i arbejdet med børn.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt.

Tiltrædelse: 1. september 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 13-08-2026



Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: SOSU-assistent søges til plejehjemmet Sønderskovhus i Lystrup.
description:
Om jobbet:

Vi søger en SOSU-assistent, der – sammen med engagerede kollegaer – vil være med til at skabe et trygt, meningsfuldt og værdigt hverdagsliv for vores beboere. Hos os står du aldrig alene. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi sparrer, og vi tænker os selv som ét fælles hus.

Vi ved, at arbejdsliv og privatliv skal hænge sammen. Derfor tilbyder vi fleksible muligheder, så vi sammen kan finde den løsning, der passer bedst til dig.

Vi tror på, at de bedste rammer for vores beboere skabes af medarbejdere, der trives, og derfor er vi åbne for dialog om, hvordan dit arbejdsliv kan tilpasses bedst muligt.

Vi arbejder personcentreret med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov, og vi er meget bevidste om at træde respektfuldt ind i deres liv og hjem. Hvis du drømmer om at gøre en reel forskel og være med til at forme det gode hverdagsliv på Sønderskovhus, så er det her, du skal være.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område. P.t. forventes tjenesten fortrinsvis at være i dag- og aftenvagt.


Din profil:

Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og fælles ansvar er fundamentet for hverdagen. Med naturligt engagement bidrager du til at styrke og udvikle den faglige kvalitet, både i samarbejdet med kolleger og i den nære kontakt med beboerne.

Som person er du stabil, fleksibel og handlekraftig. Du arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver. Du formår at planlægge og prioritere, så kvaliteten i plejen altid er i fokus.

Du kommunikerer anerkendende og konstruktivt og har let ved at skabe tillidsfulde relationer til både beboere, pårørende og kolleger. Erfaring med Cura er en fordel, og du trives i en dynamisk hverdag, hvor forandringer og mange bolde i luften er en naturlig del af arbejdet.

Vi forventer, at du møder mennesker med stor empati, respekt og forståelse for den enkeltes livssituation. Du arbejder sundhedsfremmende og rehabiliterende med fokus på at understøtte beboernes ressourcer, livskvalitet og selvbestemmelse.

Du arbejder selvstændigt, reflekterer over din praksis og har lyst til løbende at udvikle dine kompetencer, så du altid kan yde den bedst mulige pleje og behandling. Samtidig er du en holdspiller, der tager ansvar for fællesskabet og bidrager aktivt til at finde de bedste løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.


Derfor skal du vælge os:

Sønderskovhus Plejehjem er hjem for 38 beboere fordelt på tre huse, herunder flere ægtepar boliger. Vi ligger i skønne omgivelser midt i Lystrup og danner rammen om et hjem med nærvær, tryghed og hjerterum.

Hos os får du ikke blot et arbejde – du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel hver eneste dag. Vi tilbyder et arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, humor, varme og en anerkendende tilgang til hinanden. Du får mulighed for at præge din rolle, bringe dine idéer i spil og udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Vi prioriterer trivsel, arbejdsglæde og et stærkt kollegaskab højt. Derfor står du heller ikke alene. Du bliver en del af en medarbejdergruppe med dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, som vil gøre deres bedste for at give dig en tryg introduktion, værdifuld sparring og en god start på Sønderskovhus.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt den 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: 37 timer


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til forstander Tina Fangel – tlf. 4187 3984 / tiif@aarhus.dk
Vi giver gerne en kop kaffe og viser dig rundt på vores skønne plejehjem.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. august 2026

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler den 20. august 2026

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

  • Develop and deliver detailed SDM (Subscriber Data Management) core network solution designs and architectures, including technical risk evaluations for end-to-end solutions.

You will be responsible for the technical management and ongoing improvement of APM's end-user computing environment, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, application delivery platforms, and virtual desktop technologies.

Working closely with Digital, Infrastructure, and Security teams, you will ensure our end-user technology estate remains secure, scalable, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the deployment, configuration, and management of desktops, laptops, and end-user devices.
  • Deliver applications, patches, updates, and software deployments across the organisation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex end-user computing issues.

    • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)
    • Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS)
    • Application virtualisation solutions

  • Ensure compliance with security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and maintain security controls including multi-factor authentication, encryption, and access management.
  • Identify, prioritise, and remediate vulnerabilities within agreed service levels.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to continuously improve workplace technology services.

About You

You are a customer-focused technology professional who enjoys solving problems and improving the digital experience for end users. You bring strong technical knowledge across endpoint technologies and thrive in a hands-on environment.

Required Experience

  • 2+ years' experience in End User Computing, Desktop Support, or IT Operations.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile device platforms.
  • Experience with endpoint management tools such as:
    • Microsoft Intune
    • SCCM/MECM
    • Nerdio
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity management solutions.
  • Experience supporting application deployment and endpoint security initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Desirable

  • Industry certifications relevant to End User Computing, Microsoft technologies, or endpoint management.
  • ITIL certification or exposure to ITIL processes and service management frameworks.

Why Join APM?

At APM, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation making a positive impact in people's lives. You'll work alongside talented technology professionals in a collaborative environment where innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth are encouraged.

If you're passionate about delivering exceptional end-user experiences and want to be part of a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager, Redis Core (Document Database) - Product Management - Spain
description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

The Team

Document-oriented workloads are at the heart of many modern applications, and in this role you’ll help shape how developers build them using Redis. You will own and evolve Redis’s document data capabilities, enabling developers to work with JSON-based application data in a fast, intuitive, and scalable way across a wide range of real-world use cases.

You’ll work on a highly visible and deeply technical product area, collaborating closely with experienced engineers, architects, and customer-facing teams. The challenges you’ll tackle span data modelling, performance, memory efficiency, scalability, and developer experience, with direct feedback from customers running document-centric workloads at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how Redis is used beyond caching, while balancing simplicity and flexibility with the needs of open source users and enterprise customers in cloud and self-managed environments. If you enjoy turning complex data problems into clear, intuitive product experiences and seeing your work adopted quickly and widely, this is the role for you

The Role

What type of work will you be doing:


Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap for Redis’s document-oriented data capabilities as well as advanced ways to query them

  • Identify and prioritize document-centric use cases where Redis delivers strong customer value

  • Work with our alliances team to establish relationships with key partners in the document-centric application and data ecosystem, and drive joint customer value

  • Translate customer and market needs around JSON-based data models, document access patterns, scalability, and reliability into clear product requirements

  • Partner with GTM, sales, and marketing to help position and explain Redis’s document use cases

  • Gather customer feedback through direct engagement, usage data, and market research

  • Drive successful launches and measure adoption and impact


What You’ll Bring to Redis

Your experience and strengths:

  • 5+ years of experience in software product management or equivalent experience in an enterprise organization

  • Strong understanding of document-oriented data models and application data patterns (e.g., JSON-based data, document storage and access patterns, or similar systems)

  • Ability to articulate both high-level concepts and detailed technical requirements concisely, verbally and in writing

  • Comfortable with code and capable of collaborating closely with engineers on technical design

  • BSc in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience

    Extra great if you have

    • Experience managing database, infrastructure, or storage products

    • Hands-on experience with popular document databases (e.g., Couchbase, Firestore, or Aerospike)

    • Experience building developer-centric APIs, SDKs, or tools

    • Prior experience with NoSQL or real-time databases (extra points for Redis experience)

What are the benefits and perks of working at Redis Bulgaria

  • Competitive compensation package formed by salary and equity grants

  • 25 days of vacation time

  • Hybrid working options from both home and the office

  • Home internet & phone monthly allowance

  • One-time home-office setup allowance

  • Health and dental insurance for you

  • Personal life insurance

  • Critical Illness Cover

  • Lunch and snacks in the office

  • Multisport/CoolFit card

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

title: Consultant
description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Customer Success Consultant II

Ready to combine your passion for cutting-edge technology with elite strategic problem-solving? Shape the future of digital enterprise leadership. Location: Mexico City, Mexico | Work Model: On-site

About the Team

Appian Customer Success is obsessed with delivering exceptional customer outcomes and mission-critical business impact at speed. Our team acts as the elite consulting arm of Appian, partnering directly with the world’s largest commercial clients to bring their most ambitious ideas to life. By joining this high-performance team, you will establish a world-class foundation in professional consulting while directly accelerating global adoption of our AI-Powered Process Automation platform.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Consultant at Appian, you won’t just write code—you will architect modern business transformations. This role offers an unprecedented opportunity to sit at the intersection of business strategy and technical innovation. Instead of being pigeonholed into isolated legacy components, you will own the end-to-end delivery of highly visible, custom software solutions. You will work side-by-side with client executives to solve complex workflow problems, build robust integrations, and empower enterprise teams to achieve Enterprise-Grade Orchestration.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect & Implement: Design, develop, and deploy robust, custom automation solutions throughout the entire project lifecycle utilizing Appian’s low-code platform.
  • Integrate Ecosystems: Build seamless data connections and scalable APIs to integrate multiple external enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, and JDBC connections.
  • Engineer Data Models: Launch new relational data models in production environments and optimize database design through sophisticated SQL development.
  • Lead Agile Delivery: Partner within cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies (sprints, stand-ups, pair programming) to rapidly deliver high-value features.
  • Empower Clients: Collaborate closely with client technical teams and business stakeholders, driving platform adoption and training users to become self-sufficient.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience: 1+ years of hands-on experience in software development or technical implementation consulting.
  • Core Engineering: Proven track record with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), database design, and SQL (writing complex queries, joins, and views).
  • Requirements Gathering: Demonstrated ability to analyze client business processes and translate them into functional and technical system requirements.
  • Mobility: Willingness to travel up to 20% to support customer engagements and on-site collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with modern cloud architecture and environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud, or Elastic Containers.
  • Exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, Analytics, and automated test suites within a continuous integration framework.
  • We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.

#TechConsulting #SoftwareEngineering #SQL #Agile #AppianCareers

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Project description

Our client is a leading Singapore-based financial institution embarking on an enterprise-wide AI transformation programme to accelerate the adoption of Generative AI across business and technology functions. The programme focuses on deploying and operating Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation solutions within a secure, highly regulated banking environment. As part of this strategic initiative, we are looking for an experienced AI DevOps Engineer / MLOps Engineer to build, automate, and manage AI model deployment pipelines, enabling secure, scalable, and reliable delivery of AI solutions across the bank. You will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Platform Engineers, Security teams, and Application Development teams to operationalise AI workloads on modern cloud and container platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment. Deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) from Hugging Face and other model repositories into development, UAT, and production environments. Automate model packaging, versioning, testing, and release using DevOps best practices. Manage Kubernetes/OpenShift based AI platforms for model hosting and inference. Build deployment pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD tools. Containerise AI applications using Docker and deploy them into Kubernetes clusters. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications using REST APIs and microservices. Manage model lifecycle, rollback strategies, monitoring, and production support. Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible) for AI platform provisioning. Configure model serving platforms such as vLLM, Ollama, Triton Inference Server, or similar. Monitor application and model health using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace, or Splunk. Optimise GPU resource utilisation and troubleshoot model performance issues. Collaborate with AI Engineers to productionise new models and inference pipelines. Ensure security, governance, and compliance requirements are met within the banking environment. Participate in production releases, incident management, and continuous platform improvements.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 6–10 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jenkins.
  • Strong knowledge of GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML models from Hugging Face or similar model repositories.
  • Strong Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift experience.
  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Hands-on scripting experience using Bash, Python, or Shell scripting.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline automation.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible.
  • Knowledge of container registries such as Artifactory, Nexus, or Docker Registry.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Understanding of GPU-enabled environments and NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem.
  • Experience configuring model serving platforms such as:
  • vLLM
  • Ollama
  • NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
  • Text Generation Inference (TGI)
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
  • Strong troubleshooting and production support skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to have

• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or AI Agent frameworks. • Experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector). • Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture. • Experience deploying Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, or other open-source LLMs. • Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, or other MLOps platforms. • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ. • Experience with API Gateway and service mesh technologies. • Knowledge of security scanning tools such as Trivy, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or Snyk. • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices. • Agile/Scrum delivery experience. • Previous experience within Banking, Capital Markets, or Financial Services. • Experience supporting AI platforms in production environments.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
Orange Business is here!

About us

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

As a SOC Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Map your knowledge to a defense in depth strategy implemented on our detection capabilities
  • Analyze security events raised by our tooling and take adequate steps together with the customer’s security department to mitigate them
  • Develop and improve playbooks within our SOAR used to automate our investigations & amp; remediation procedures
  • Interlock with CyberSOC teams to actively implement new threat scenarios in our customers context
  • Advice customers on cyber trends
  • Contribute to our mentorship program towards other SOC analysts
  • Your success is defined by building a trust relationship with our customers and minimizing risks based on their business.

About you

Skills:

  • Cybersecurity needs to be your passion, securing the customers assets your mission. As security is often a tradeoff between different aspects, you need to be pragmatic, and result driven to get your message delivered while reducing the risk for the customer.
  • Minimal a bachelor’s degree in computer science or programming
  • 3+ years of experience in security management services-oriented position giving support and/or performing installations of network security systems with proven working experience in logs collection and threat monitoring
  • 2+ years of experience in a SOC role
  • Broad knowledge on threat analysis and experience in intelligence reporting
  • Excellent English written/verbal and communication skills
  • Experience in administrating a SIEM solution such as IBM QRadar or Splunk ES
  • Experience in investigation on a Microsoft EDR solution such as Sentinel One or Palo Alto Cortex XDR.
  • Experience in reversing malware is a plus
  • Technical security certifications (at least one) such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, C|EH, GIAC GSEC, GIAC GCDA, GIAC GDAT
  • Industry certifications like CISA, CISM, CISSP is a plus

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What we offer

• Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.• Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).• Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.• Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.• Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.• Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Only your skills matter

Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.
