title: IT Engineer
description: ROLE OVERVIEW Royal Cyber is seeking a QAD Developer with strong EDI and integration experience to build and deliver the full QAD-side integration. This role covers five brands (Rotronic, Michell, Ntron, SST, Dynament) running on QAD across US and UK/EU entities. You will own all QAD-side integration workstreams from Discovery (W1) through to go-live at W18, including EDI flow development, product/pricing feed configuration, order status automation, and SFDC/Hybris connectivity via Boomi. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Participate in discovery from W1 — document QAD entity structure (multiple US + UK/EU entities per brand), integration touchpoints, and data models • Build and configure EDI transaction flows within QAD: 850 PO inbound, 855 order confirmation outbound, 856 ASN outbound, 810 invoice outbound, 860 change order handling • Implement product and pricing feed from SAP S/4HANA into QAD — catalogue alignment across all five brands and multiple entities • Develop order status update flows from QAD to SFDC and SAP Hybris via Boomi • Build inventory feed from QAD to SAP Hybris (ecommerce platform) • Implement returns/RMA status flows: QAD → SFDC case update → Hybris • Implement Akeneo inventory sync (S/4HANA ↔ QAD) and Akeneo price feed (S/4HANA → Akeneo) • Configure Boomi processes for all non-CPI flows (SFDC, Hybris, Akeneo, order status, returns) • Participate in SIT (W9–W13), EDI partner regression (W12–W14), UAT support, and go-live cutover at W18 • Produce QAD integration runbooks and hand over to client team at programme close REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE • 4+ years hands-on QAD ERP development and configuration experience • Strong QAD EDI knowledge — inbound/outbound transaction configuration (850, 855, 856, 810, 860) • Experience with multi-entity QAD environments (US and international entities) • Familiarity with Boomi AtomSphere for middleware integration (process design, connectors) • Understanding of SAP S/4HANA product/pricing data structures for feed configuration • Experience with EDI VAN connectivity and partner onboarding / regression testing • Ability to work within a structured SDLC with formal SIT/UAT and cutover processes PREFERRED / NICE TO HAVE • Experience with SAP Hybris B2B commerce integration • Knowledge of Akeneo PIM connector patterns • Familiarity with SFDC integration for order and case management • Previous work on M&A integration or ERP harmonisation programmes

title: Principal Software Engineer, Toast Partner Connect
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction for our Partner Connect team, which owns how everything outside Toast connects to Toast. That includes the event infrastructure every team at Toast uses to publish data, the frameworks partners and customers use to integrate with restaurants through our APIs, and a new charter to make Toast the source of truth for all the data about the restaurants we serve.

Your impact will run well past this team. The frameworks Partner Connect builds are what other Toast engineering teams use to expose their data and their events, so the patterns you set here become how dozens of teams ship for years afterward. Get that right and the entire platform moves faster. Few technical roles at Toast have that kind of reach into how other people build.

You're someone who does your best work when the path isn't drawn yet. You write clearly, you build agreement across organizations rather than issuing mandates, and you treat the engineers who use your systems as customers whose experience matters. You'll be based in Bangalore, working with a small and growing team spread across Bangalore, Dublin, and Boston, and partnering closely with the engineering manager and product manager to turn a broad vision into work the team can actually deliver.

Come own a domain that touches every Toast customer and every Toast engineer.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own the technical strategy for Partner Connect and make it legible to people well outside the team.
  • Design the platform that lets strategic partners send us customer data, and the architecture for storing it and serving it to ToastIQ and our AI agents.
  • Design the systems that make partner onboarding automated, self-serve, and fast, including sandbox provisioning and a clean path to production.
  • Set the frameworks, contracts, and standards other Toast teams use to publish events and expose APIs, and build the feedback loops that tell you whether those teams are succeeding.
  • Build partnerships across Commerce, platform, and product organizations so the technical direction here aligns with where Toast is going.
  • Partner with the engineering manager and product manager to turn vision into an executable roadmap, holding the balance between new architecture and the systems the team already runs in production.
  • Raise the technical bar through architecture, design review, and code review, and mentor engineers across levels as the team grows.
  • Guide the team to build for the next order of magnitude of scale, with the monitoring and operational maturity to match.
  • Use AI tools in your own workflow and help establish how the team uses them well, including how to critically evaluate what they produce.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years designing and delivering complex, scalable backend systems, with a track record of technical leadership on work that mattered to the business.
  • Demonstrated influence beyond your own team. You've driven a technical direction other teams adopted, and you can describe how you earned that.
  • Deep experience with distributed, event-driven architectures and APIs in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or a similar language, on a major cloud platform.
  • Strong data architecture and schema design judgment. You've made modeling decisions that had to survive years of new requirements.
  • Experience owning a platform or shared service with real internal consumers, and a point of view on how you knew whether those consumers were succeeding.
  • Comfort starting from ambiguity. Parts of this charter have no playbook yet, and your first job is to write one.
  • A customer-first instinct that extends to developers. You care that an integration is pleasant to build against, not only that it's correct.
  • Excellent written communication. At this level a clear design document is one of your highest-value artifacts, especially on a team split across three time zones.
  • Strong interpersonal skills. Respectful, empathetic, humble, and genuinely invested in making the engineers around you better.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered engineering tools to improve productivity, code quality, and technical decision making, with the judgment to validate what they generate. Experience championing responsible, secure AI adoption across engineering teams is a real plus.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. By embedding these principles into our culture and design, we create equitable opportunities for all and raise the bar in delivering exceptional experiences.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

Praktikos metu dirbsi kartu su patyrusiais specialistais ir iš arti susipažinsi su ESO darbo specifika.

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Susipažįstant su technologinėmis kortomis, darbo saugos instrukcijomis ir ESO reikalavimais vykdant elektros tinklo darbus;
  • Įgyjant praktinių žinių apie elektros įrenginių įrengimą, eksploatavimą ir techninę priežiūrą;
  • Susipažįstant su remonto darbų organizavimo procesu – kaip planuojami, vykdomi ir aktuojami elektros tinklo remonto darbai;
  • Mokantis dirbti su remonto darbuose naudojamais mechanizmais, matavimo prietaisais ir apsaugos priemonėmis, kompiuterine ir programine įranga;
  • Perprantant darbo organizavimo bei darbų saugos užtikrinimo principus energetikos sektoriuje.
  • Studijuoji elektrotechnikos, energetikos ar susijusios krypties programą profesinėje ar aukštojoje mokykloje;
  • Esi motyvuota (-as) 6-9 mėnesius mokytis, stebėti patyrusių elektrikų ir inžinierių darbą bei gilinti praktines elektrotechnikos žinias realioje darbo aplinkoje;
  • Geri lietuvių kalbos įgūdžiai (žodžiu ir raštu).

Privalumas būtų:

  • B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimas.
  • Galimybę po sėkmingos stažuotės tęsti karjerą ESO
  • Galimybę kasdieniniais darbais kurti vertę Lietuvai;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą, kurį sudaro sveikatos draudimas ir sveikatinimosi išmoka;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Finansinį skatinimą už kandidatų rekomendavimą;
  • Modernią, aukščiausius saugumo reikalavimus atitinkančią darbo aplinką;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Profesionalią naujos kartos energetikų bendruomenę;
  • Vertybėmis grįstą lyderystę ir verslo sprendimus.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Data Center Technician - 	Blonduos, Iceland
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do:

The Data Centre Operations team is at the physical core of our business, responsible for building, maintaining, and operating the cutting-edge infrastructure that powers the cloud. This team ensures the stability, security, and scalability of our physical assets, working hands-on in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment to deliver a best-in-class experience for our clients.

About the role:

The Data Centre Technician will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data centre operations. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics, followed by physical repair, and includes maintenance of data centre operations to ensure service availability. You will be responsible for root cause analysis of failures, training internal teams, and developing documentation or scripts to update server and networking hardware. As part of this 100% on-site role, you must be able to respond to on-site equipment failures within 60 minutes while scheduled on-call and travel up to 10% of the time to other locations as required.

Who You Are:

  • Computer Hardware experience, including troubleshooting and assembling.
  • Linux Operating System experience.
  • Ability to regularly transport and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and maneuver in cramped or elevated spaces, such as ladders or under-floor areas.
  • Ability to perform tasks requiring fine motor skills for handling small hardware components and cables.
  • Availability to work a flexible schedule within a 24/7 environment, including participating in a rotating on-call shift.
  • Excellent time management, organisational, and communication skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and react quickly to issues.
  • Ability to perform essential job duties in environments with fluctuating temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Computer Networking.
  • Python, Bash, or other scripting languages experience.
  • Experience with Cisco IOS and/or Juniper JunOS.
  • An Associate's Degree or equivalent experience in an IT-related field.

Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You love to solve complex physical and technical problems through hands-on repair.
  • You're curious about root cause analysis and improving data centre reliability.
  • You're an expert in hardware diagnostics and maintaining critical infrastructure.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results

They also ensure we have enough resources to meet current and future Platform demand efficiently, involving forecasting needs, capacity planning, monitoring performance (KPIs), managing risks (shortages/overloads), and developing strategies for optimisation.

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. title: Product Manager - Indirect Tax Calculation, Tax Engine Business
description:
Amazon is looking for a Product Manager to join its Tax Department's Indirect Tax Calculation – Tax Engine Business team. This team operates in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, striving to ensure Amazon's tax technology and processes are accurate and adaptable to a changing business landscape.

In this role, you will play a pivotal part in driving the development and success of our indirect tax calculation products. You will be responsible for providing technical product requirements documents, collaborating with software and business teams throughout the entire project lifecycle –from design-to-delivery, manage tax related queries, and ensuring the delivery of high-impact solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth. You will also be/become a subject matter expert in tax technology trends and challenges, leveraging this expertise to add value to our customers and differentiate our solutions in the marketplace. Future growth opportunities to take on different types of projects and programs over time are possible within the scope of this team.


Key job responsibilities
As a Product Manager you will help develop and evolve our indirect tax technology, processes, services, features, and operations. You will be expected to respond to new or changing tax legislative/compliance and business needs, and drive the end-to-end project lifecycle required to adapt or enhance our indirect tax collection capabilities to meet those needs. You will partner closely with cross functional teams across nearly all of Amazon to gather business and tax requirements, convert those requirements into product specifications, collaborate with software and business teams, and continue to engage through the entire lifecycle of our projects – from design-to-delivery.

A day in the life
• Meeting with tax, business, and software teams to understand their goals and identify the associated indirect tax calculation and collection implications. Identifying the required technical, process and operational changes to support those objectives. Developing product functional and user experience requirements, feature specifications, and standard operating procedures.
• Actively participating in projects throughout their lifecycle to ensure that the requirements are met – to include making tax rules configurations, specifying and reviewing test cases, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring alignment across teams.
• Understanding your customers (consumers, sellers, taxing authorities, and Amazon internal teams) to ensure that our product development consistently meets the objectives and experience expectations of our customers. Developing long term product strategies and associated product roadmaps – seeking consensus to prioritize those strategies, documenting trade-offs, and removing obstacles as necessary.
• Providing general indirect tax calculation and collection super subject matter expertise to internal and external personas – including legal, customer service, public policy, media relations, business development, tax software vendors and service providers, taxing authorities and other governmental entities, and industry and tax groups.

title: Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
location: Corvallis, Oregon, United States of America
description:
Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer

Description -

Why Join HP as a Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer?

At HP, you'll have the opportunity to shape the critical infrastructure that powers cutting-edge technology development and advanced manufacturing operations. As a Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer, you'll lead complex projects across the full lifecycle, from system design and integration through commissioning, startup, and long-term sustainment. You'll influence the reliability, safety, and performance of business-critical manufacturing and facility systems while working with advanced control technologies, PLCs, SCADA platforms, and integrated infrastructure solutions. This role offers the chance to combine deep technical expertise with leadership, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving, partnering with talented engineers, project teams, and industry suppliers to deliver impactful results. If you're passionate about system integration, bringing new solutions online, and driving innovation in a highly collaborative environment, this is an opportunity to grow your career while helping build the future of technology at HP.


Responsibilities

  • Lead I&C projects through full lifecycle (scope, design, implementation, validation, commissioning/start-up) for complex site and infrastructure systems.

  • Provide technical leadership for control system architecture, PLC/HMI/SCADA solutions, control panel design, and integration with facility systems.

  • Develop scopes of work, cost/schedule inputs, and technical requirements, coordinate with project managers, construction, system engineers, and designers.

  • Review designs and project activities for compliance with codes, standards, and internal guidelines; provide clear feedback to improve quality and maintainability.

  • Perform field verification and investigations; produce field notes/redlines and ensure sustaining drawings and documentation are updated.

  • Manage and expand relationships with internal teams and external suppliers/integrators; support issue resolution and remove project roadblocks.

  • Mentor and guide less experienced engineers; contribute to process improvements and adoption of new technologies.


Education & Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or related engineering field (Master’s preferred).

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in industrial controls and/or facility infrastructure environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical work, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results with minimal direction.

  • Experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing facility systems (e.g., HVAC, pumped chemical, gas, industrial wastewater treatment).

  • Platform experience such as Emerson RX3i PLCs and/or GE Cimplicity SCADA.


Required Certifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.


Knowledge & Skills

  • Controls engineering: PLC programming and troubleshooting, control panel/system design, discrete/analog signals, and PID control fundamentals.

  • HMI/SCADA: development and configuration of operator interfaces.

  • Electrical fundamentals: understanding of applicable electrical codes; 3‑phase power distribution, metering, and common industrial components.

  • Design and documentation: interpret drawings/schematics/wiring diagrams; perform field verification; create and incorporate redlines/updates.

  • Tools/software: proficiency with relevant engineering and analysis tools (e.g., power system studies tools such as PTW/EZPOWER/PowerWorld, as applicable).

  • Networking concepts: familiarity with IT network architecture as applied to industrial control systems (switches, edge devices, segmentation considerations).

  • Analytical and communication skills: strong problem solving; ability to communicate architectures, design trade-offs, and recommendations to stakeholders.

The pay range for this role is $116,150 to $182,400 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. description:

Within the Financing & Treasury Division, the Treasury Department manages Liquidity management and Front-Office activities for both Corporate, Treasury Center and Business entity activities.

You will be part of the Group Corporate & JVs Cash Management team, managing these Corporate & JVs activities and part of the operational entities within the Group.

The job includes the following missions (not limitative):

Liquidity management & Reporting

• Ensure the cash management of Corporate & JVs entities: Daily reconciliation of flows, resolve any related issues with external parties, link with accounting department, manage and follow-up the FX exposure on a monthly basis;
• Assist as needed on the daily cash management of Group Treasury Center (T.EN Eurocash): management of cash pooling with subsidiaries linked to Treasury Center, Cash optimization according to global and per currency position together with Front Office, Group and Bank counterpart monitoring.
• Bi-monthly Short-Term Forecast (STF) process: follow-up of timely data reporting by main entities in scope of this report, consolidation of figures and analysis of variances between declaration of the current STF vs. the previous STF;
• Support on the Group Cash and Debt Reporting bi-monthly process with the use of Oracle Hyperion Planning: opening/follow-up of reporting, submit the report for the corporate entities, check the timely data submission by all subsidiaries worldwide and assist in checking of consistency of the data reported/consolidation and drafting of the report for the Chief Financial Officer.

title: Program Assistant (CSI), LES 4
description:
Organization profile

Every year, millions of people around the world go missing as a result of conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, irregular migration, and other causes. This is a complex global challenge that can be tackled effectively through cross-cutting programs that address a variety of difficult, interconnected issues.

The International Commission on Missing Persons (ICMP) is a treaty-based intergovernmental organization with Headquarters in The Hague, the Netherlands. Its mandate is to secure the cooperation of governments and others in locating missing persons from conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, migration and other causes and to assist them in doing so. To learn more about ICMP click here.


Key Responsibilities

Under the overall guidance and supervision of the CSI Program Coordinator and in close cooperation with the Program Officer (CSI) and other departments (Finance, Procurement, General Services, HR) in the Ukraine office and ICMP’s headquarters, the Program Assistant’s duties and responsibilities will include, but will not necessarily be limited to, the following:

  • Provide general support to ensure a smooth-running of the CSI Program.
  • Provide logistical and administrative support in organizing roundtables, travel, workshops, info sessions and other program activities.
  • Maintain relevant formal documents and correspondence with sub-grantees and other CSI partners.
  • Assist in the administrative implementation of the program's initiatives and activities especially related to managing the small grants.
  • Assist in small program-related purchases and temporary contractors.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Program Support on the preparation of Special Service Contracts for venues, interpreters, contractors and follow up on the procedures.
  • Other related duties as assigned.


Mandatory Requirements

  • Post secondary qualification in international relations, business administration or other relevant disciplines;
  • At least four (4) years of relevant professional experience in office management and preparation of events, media materials, reports and briefing papers;
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Ukrainian.


Other Requirements

  • Knowledge of political structures, relevant governmental institutions, specialized agencies and IOs in Ukraine dealing with the rule of law, human rights and missing persons issues in particular;
  • Fully proficient computer skills and use of relevant software and other applications, e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, internet, power point and experience in handling of web-based management systems, including Word, Excel, and Power Point;
  • Ability to form and maintain relationships through teamwork;
  • Consistently approaches work with energy and a positive, constructive attitude;
  • Openness to change and ability to manage complexities;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, and establishing and maintaining contacts;
  • Proven organizational and communication skills;
  • Demonstrated capacity to undertake assigned responsibilities and work under pressure;
  • An excellent team player, and a self-starter;
  • Seeks and applies knowledge, information and best practices inside and outside ICMP;
  • Tact, discretion and diplomacy;
  • Willingness and ability to work and live in Ukraine under hardship conditions with limited infrastructure
  • and personal privacy;
  • Physical and mental resilience, with the ability to operate effectively in hostile environments;
  • Commitment to the underlying objective of helping the authorities and families of the missing to account for missing persons in an impartial and transparent manner.


Benefits

This is a full-time, fixed-term position with a competitive base salary at LES4 on the ICMP Ukraine salary scale, generous paid leave, and extensive health insurance benefits for the incumbent and any eligible dependant(s). This position is not eligible for expatriate benefits and allowances.


VN close date: 31 August 2026

Expected start date: 1 October 2026


ICMP is committed to maintaining an environment of mutual respect, where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants. ICMP believes that diversity and inclusion among our staff are critical to our success as a global organization, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented individuals from a thoroughly diverse range of candidates. ICMP is proud to be part of the International Gender Champions network.


ICMP may cancel this recruitment without notice or may decide to offer a position with different duties and/or contract length.

ICMP does not request payment during any stage of the selection process.


All applications must be submitted in English. ICMP does not accept applications in any other language.

I Gaia taler børn, forældre og medarbejdere pænt til og om hinanden

I Gaia er alle børn, forældre og medarbejdere betydningsfulde i fællesskabet

I Gaia er forskellighed en ressource

I Gaia har alle voksne; medarbejdere og forældre ansvar for fællesskabet

I Gaia skal alle børn have venner!

Du bliver en del af en medarbejdergruppe, der står klar til at tage imod dig. Vi guider og hjælper dig ind i vores fællesskab. Arbejdet består af forskelligartede opgaver; både pædagogiske og praktiske. Du skal både arbejde ude og inde,

title: Rides Guest Services and Operations Assistant
description:
Job Description

Location: Hakuba, Japan

Dates: November, 2026 - April 2027 (exact dates TBC) - Seasonal, Full-time

Salary: From ¥1800 per hour


About us:

Rhythm is about creating epic experiences for our customers, which starts with our people. We live by our values and put people first. We take pride in creating working and living environments that foster innovation, adventure, and balance. Working at Rhythm is more than a job, it's an experience you will have forever.

The Role:
Our Rides Guest Services team is key to giving our guests an epic experience – listening to each customer’s needs and goals and using deep product knowledge to recommend the best on-snow lesson or guiding experience. In this combined role you’ll also keep our Snowsports operation running smoothly, supporting the day-to-day logistics, administration and on-mountain coordination that get every lesson started on time. It’s a varied, fast-paced role that sits at the heart of both the guest experience and the operation behind it.


Key Responsibilities and Duties:
Guest Services

  • Process lesson enquiries received via email, phone, our booking system.
  • Assist and advise customers on the best on-mountain experience for their goals and ability level,

upselling where appropriate.

  • Proactively listen to, communicate and resolve customer feedback, escalating to a supervisor where needed.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our products and services and complete all booking processes accurately.
  • Professionally liaise with our booking partners in the resort so shared guests enjoy a seamless

experience.

Operations & program support

  • Assist with the organisation and logistics of the Privates and Training programs, and other Snowsports programs as needed.
  • Collaborate with the operations team to deliver a successful daily line-up, ensuring all lessons begin on time and as expected.
  • Liaise with instructors to help locate guests and resolve any issues that arise during lesson time.
  • Drive guests or instructors to their lesson start location as needed, including in an emergency.
  • Assist with vehicle logistics and process, including daily key handover for product and other support.

Administrative support

  • Prepare and distribute reports, memos and other documents related to Snowsports operations.
  • Provide general administrative support – data entry, filing and record-keeping.
  • Assist with staff scheduling, timekeeping and payroll processes as needed.
  • Support the team Managers and contribute to improving operational procedures and systems.

What you need to succeed:

  • A passion for the mountains, our community and our sport – and a fire for passing it on to others.
  • Previous experience in a customer service or administrative role, ideally in snowsports or outdoor recreation.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision under pressure, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines.
  • A detail-oriented mindset ensuring accuracy across bookings, data and tasks. • A solid understanding of skiing and snowboarding progression, so you can confidently coordinate the right experiences.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and general computer systems for data entry, scheduling and record-keeping.
  • A collaborative approach, working effectively with staff across departments.
  • A valid Japanese or International Driving Licence (IDL) and happy to drive Rhythm vehicles.
  • Good knowledge of the local Hakuba area is a bonus.

The Perks and Benefits:

As a Rhythm employee, you’ll experience the same legendary hospitality we extend to our guests. We’re passionate about looking after our crew, and here are just a few of the perks you’ll enjoy when you join our team:

  • Live, Work, and Play in Paradise: Immerse yourself in one of the world’s top mountain resorts.
  • Work with a Legendary Crew: Join a team that’s passionate, fun-loving, and deeply connected to the industry.
  • Subsidized Staff Accommodation: Affordable housing options and housing assistance to help you settle in.
  • Epic Social Scene: From team ride days and department dinners to staff parties, events, and day trips, our social calendar is packed with opportunities to connect and unwind.
  • Wellness and Lifestyle Benefits: Access the Rhythm Wellness program, enjoy free snowsports or bike demos, and take advantage of generous store discounts for you, your friends, and your family.

At Rhythm, we work hard, but we play even harder. If you know anyone who’s worked with us before, they’ll tell you this isn’t just a job- it’s an experience of a lifetime. Our fun, supportive culture is the heart of everything we do because people like you make Rhythm what it is.

title: Sygeplejerske til Hjemme- og sygeplejen Aften
description:
Bliv en del af vores team!

Er du en passioneret sygeplejerske, der brænder for at gøre en forskel i det nære sundhedsvæsen? Så er du måske vores næste kollega!
Timetal er efter aftaler og vi er åben for dialog herom – weekendvagt hver 4. weekend. Stillingen er en fast aftenvagt, med mulighed for enkelte andre vagttyper hvis dette ønskes.

Hvem er vi?
Hjemme- og sygeplejen er placeret på 4 baser – Fjerritslev, Brovst, Aabybro og Pandrup.
Aften- og nattevagten har base i Brovst. Disse er bemandet med henholdsvis 3 sygeplejersker i aftenvagt og 2 i nattevagt.
Sygeplejen har én indgang og denne er bemandet med 4 koordinerende sygeplejersker.
Derudover består sygeplejen af 3 demenskoordinatorer samt 5 centersygeplejersker, en borgernær sygeplejerske og psykiatrisk sygeplejerske.
Vi varetager også akutfunktionen som primært varetages af én sygeplejerske i dagvagten. Aften og nat varetages funktionen af de sygeplejersker der er i vagt.
I sygeplejen har vi en del specialfunktioner – sår, kompression, klinisk vejleder og derudover nøglefunktion indenfor diabetes og palliation.

Vi er uddannelsessted for sygeplejerskestuderende på 3., 4. og 6. semester, hvor det er et fælles arbejde mellem kliniske vejledere og de resterende sygeplejersker at sikre at vores fremtidige kollegaer får den bedst mulige kliniske periode.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med rusmiddelcenter omkring substitutionsbehandling derudover inddrages vi meget bredt da vi kan tilkaldes på skæve tidspunkter på såvel bosteder og plejecentre.

Hjemme- og sygeplejen har fælles lokal ledelse men det ledelsen af det sundhedsfaglige område ligger hos leder i Brovst. Dette betyder også at du som aftenvagt vil have indmøde og ledelsestilknytning til Brovst.

Din hverdag som sygeplejerske
Med et stadig større ansvar for opgaver, der tidligere blev varetaget af sygehusvæsenet, vil du få spændende og komplekse opgaver som IV-behandlinger, akutte vurderinger, sårpleje og palliation. Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling og tilbyder løbende sparring og vidensdeling.

Vi har sygeplejeklinikker, hvor de mest mobile borgere får behandling og opfølgning, og en akutfunktion, som varetages af sygeplejersker med specialkompetencer. Du vil også få mulighed for at arbejde på plejecentrene da de udekørende klarer de komplekse opgaver der i weekend, aften og nattevagter, sammen med et team af dedikerede kollegaer.

Hvem er du?
  • Du er uddannet sygeplejerske og har klinisk erfaring
  • Du trives med at dele viden, sparre og støtte dine kollegaer
  • Du arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik
  • Du er positiv overfor forandringer og tager dem konstruktivt op
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men trives også som en del af et team
  • Du er interesseret i velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og ser dem som en mulighed for at optimere arbejdet
  • Har du andre specialkompetence er vi åben for dette, idet vi har forskellige nøglefunktioner i sygeplejen

Vi tilbyder:
  • En grundig introduktion med et skræddersyet introduktionsprogram, der giver dig indsigt i de forskellige opgaver
  • Et spændende og udfordrende job med mulighed for stor indflydelse og udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads i konstant udvikling, hvor din faglige og personlige vækst er vigtig
  • Et engageret og selvstændigt kollegateam, der støtter hinanden
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer både fagligt og personligt
  • Løn efter overenskomst samt lokale aftaler

er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Jette Simonsen, Leder af det sundhedsfaglige område på telefon 41 91 23 04.

Der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende så skynd dig at komme til tasterne.

title: Kernel Developer
description:
The company is hiring remote specialists who have already relocated from Russia/Belarus.

Description

TuxCare offers a comprehensive portfolio of security solutions for Linux and open-source software designed for enterprise organizations. With TuxCare, companies can automate live vulnerability patching, minimize downtime, ensure security and compliance, and rely on a team with deep expertise in Linux security. The solutions cover the most popular Linux distributions, end-of-life systems, programming languages, and more.

Product Description

KernelCare provides automated live patching for Linux kernels without requiring reboots. Our Extended Lifecycle Support products keep end-of-life Linux distributions secure by backporting important security and bug fixes to older software versions used by enterprise customers.

Role and Team

We are looking for a Kernel Developer to join the KernelCare ELS team. The team investigates upstream Linux kernel changes, backports fixes to supported enterprise kernels, builds distribution packages, and validates that patches are safe and reproducible.

The role is centered on practical patching and building work. You will also use automation and agentic development tools to accelerate investigation while retaining engineering ownership of every result.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate upstream security and bug fixes and identify their dependencies.
  • Backport Linux kernel patches to older RPM- and Debian-based distributions.
  • Resolve conflicts caused by differences between upstream and target kernel versions.
  • Build and rebuild kernel source and binary packages in reproducible environments.
  • Validate patched kernels through focused tests, build checks, and regression analysis.
  • Improve patch preparation, build, and validation workflows with Python, Go, or Shell.
  • Use agentic development tools responsibly and verify generated code, analysis, and documentation.
  • Document technical decisions and participate in code review with the kernel team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Strong C programming and Linux debugging skills.
  • Practical Linux kernel development, patching, or backporting experience.
  • Confident use of Git, GNU build tools, and standard Linux development utilities.
  • Experience building Linux kernels or distribution packages.
  • Automation experience with Python, Go, Shell, or a similar language.
  • Some experience with agentic or AI-assisted development and a clear approach to validating generated output.
  • English at an intermediate level or higher, both written and spoken.
  • Strong ownership, careful technical judgment, and readiness to explain trade-offs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with RPM/SRPM or Debian kernel packaging.
  • Security patching, CVE analysis, or extended lifecycle maintenance experience.
  • Familiarity with Docker, QEMU, Jenkins, or other CI systems.
  • Experience designing kernel tests or investigating core dumps and regressions.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

title: Director, Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Americas Remote

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. I'm looking for an experienced engineering leader to own several of Customer.io's product development engineering teams. This is a role for someone whose primary job is business impact: you set clear goals, hold teams accountable to schedules, and personally drive complex initiatives to done. Your first mandate is a high-priority, executive-visible platform initiative — the kind of project where you'll set the direction, align the org, and carry it across the finish line yourself. If you're energized by making things happen inside an organization — not just managing the people who do — this role is for you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Execution above all
Leading a team and driving impact are not the same job — yours is the second one, and the team is how you do it. You set direction, create accountability, and see initiatives through across an organization. When something must ship, you put it on your back.

Engineering leaders who go deep and wide
You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align executives on a roadmap and earn an engineering team's respect in the same day. You still read the code, join the incident channel, and know why the thing is late. You don't choose between vision and execution — you hold both.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"
You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait.

An AI-first engineering mindset
AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You've developed a real point of view on AI-native development, you can speak to it concretely, and you bring it into how your org operates.

What You'll Do

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for major platform initiatives — starting with the delivery of our new billing platform, a high-visibility integration program spanning Engineering, Product, and Finance
  • Set clear goals and delivery milestones, hold teams accountable to them, and communicate progress crisply to executive stakeholders
  • Make build-vs-buy and sequencing decisions with conviction, and lead the team through them
  • Mentor and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders — with the bar that everyone on the team can articulate the impact they're driving
  • Drive a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the org
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate team velocity and bring an AI-native perspective to how the team builds

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time leading engineering teams
  • Experience managing engineering managers and/or senior technical leaders
  • A track record of driving complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion — you've taken something ambiguous and org-spanning and personally made it ship
  • Deep understanding of SaaS software architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that come with building in-house vs. buying and integrating
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear strategy and communicate effectively with both engineers and executives
  • Demonstrated AI-native leadership — not just personal fluency, but a track record of bringing AI-first development practices into how your team works
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and making difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities
  • You can articulate, specifically, what you made happen in your last role that wouldn't have happened without you

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in the domains of self-service and growth, audience segmentation, or customer data platforms (CDPs)
  • Exposure to billing, subscriptions, or monetization systems — useful context for your first mandate, not a requirement
  • Experience at high-growth SaaS companies; you have delivered results at a startup
  • Track record of shipping in high-velocity product orgs where your domain was treated as a first-class engineering concern

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $230,000-$270,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for, your leadership style, and how we work.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Deep dive into your experience leading teams, your technical philosophy, and how you think about building organizations.
  4. People Partner Interview (60 mins) - Explore your leadership style, management philosophy, and approach to supporting high-performing teams with our engineering people partner.
  5. Technical Interview (60 mins) - Engage in a collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
  6. Take-Home Assignment - Submit a short written retrospective on a project you’ve led as an Engineering Manager.
  7. Retrospective Review Call (60 mins) - We’ll use your written submission as the foundation for a deeper conversation.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-director-engineering

title: Analyst-Compliance
description:
The Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) is part of American Express's Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) organization within Global Risk & Compliance. GFCSU partners closely with the U.S. Investigations Unit (USIU) to detect, investigate, and mitigate financial crime risk across the enterprise.

GFCSU is responsible for identifying and investigating potentially suspicious financial activity through transaction monitoring, data analysis, and investigative research. The team reviews complex cases involving money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and other financial crime risks. When appropriate, GFCSU supports the filing of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) and partners with internal compliance teams to meet global regulatory reporting obligations.

By leveraging advanced monitoring tools, analytical techniques, and cross-functional collaboration, GFCSU helps safeguard American Express from financial crime while ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA). The team's work is critical to protecting the company, supporting regulatory compliance, and assisting law enforcement in combating money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, identity theft, and other illicit activity.

The successful candidate will work in our hub in Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) to mitigate risk to the American Express enterprise through research and analysis of financial activity for suspicious patterns along with the review of records. Candidates must be flexible and willing to change responsibilities to meet business needs, should be comfortable reading and reviewing records from multiple jurisdictions, and be able to work with various teams across American Express, including international Market Compliance Officers, line of business representatives, and project teams, among others.

How will you make an impact in this role?

  • Conduct time-sensitive, meticulous financial crime investigations, analyzing each instance of potential suspicious financial activity across multiple jurisdictions and countries, utilizing a wide variety of research and analytical tools.

  • Demonstrate a keen attention to detail in investigation, analysis, and writing.

  • Produce well-written reports detailing and analyzing potentially suspicious activity.

  • Review other analysts' investigations and provide constructive feedback.

  • Ability to pivot smoothly between the different GFCSU workflows: AML, EDD, Screening and Anti-Corruption.

  • Meet performance expectations: productivity and quality goals.

  • Compliance with SLAs.

  • Collaborate on additional projects to assist the various CGFCSU teams.

  • To develop and maintain an adequate knowledge of the financial crime environment.

  • Build strong relationships with strategic partners across to ensure effective coordination of investigations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least two years of experience in one of the following areas is mandatory: AML compliance, transaction monitoring, sanction screening, EDD, regulatory compliance, law enforcement, fraud investigations and other financial crime investigations (two years minimum).

  • Knowledge of AML legislation and specific financial crime, sector and geopolitical issues.

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).

  • Microsoft Excel proficiency.

  • Proficiency in researching information for business related purposes.

  • Proven ability to work with and analyze large amounts of data in order to report critical information.

  • Effective communication and excellent writing skills.

  • High level of professionalism, self-motivation, and sense of urgency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of languages other than English would be a plus.

  • Certification in Compliance, AML or Financial Crime related fields.

  • Experience working in KYC, Transaction monitoring, Sanctions or EDD departments

  • Highly preferred bachelor’s degree (or equivalent). Ideally in one of the following, or similar, fields of study: Law, Justice Studies, Criminology, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Government & Public Services,

  • Knowledge of data processing and visualization, dashboarding and reporting, process automation and optimization.

    • Valdant sudėtingas klientų situacijas ir konstruktyviai sprendžiant iškilusius klausimus;
    • Bendradarbiaujant su komanda ir prisidedant idėjomis prie klientų patirties gerinimo.

    Darbas organizuojamas kontaktų centro darbo valandomis (I–V 8:00–20:00, VI 9:00–17:00, VII nedirbama). Darbo laikas organizuojamas taikant suminę darbo laiko apskaitą. Yra galimybė rinktis mažesnį darbo krūvį – 0,75 etato.

    • Patirtis klientų aptarnavimo ar pardavimų srityje;
    • Noras ir gebėjimas bendrauti su klientais bei spręsti jų situacijas;
    • Geri darbo kompiuteriu įgūdžiai (MS Office);
    • Atsakingumas, savarankiškumas ir bendradarbiavimo įgūdžiai;
    • Lietuvių kalbos mokėjimas (žodžiu ir raštu).

    Privalumas būtų:

    • Patirtis kontaktų centre;
    • Užsienio kalbų mokėjimas.
    • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir individualiai derinamą darbo grafiką pagal kontaktų centro darbo valandas (I–V 8:00–20:00, VI 9:00–17:00, VII nedirbama);
    • Apmokamas mokymosi atostogas ir papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei bei už sukauptą darbo stažą;
    • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo MELP programėlėje;
    • Kintamąją atlygio dalį iki 10 %, priklausančią nuo individualių ir komandinių tikslų įgyvendinimo;
    • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
    • Galimybę įsitraukti į vidinę iniciatyvą GROW akademija – tapti lektoriais arba dalyvauti mokymuose;
    • Asmeninį telefoną kasdieniam darbui;
    • Darbuotojams skirtą automobilių stovėjimo vietą prie biuro;
    • Galimybę energetiką paversti lengviau suprantama kiekvienam, kuriant unikalią klientų patirtį ar prisidedant prie itin reikšmingų Baltijos šalių regionui energetikos projektų.

    Darbo užmokestis šiai pareigybei yra nuo 9,35 iki 14,03 EUR/val. (~1560 - 2340 EUR/mėn.) neatskaičius mokesčių. Atlygis priklauso nuo kandidato darbo patirties ir kompetencijų. Pareigybei taikoma suminė darbo laiko apskaita.

    Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

    Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

    „Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Senior Project Manager / Director
description:
Project Manager / Director

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Project Manager / Director to lead and oversee construction projects from planning through completion. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of project execution, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards.

Candidates with proven experience in school, nursing home, and factory construction projects will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the planning, execution, and completion of construction projects from inception to handover.

  • Report directly to Management and provide regular updates on project progress, risks, budgets, and resource requirements.

  • Manage multiple projects concurrently while ensuring project objectives, timelines, and quality standards are achieved.

  • Develop, monitor, and update project master programmes, identify critical paths, and implement recovery plans when required.

  • Lead project teams, site management staff, consultants, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth project execution.

  • Review project schedules, manpower deployment, procurement plans, and resource allocation to maximize efficiency and productivity.

  • Monitor project costs, budgets, variations, and claims to ensure financial targets and profitability are achieved.

  • Coordinate with clients, consultants, authorities, and relevant stakeholders to resolve technical, contractual, and operational matters.

  • Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements, safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies.

  • Conduct regular site visits, project reviews, and progress meetings to identify issues and implement corrective actions.

  • Oversee contract administration, tender evaluations, procurement activities, and project documentation.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and maintain high standards of project delivery and client satisfaction.

  • Mentor and develop project team members, fostering a positive and high-performance working environment.

  • Perform any other duties assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Civil Engineering recognized by the Professional Engineers Board (PEB) and Building and Construction Authority (BCA) Singapore.

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in building construction projects, with at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership position.

  • Proven track record in managing school, nursing home, and factory construction projects locally.

  • Experience with main contractor projects will be an advantage.

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, project planning, budgeting, contract administration, and project controls.

  • Familiar with local authority requirements, building regulations, and workplace safety regulations.

  • Strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to manage clients, consultants, subcontractors, and project teams effectively.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

title: EUC Technical Specialist
description:
EUC Technical Specialist

  • Love what you do and leave your mark
  • On-site: Based at our Bulimba office in Brisbane

As an EUC Technical Specialist at Endeavour Group, you will serve as the vital, frontline "face of IT," delivering timely and effective technical support across our Desktop Support function.
Based on-site at our Bulimba Office, you will provide an essential daily onsite IT presence, assisting users both in-person for walk-ins and remotely. In this role, your primary mission is to ensure seamless business operations by resolving hardware, software, and system issues with a focus on operational efficiency, technical excellence, and world-class customer service.

Sound good? Read on.

Here is a taster of what you can expect in this role:

  • Frontline Support: Deliver exceptional service across in-person, phone, email, and ticketing channels to support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ticket Management: Manage and resolve support tickets within the ServiceNow ecosystem, ensuring strict adherence to established SLAs.
  • Hardware Deployment: Expertly set up, configure, and support desktop computers, printers, and peripheral devices.
  • Meeting Room Excellence: Conduct daily audits of meeting room technologies to ensure systems are "meeting ready" and deliver prompt, real-time troubleshooting.
  • Maintenance & Repairs: Perform routine maintenance on Endeavour Group-owned technology and liaise with third-party vendors to coordinate warranty repairs.
  • Asset Management: Maintain rigorous Asset and Configuration Management records across the business.
  • Operational Support: Conduct occasional site visits to provide hands-on IT support to local ALH hotels, EGL Depots, and the wider business.
  • Documentation & Training: Develop and maintain clear procedural documentation and user guides while facilitating staff training sessions.

Now let’s talk about you:

  • Core Technical Expertise: Proven experience in desktop support with demonstrated hands-on technical proficiency in Windows OS, Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft Endpoint Management.
  • Hardware & AV Proficiency: Strong background in installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting computer hardware, peripherals, and meeting room AV technologies.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to bridge the gap between technical jargon and user-friendly explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mindset & Demeanour: A customer-centric approach with a calm, composed, authentic, and resilience under pressure, acting as an approachable "face of IT".
  • Analytical & Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities with a pragmatic, flexible approach to solving complex problems in dynamic corporate and site environments.
  • Process & SLA Knowledge: Demonstrated experience working in team-oriented, problem-solving environments managing ServiceNow incidents and requests within structured SLA frameworks.
  • Desirable Technical Toolsets: Exposure to or experience with the Meraki dashboard, iOS/Android mobile device management, Intune, Google MDM, JAMF, and the Google Workspace suite is highly regarded.
  • Commercial Acumen: A collaborative team player with solid commercial acumen, retail understanding, and an eagerness to continually learn and adapt to new technologies.

The benefits are good too!

  • As a valued member of the team, your health and wellbeing is our top priority. You will have access to a range of free services to help you live well and support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • Endeavour Group is full of opportunities - use our dedicated learning and development options to grow an idea, yourself, and your career. This is just the start, so dream big
  • Find out more about our range of benefits and discounts here

At Endeavour, we value being a workplace where everyone’s welcome - if you meet a number of the requirements (and not all), we encourage you to apply.

We are together creators

With a portfolio that includes Dan Murphy’s, BWS, ALH Hotels, Pinnacle Drinks and more, Endeavour Group is big on sociability. Together we create the moments that bring millions of people together. And together we have more fun, create more opportunities, and score a lot more goals. We’re serious about creating a safe, inclusive and fun place to rock up to where equal opportunity is key, and flexibility is part of how we roll.

We’re all about creating a more sociable future - for our customers and each other. If this job excites you - and you’re close-enough on the requirements, reach out, we’d love to hear from you.

You can learn more about working with us on LinkedIn or at endeavourgroupcareers.com.au.

title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure, Ads Privacy Data Governance
location: Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Ads Privacy Data Governance (APDG) team is at the forefront of Google’s commitment to user trust. We build and maintain high-scale privacy compliance infrastructure that governs Google's Ads data at rest. Our mission is to ensure that every byte of data used across our advertising platforms aligns with evolving global privacy standards, creating a secure foundation for the future of digital advertising.

Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of distributed privacy infrastructure to manage large-scale data governance tasks.
  • Build and integrate GenAI-driven solutions and agentic frameworks to automate complex compliance workflows for data owners.
  • Manage and optimize production execution pipelines to ensure high availability and performance of privacy-critical systems.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Technical Program Managers to translate privacy policies into robust technical requirements.
  • Own the full technical project lifecycle, from initial architectural design to deployment and long-term maintenance.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development using C++, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an industry setting.
  • 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures, algorithms, system design, or large-scale data processing systems.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies and user-centric developer tools.
  • Experience building and deploying Generative AI applications, agentic workflows, or LLM-based automation tools in production environments.
  • Ability to own full end-to-end technical aspects of projects with attention to detail, working effectively with cross-functional partners (PM, TPM, UX, Legal/Policy) and a keen interest in internet privacy.

title: Bliv en del af et stærkt pædagogisk fællesskab i Elverhøj
description:
Pædagog søges til vores lille børnehus Elverhøj

Vil du være en del af et lille børnehus, hvor arbejdsglæde, faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd?

Hos Elverhøj søger vi en uddannet pædagog til vores børnehave. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, men vi finder gerne et timetal, der passer til den rette kandidat.

Vi er et lille hus med højt til loftet – både fagligt og menneskeligt. Her møder du engagerede kolleger, en høj andel af uddannet personale, grin i hverdagen og en leder med en åben dør, hvor sparring aldrig er langt væk.

Hos os får du

Vi står et spændende sted i vores udvikling. I 2026 er vi i gang med implementeringen af Dagtilbud for Alle, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med at udvikle vores læringsmiljøer, organisering og relationskompetencer.

Samtidig har vi oprettet to ekstra stillinger uden flere børn i huset. Det betyder en mærkbart bedre normering, mere tid til børnene og mere luft i hverdagen. Dette har været muligt, da vi har en stærk økonomi.

Vi prioriterer faglig udvikling højt. Derfor får alle pædagoger i efteråret 2026 mulighed for at besøge andre dagtilbud i en uge ad gangen for at hente inspiration og styrke både egen og husets praksis.

Vi arbejder desuden tæt sammen på tværs af huset og har oprettet en overgangspædagogisk funktion mellem vuggestue og børnehave. Det giver børnene en tryg overgang og et tæt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Vi har et stærkt og engageret forældresamarbejde og arbejder hver dag med afsæt i:

  • legens betydning for børns udvikling, trivsel og læring
  • stærke relationer mellem børn og voksne
  • refleksion og faglig sparring om den pædagogiske praksis.
Hverdagen hos os

Du bliver én af tre pædagoger i vores børnehave med 30 børn. Derudover er I en fast medhjælper og en flexjobansat, som også er uddannet pædagog. Samtidig har vi en pædagog og en medhjælper, som arbejder på tværs af huset og understøtter hverdagen. Samt 3 pædagoger og to medhjælpere i vuggestuen.

Elverhøj består af:

  • 30 børnehavebørn
  • 20 vuggestuebørn
  • 12 faste medarbejdere (13 når vi har studerende, som er oveni normeringen).

Vi er én samlet børnehavegruppe, men organiserer hverdagen i mindre grupper med blandt andet faste sproggrupper, turgrupper og legefællesskaber. Vi følger børnenes spor og skaber aktiviteter med udgangspunkt i deres nysgerrighed og interesser.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tydelig ugeplan, fordi vi oplever, at struktur skaber ro, overblik og gode rammer for både børn og voksne. Samtidig er der altid plads til spontanitet, nye idéer og de muligheder, dagen bringer.

Vi er en del af Holme-Rundhøj Dagtilbud.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet pædagog – gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbud.

Du trives med at skabe struktur og organisere hverdagen, men ved også, at de bedste dage opstår i samspillet med børn og kolleger.

Vi håber, at du:

  • ser værdien i børns spontane leg og deltager aktivt i den
  • tager initiativ og bidrager til fælles løsninger
  • kan skabe overblik og struktur i hverdagen
  • reflekterer over egen og fælles praksis
  • vægter et tæt og tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde
  • har lyst til at udvikle både dig selv og vores fælles faglighed.
Derfor skal du vælge Elverhøj

Hos os får du:

  • et lille hus med et stærkt fællesskab
  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kollegaer
  • høj faglighed og gode muligheder for udvikling
  • en forbedret normering og tid til kerneopgaven
  • stor indflydelse på hverdagen
  • en leder med åben dør og kort vej til sparring
  • et engageret forældresamarbejde med stor opbakning til huset.

Du er meget velkommen til at ringe eller aftale et besøg. Vi viser gerne vores hus frem.

Løn og ansættelse

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Vil du vide mere?

Kontakt pædagogisk leder Caroline Hald

23 38 12 45

gcal@aarhus.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: 25. august 2026

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Om Elverhøj

Elverhøj er et lille børnehus med et stort hjerte. Her kender alle hinanden, og fællesskab, nærvær og omsorg er fundamentet for vores hverdag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

title: Quality Control Associate - Microbiology
description:

1.BET testing (Gel clot/Kinetic systems/Validations)

2. MLT testing

3. Sterility testing

4. Product Method Validations (BET/MLT/Sterility)

5. Plate enumerations

title: EUC Engineer
description:

In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for the deployment, management, optimisation, and support of end-user devices, applications, and workplace technologies that enable our people to do their best work.

As the subject matter expert for EUC services, you will play a key role in designing and supporting modern desktop, mobility, virtual desktop, and application delivery environments while ensuring security, reliability, and an exceptional user experience.

About the Role

You will be responsible for the technical management and ongoing improvement of APM's end-user computing environment, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, application delivery platforms, and virtual desktop technologies.

Working closely with Digital, Infrastructure, and Security teams, you will ensure our end-user technology estate remains secure, scalable, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the deployment, configuration, and management of desktops, laptops, and end-user devices.
  • Deliver applications, patches, updates, and software deployments across the organisation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex end-user computing issues.
  • Develop and implement end-user computing strategies and roadmaps.
  • Design and support EUC architectures to meet performance, security, scalability, and resilience requirements.
  • Manage and support technologies including:
    • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)
    • Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS)
    • Application virtualisation solutions
  • Monitor and optimise EUC environments to improve performance and user experience.
  • Apply best practices for capacity planning, resource allocation, and system maintenance.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and maintain security controls including multi-factor authentication, encryption, and access management.
  • Identify, prioritise, and remediate vulnerabilities within agreed service levels.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to continuously improve workplace technology services.

About You

You are a customer-focused technology professional who enjoys solving problems and improving the digital experience for end users. You bring strong technical knowledge across endpoint technologies and thrive in a hands-on environment.

Required Experience

  • 2+ years' experience in End User Computing, Desktop Support, or IT Operations.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile device platforms.
  • Experience with endpoint management tools such as:
    • Microsoft Intune
    • SCCM/MECM
    • Nerdio
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity management solutions.
  • Experience supporting application deployment and endpoint security initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Desirable

  • Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Industry certifications relevant to End User Computing, Microsoft technologies, or endpoint management.
  • ITIL certification or exposure to ITIL processes and service management frameworks.
  • Experience working with VDI, DaaS, and virtualisation technologies.

Why Join APM?

At APM, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation making a positive impact in people's lives. You'll work alongside talented technology professionals in a collaborative environment where innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth are encouraged.

If you're passionate about delivering exceptional end-user experiences and want to be part of a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.
